chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 590: Demon Scripture
paragraphs: There are actually two Divine Forms!
Divine Forms are extremely difficult to manifest!
Chiyou certainly has Divine Forms too, but only three. Ding Ling is so young, yet he already has two and has achieved his goals!
This is truly extraordinary!
What a pity, what a pity...
He and him.
Can only have one master.
Chiyou absolutely cannot submit to anyone, being just a supportive figure!
Thinking of this.
Chiyou looks at Ding Ling involuntarily:
"Disciple, what do you say?"
"First, teach me the Demon Scripture."
Seeing how Chiyou sometimes calls him brat, sometimes boy, sometimes disciple, with such intense mood swings, doesn’t seem like a Great God at all. He seems more like a deceitful, arrogant demon.
How disappointing for the War God of the Army to be such a person!
Ding Ling feels very disappointed.
But now he is cooperating with Chiyou’s act, naturally not showing his disappointment, only responding earnestly:
"Master. You, as my elder, keeping your word, isn’t it expected? How can you go back on what you promised your disciple?"
Seeing Ding Ling’s demeanor and attitude, Chiyou grew anxious and replied:

"I can teach you the Demon Scripture. But once it’s taught, you must immediately release your Sea of Consciousness to nurture my spirit. You see. My spirit is unstable and hard to sustain for long. If you don’t cooperate timely, your master will dissipate, and you’ll lose all my teachings and legacy.
Moreover, the Demon Scripture is extremely difficult to learn.
Even if I taught you, without my guidance, you wouldn’t learn it. So why not wait until I recover a bit, then settle down and slowly guide you?"
"Master, just teach it."
Ding Ling said:
"Failing to learn is my issue."
Ding Ling’s thick-skinned demeanor, with full-level acting, didn’t seem like lying at all.
And Chiyou hasn’t been in Ding Ling’s heart for long, also unable to delve deep, naturally doesn’t know Ding Ling’s thoughts or past deeds.
At this moment, hearing Ding Ling say this, Chiyou pondered for a while, saying:
"Alright. Listen carefully. I will teach you the mantra and technique of the Demon Scripture now..."
The mantra of the Demon Scripture has thousands of words.
Chiyou quickly recited it, asking:
"Have you memorized it?"
Ding Ling recalled it once.
As more books appeared on the library shelf.
The next moment.
[Demon Scripture Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Strength +1]
[Constitution +1]
[Agility +1]
This Demon Scripture is indeed a Void Shattering Level technique!
Even stronger than the Shattering Technique like the Tathagata Divine Palm!
If the Tathagata Divine Palm is Shattering Initial Tier Level.
Then the Demon Scripture definitely reaches Middle Tier standards.
Once fully leveled.
Primordial Qi and Spiritual Mechanism rush in like a flood.
Ding Ling instinctively runs the Eternal Youth Technique.
But finds he cannot refine this Qi flooding into Dantian.
Once this Qi enters the Dantian.
It quickly condenses into three pure black True Qis.
The three True Qis soon merge into one.
Becoming a drop of True Water.
It’s Demon Path True Water.
This True Water is different from Longevity True Water and Nine Yang True Water.
Very sinister and has a demonic nature!
Endlessly transforming, extremely cold and eerie! Very strange!
As the Demon Path True Water flows in.
The Tai Chi Qi and Muscle-Tendon Changing Qi in Ding Ling’s Dantian quickly join the harmonizing process.
Not long after.
The Tai Chi pattern in the Dantian became more apparent.
The Demon Path True Water had transformed into a dot of Supreme Yin, gently rotating.
[True Power Value 31 points]
Undoubtedly.
The True Power Value increased again.
The physical qualities also improved significantly.
Ding Ling’s changes are visible to the naked eye.
Chiyou naturally sees this, shocked to the extreme:
"You, you, how is this possible?! This, this is the Demon Scripture!"
"Is there any saying?"
Ding Ling glances sideways.
With the Demon Scripture at full level.
Ding Ling feels that within his shell, the Demon Path True Water generated by the Demon Scripture forcibly opened one or two rebellious meridians.
These meridians differ from the regular meridians, the Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Extremely eerie, seemingly not existing within the shell, or buried deep within, activated by fully leveling the Demon Scripture!
Once this meridian opened.
Ding Ling feels as if he has mastered an invincible, changeable, very sinister Demon Qi!
This Demon Qi is extremely pure, unlike the Qi seen on the Fire Qilin.
That Qi is violent, bloodthirsty, cruel.
Whereas the Demon Qi within Ding Ling is refined from absorbing the world’s Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, the purest form of Supreme Yin Qi, thus having no side effects.
Chiyou also sensed this point, even more shocked, incredulous:
"I only recited the mantra once, how could you have learned the Demon Scripture?!"
He looks up suspiciously, seemingly seeking confrontation in Ding Ling’s eyes:
"Boy, did you previously obtain the heart technique of my Demon Scripture left in the world?"
Ding Ling gave no answer.
Chiyou then presumed that Ding Ling truly obtained it, strangely relieved, murmuring, ’I said, how could the world have such an incredible genius! Turns out, he learned it earlier.’
Saying this, he laughed twice, saying:

"Boy, it seems you and I really have a master-disciple connection. Since you learned my Demon Scripture earlier, naturally you are under my lineage now. Haha, good. To think someone contemporary could learn the Demon Scripture. Truly a genius!"
Coming to this.
Chiyou was again puzzled and said: "Boy, since you learned the Demon Scripture earlier, why only now did you fully activate this rebellious meridian. It defies common sense?"
Ding Ling just smiled and didn’t answer, changing the topic:
"Master, you said learning the Demon Scripture allows me to master the technique of entering another’s heart gate. But I only learned the fundamental technique of the Demon Scripture, not its skill.
Still need trouble master to teach me the skills of the Demon Scripture."
"Oh?"
Chiyou thought deeply:
"Seems like the skill and technique of the Demon Scripture I left in the world were separated into two halves? You only got the technique?"
Ding Ling didn’t respond.
Chiyou then mused to himself:
"I said I’d teach you the Demon Scripture, and now I have taught you. Shouldn’t you fulfill your promise, release your Sea of Consciousness, and nurture my spirit?"
"Master’s skill has not been taught yet."
A skill is like Martial Arts.
The mantra of the Demon Scripture is akin to Inner Power.
This Inner Power also has the effect of refining the physique. Once fully leveled, it can continuously enhance the physique as the Demon Qi grows over time.
Achieving a peerless magic physique is possible over time.
"You’re going back on your word?!"
Chiyou’s face darkened, angrily saying:
"You’re being dishonest."
"When did I become dishonest?"
Ding Ling countered.
Chiyou thought carefully, hesitated, Ding Ling really hadn’t promised him access to the Sea of Consciousness, realizing this, his face grew more somber:
"If I teach you the skill this time, will you let me into the Sea of Consciousness?"
"Correct. Master, teach me the skill."
"Alright, listen carefully."
Chiyou didn’t hesitate, immediately reciting all the skills’ techniques and mantras, finally saying:
"Alright, I’ve taught what I needed to. Let me in now."
Ding Ling shook his head saying:
"Master, there are errors in this skill."
The skill cannot achieve full level.
Clearly, the mantra technique of this skill is wrong.
"How do you know there’s an error?"
Chiyou glanced sideways, startled:

"Someone encountering this skill for the first time absolutely couldn’t detect its errors. Thus there’s only one possibility. The Demon Scripture you learned wasn’t obtained earlier, but just now when I taught you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 591: Demonic Body
paragraphs: Chiyou was just probing.
Unexpectedly, with one probe, he guessed right.
Before, he was perplexed about how Ding Ling could have learned the Demon Scripture, and why the reverse meridians had only now been developed and activated?!
There must be some trickery involved.
And now, with this probe.
He got the result he wanted.
Chiyou was increasingly shocked and dazed, finding it hard to believe that such a supreme genius could exist in this world!
He remembered that learning the Demon Scripture had cost him dearly!
Especially opening up the reverse meridians brought him great suffering; as no one before him had ever succeeded in mastering the Demon Scripture!
He had created the Demon Scripture by absorbing nutrients from the Dao Scripture and Pangu Celestial Divination Shock, two absolute fundamental techniques!
He knew well the difficulty of this cultivation technique, and he believed that apart from himself, none of his valued subordinates or other supreme geniuses had reached Great Perfection.
Yet now, Ding Ling, a young man from the Human Race, had mastered the Demon Scripture to Great Perfection in an instant.
How is this possible?!
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You have shocked Chiyou!]

[Notes: Your mastered Divine Form, Vast Righteous Qi, and Buddha Qi have shocked Chiyou. Your instant mastery of the Demon Scripture has left Chiyou dazed, questioning life and feeling a strong sense of déjà vu in a dreamlike world!]
Upon hearing the prompt.
Ding Ling understood that his deception had surely been seen through by Chiyou.
He felt some regret.
He had just obtained a fundamental technique of the Demon Scripture.
He still wished to acquire the skill of the Demon Scripture and other cultivation techniques like the War God Technique from Chiyou.
It was imaginable.
Chiyou, in the Ancient Era, a time of numerous talents, held the titles of Commander and War God; his might and combat power must have been earth-shattering, capable of scaring ghosts and gods!
He had used full-level acting and loophole exploration to obtain this Demon Scripture, and now with Chiyou’s realization, it was likely tough to obtain further cultivation techniques.
Sure enough.
After revealing Ding Ling’s secret, Chiyou’s face changed unpredictably as he pondered over something, until he finally took a breath and said:
"Disciple, if you truly consider me your master, open your sea of consciousness immediately."
"Master, you haven’t taught me the skill of the Demon Scripture yet."
Ding Ling spoke sincerely, with utmost sincerity:
"As soon as you teach me the skill, I’ll open my sea of consciousness."
Chiyou was speechless and silent.
Ding Ling’s talent astonished Chiyou beyond imagination.
This made Chiyou even less inclined to freely impart the skill of the Demon Scripture to Ding Ling.
If he were to teach Ding Ling this skill.
Ding Ling would understand the Soul Splitting and Heart Entering Technique, allowing him to instantly comprehend Chiyou’s scheme, leading to an inevitable mortal conflict!
Thinking of this, Chiyou said:
"This skill is closely tied to my life, and therefore I can’t teach it. If you want to learn other techniques, open your sea of consciousness, and I will inject all techniques into it."
"All techniques?"
"Indeed."
Chiyou stared heavenward with bright eyes, seemingly facing Ding Ling’s gaze:
"Including the skill of the Demon Scripture."
Ding Ling scanned his sea of consciousness.
The most important thing in his sea of consciousness was the library.
In addition, there was his consciousness body.
The consciousness body is invisibly connected to the sea of consciousness, and if the sea of consciousness is damaged, the consciousness body would surely be severely injured.
Therefore, one must never casually open one’s sea of consciousness to others.
Ding Ling knew Chiyou had yet to act, which likely meant there was a greater scheme, possibly targeting his life, and judging this, Ding Ling immediately rejected Chiyou’s proposal.
Chiyou was enraged:
"Boy, I’ve already taught you the Demon Scripture. You’re not doing anything in return; isn’t this too much?"
"I’ve released you from my heart, how can you say I haven’t done anything?"
Ding Ling paused, probing:
"If you’re indeed uneasy, I can help you exit my body and go to the outside world."
Upon hearing this, Chiyou showed a panicked expression:
"Impossible!"
"It seems my master’s soul body is indeed very fragile."
Ding Ling saw through it; Chiyou had no choice but to stay within his body, as exiting into the outside world might result in immediate annihilation.
It goes without saying.
Chiyou would choose to use the skill of the Demon Scripture to enter his heart.
Definitely a choice made over thousands of years with no alternatives.
Seeing him approach the coffin, excited and thrilled, made him overlook other thoughts.
But he likely didn’t anticipate the presence of Vast Righteous Qi within one’s heart, even if only Buddha Qi, unable to control him.
Whereas Vast Righteous Qi is precisely his nemesis!
Having learned the Demon Scripture’s fundamental technique, Ding Ling understood this deeply; full-level Demon Scripture makes Buddha Qi hard to suppress, only producing some restraining effects.
Only the grand, vast, pure Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi is the true nemesis of Evil Qi and Demon Qi.
And Vast Righteous Qi is the purest form of Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi!
If not for the protection of Vast Righteous Qi at his heart, he would certainly have fallen into Chiyou’s trap this time!
In essence.
He and Chiyou were already mortal enemies!
Chiyou intended to kill him!
Ding Ling was well-aware, the more he understood the Demon Scripture, the more he knew Chiyou harbored deceitful intentions!
Chiyou too realized this point, knowing it could no longer be hidden, he laughed thrice, saying:

"Although I am very vulnerable, should I choose to strike back, boy, your sea of consciousness will surely shatter, leading to mutual destruction. If you do not wish to die, open your sea of consciousness or your heart."

Chiyou’s face turned fierce, as Demon Qi ignited around him, stirring into intense flames, and his once mighty form suddenly transformed, becoming a monster with three heads, six arms, eight legs, and a human body with bull hooves.
His eyes emitted black flames, burning the surface of Dragon Form and Elephant Form until they began to crackle:
"Brat, you’ve witnessed my power. If you still refuse to cooperate, don’t blame me for my ruthlessness!"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling snorted softly, saying:
"Chiyou, it’s a disgrace that, as a Commander of your time, you resort to such means and schemes to bully a junior!"
From earlier displays of false bravado and grandeur.
To inadvertently revealing impatience and rapid emotional changes.
All of this indicated the Commander was scheming to seize his body!
Understanding this thoroughly, Ding Ling saw Chiyou was unwilling to teach techniques. He stopped bickering with Chiyou, released a ray of Vast Righteous Qi like lightning towards Chiyou.
Chiyou, seeing this, was enraged:
"Brat, you truly wish to perish together!"
Ding Ling did not respond.
He didn’t believe Chiyou had the capability to mutually annihilate.
Because his sea of consciousness is protected by the library!
Could Chiyou shatter the library?!
He did not believe it!
"Hahaha, fine, fine!"
Chiyou laughed with great anger, frustration, suppression, and despair:

"I just came into being not long ago, and encountered a uniquely gifted cunning brat like you! It’s my bad luck, but kid, don’t be too pleased, this is merely one of my soul divisions, even if annihilated here, it won’t harm me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 592: War God Technique
paragraphs: "You need to think it through."
Chiyou watched as the Vast Righteous Qi surged toward him like a rapid current, his pupils narrowing as he spoke faster:
"If you really decide to fight to the death with me, and if one day I break free, I will definitely ascend to the heavens and descend to the earth to kill all your friends and family!"

Ding Ling chuckled softly, thinking that if Chiyou were to possess his body and seize the library, everything of his would belong to Chiyou! And if Little Dragon Girl and others realized that Chiyou wasn’t him, would they still survive?
The intent to kill Chiyou had been set.
Hearing Chiyou’s threat.
Ding Ling was more determined.
Even if Chiyou were in a coffin.
One day, he must destroy him!
The Chiyou before him appeared overbearing and bold, but in reality, he was despicable, treacherous, and insidious!
The Demon Qi lingering on him was almost identical to that on the Fire Qilin!
There’s no doubt they are from the same root!
The Mad Blood on the Fire Qilin was all because of Chiyou!
This Chiyou has already become a demon!
Thinking of this, the Vast Righteous Qi shot toward the Dragon Form’s side, ready to suppress Chiyou.
Seeing this, Chiyou was unwilling, depressed, and laughed loudly thrice, saying:

"I originally thought my luck had turned, that I could break free, and return to the mortal world by borrowing your kid’s body! To break the boundaries of heaven and earth, to attack the Immortal Realm!
But now it seems there’s no chance!
However, if I, Chiyou, can’t have it easy, kid, you definitely won’t either!"
BOOM!
The Vast Righteous Qi condensed into a mountain, together with the Dragon Form and Elephant Form, suppressed Chiyou, pressing him an inch into the ground!
He wore a defiant, ferocious, menacing expression:

"Brat, I warn you again. If you cooperate with me, together we will become one! Then, attacking the Immortal Realm, achieving the body of Gods and Demons, we can naturally split apart, you as god, I as demon. Isn’t that better?"
Ding Ling had countless questions in his heart, so he casually asked where the Immortal Realm was.
Chiyou laughed loudly and said:
"I am the Ancient War God Weapon Master, omnipotent, invulnerable to gods and demons! If you have my protection, your future will be smooth.
Otherwise, not only will you die now,
Your friends and family will all die in the future!
What choice do you make? It’s up to you!"
Ding Ling chose to suppress and kill Chiyou.
This was a demon.
Untrustworthy!
No matter how bold Chiyou seemed or how pleasant his words sounded, they couldn’t deny one fact: he wanted to take Ding Ling’s body for himself!
This was something Ding Ling could not accept.
BOOM!
Ding Ling flipped his wrist, activating the Xuanyuan Divine Sword.
The Human Dao Sword Qi surged overwhelmingly, suddenly rushing into Ding Ling’s body, transforming into a divine sword aimed at the suppressed Chiyou!
Chiyou roared angrily:
"Brat, if that’s the case, today I will fight you to the death!"
BOOM!
His whole body began to burn, and in an instant, he turned into a burning torch. In the next moment, like a black lightning bolt, he broke through the seal and restraint with a loud bang!
Only to fiercely clash with the rushing Human Dao Sword Qi within Ding Ling’s body for merely an instant!
Then once again broke through the blockade of the Human Dao Sword Qi!
Charging into the Sea of Consciousness.
But just as he entered the Sea of Consciousness, preparing to crush Ding Ling’s consciousness body, he saw a vast, boundless library blocking his way forward.
"This, this, what is this?!"
Chiyou was shocked, trembling.
The next second.
The library trembled slightly.
An incomprehensible force burst forth, shattering Chiyou’s soul body in an instant.

Chiyou’s soul body had already consumed thirty percent of its energy breaking through the blockade of Vast Righteous Qi, Dragon Form, and Elephant Form, and another thirty percent in its fierce collision with the Human Dao Sword Qi.
The last forty percent of burning Demon Qi was also considerable. If it really unleashed its power, it could severely damage Ding Ling’s almost undefended Sea of Consciousness!
At this point, Ding Ling.
Had no methods to defend his Sea of Consciousness, and it was hard to find such methods in the Martial World.
Therefore.
Chiyou was so confident.
Unfortunately, after the library had traversed several worlds, its aura became more and more ethereal, deep, and immeasurable.
The Martial Arts Melting Furnace seemed capable of refining everything.
Chiyou’s intrusion.
Was like a piece of firewood voluntarily thrown into the furnace.
As the bookshelves filled with secret manuals and the Martial Arts Melting Furnace targeted together, in an instant, Chiyou’s soul body was crushed.
Whoosh whoosh!
Streams of light divided from the library, swept up the shattered soul body to the top of the furnace, and in moments, Ding Ling unknowingly sensed a technique:
"War God Technique!"
Whoosh!
The technique quickly condensed into a secret manual, placed on one of the bookshelves.
The next second.
[War God Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Strength +1]
[Strength +1]
[Physique +1]
[Defense +1]
[Defense +1]
A feeling identical to that of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill surfaced again.
Ding Ling felt very hungry.
But fortunately, he had experience from before.
This time, after improving by just about two points, the library automatically slowed down the upgrade speed.
It started growing at a rate of about 0.1!
"Another super technique identical to the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!"
Ding Ling felt this technique was extremely powerful.
In terms of body refining, it was not inferior to the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
If it reaches Great Success.
It might achieve the War God Physique! Immortal and indestructible! Even if decapitated, it could still be agile and lively!
"What a powerful War God Technique!"
Ding Ling was shocked.
"In a sense, this War God Technique was truly born for battle!"
The Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill excelled in body refining and achieving Divine Form.
While the War God Technique excelled in body refining and self-healing, repair.
Decapitation, severed hands, severed feet, as long as its energy was sufficient, everything could be restored promptly without harm.
"Invincible!"
Ding Ling’s heart pounded rapidly.
Even he hadn’t expected Chiyou to leave such a significant benefit after his demise.
"No wonder Chiyou was unwilling to teach me the War God Technique. No wonder he was immortal, claiming this was only his soul division."
Ding Ling understood.
With this Great Perfection Level War God Technique, Chiyou would truly find it hard to die.
Ding Ling’s War God Technique also reached Great Perfection Level, naturally aware of its prowess! But he currently still urgently needed energy for body refining.
So even though the War God Technique was perfected, it couldn’t guarantee immortality.
Just to say.
Even if his hand got cut off, as long as his energy was ample, it could promptly recover.
As for getting decapitated?
Ding Ling didn’t dare to try it now because his War God Technique was still evolving.
The Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill was yet to be cultivated to its utmost.
Let alone the War God Technique.
Insufficient energy was a big problem.
Even though it was at full level, post-full level, cultivation demanded a massive amount of energy.
Ding Ling merely skipped the long time others spent understanding and practicing the technique. He could directly absorb energy and continuously advance!
[True Power Value 32 points]
The energy produced by the War God Technique was refined by the Eternal Youth Technique, forming Longevity Qi.
It’s obvious.
The War God Technique’s energy leaned more towards the righteous path.
While the energy from the Demon Scripture belonged to the Demon Dao!

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 593: Soul Division Memory
paragraphs: It’s likely that Chiyou never imagined his own death would complete Ding Ling.
Not to mention Chiyou.
Even Ding Ling didn’t expect it.
The bookshelf in the library, combined with the Martial Arts Melting Furnace, actually has the function of assimilating others’ memories.
Not only did Ding Ling master the War God Technique,
he also gained a small part of Chiyou’s memory in a mysterious way.
This portion of the memory was fragmented.
The older the time, the blurrier it was.
The closer to the present, the clearer it was.
This also made Ding Ling aware of all of Chiyou’s motives.

The reason he scolded Ding Ling and stirred Ding Ling’s emotions was to seize the opportunity to enter Ding Ling’s heart, but unfortunately, the Vast Righteous Qi was too pure for him to penetrate and he had to seek another way.
That was to immediately strike a deal with Ding Ling.
Only because the closer it was to the ’coffin,’
the more powerful his Soul Division could be by leveraging the power of the ’main soul.’
If he strayed away from the main soul, the Soul Division would grow weaker, making it nearly impossible to achieve his goal of soul possession.
"Possession?!"
Ding Ling’s pupils involuntarily contracted when he saw this fragment of memory.
The technique of Chiyou for possession was actually quite simple.

Simply by forcing his millennia of memories into Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness, he would burst Ding Ling’s consciousness body, and then he could perfectly replace Ding Ling and become the master of this body!
Even if it didn’t burst, he could still become the leader with absolute superiority!
"As expected, with malicious intent!"
"Too bad, Chiyou could never imagine that I would have such an otherworldly cheat like the library."
Ding Ling pondered:
"Chiyou’s Soul Division is completely dead, without leaving a trace of thought, so the main soul likely doesn’t know what happened within my vessel?"
Ding Ling had a sense of this, but he wasn’t quite sure; regardless of the outcome, once he became the strongest in this realm, he would definitely return to annihilate Chiyou’s main soul!
"The progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace is becoming increasingly apparent."
Ding Ling sensed for a moment.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 56%]
It jumped by 5 percentage points.

The acquired Celestial Frost Fist, Tathagata Divine Palm, Demon Scripture, Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, Hero King Heart Method, War God Technique, Holy Spirit Swordsmanship, and so on were all top-tier techniques!
The War God Technique, Demon Scripture, and Tathagata Divine Palm were Void Shattering Level techniques of extremely high quality!
This resulted in just a small amount of secret manuals pushing up the progress by 5 percentage points.
The facts prove.
Quality is the king’s way!
As long as enough top-tier techniques are obtained, it’s not a problem for the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace to reach a hundred percent.
"It’s a pity that I didn’t obtain all of Chiyou’s techniques."

Ding Ling estimated that if the library had more bookshelves full of secret manuals, and the manifestation level of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace was higher, perhaps he could refine more of Chiyou’s memories.
Obtaining other techniques of Chiyou would naturally not be a problem.

"It seems this bookshelf needs to be filled with secret manuals to cooperate with the Martial Arts Melting Furnace and manifest peerless power. What a pity, this is a passive skill, and I cannot actively use it."

Only those like Chiyou who actively invade Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness and attempt to eradicate Ding Ling’s consciousness body could be countered by the passive skill of the library’s bookshelf and the furnace.
"But this passive skill also seems to be unsustainable."
Ding Ling felt that after using this passive skill once, the bookshelf of the library and the body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace faded considerably.
It shows that this passive skill is not without limits.
"Therefore, it’s better to be cautious and vigilant!"
With this in mind, Ding Ling opened his eyes, and what appeared before him were the large faces of Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann.
The unique male scent rushing towards him caused Ding Ling to halt his breathing instinctively and take a step back.
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann laughed awkwardly.
Nie Renwang spoke first:

"Young Hero Ding, it’s so strange. You’ve been muttering to yourself all along, not responding to us. We thought you were possessed, so we pulled you down from the sky, thinking of how to treat you, and unexpectedly, you just woke up."
"Yes."
Marshal Duann was equally puzzled:

"Young Hero Ding, with your extraordinary talent and supreme martial arts, the characteristics just now were extremely strange and frightening. No matter how we called, you didn’t wake. We had no choice but to bring you to the ground. However, this wasn’t the most unusual thing. What shocked Brother Nie and me the most was that your aura was constantly changing, becoming deeper, stronger, and more mysterious!
Later on,
there was actually a feeling of terror and horror, as if facing an abyss and the Heavenly Dao!
When he mentioned this,
he swallowed dryly and looked at Ding Ling nervously:
"Young Hero Ding, what exactly happened to you?!"
[Received an E-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated Marshal Duann,]
[Received an E-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated Nie Renwang]

[Note: Since you silently and effortlessly entered the Dragon Vein Space and mastered the Xuanyuan Divine Sword, both were both amazed and fearful of you. During the recent period, your aura was unpredictable, sometimes the Primordial Spirit gushed in to strengthen yourself, sometimes due to the Demon Scripture and War God Technique Full Level, generating peculiar Demon Qi and War God Qi. All of this left them shocked and incredulous!
They, for a moment, didn’t know if you were the heir of the demon or the inheritor of the god! So there is extreme tension! Trepidation!]
Hearing the prompt,
Ding Ling understood.

He glanced at Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang. These two had been cultivating arduously in this Spiritual Qi abundant Earth Realm for so many years, their cultivation entering the Grandmaster Realm, far surpassing Bu Jingyun.
Although Bu Jingyun had escaped the juvenile stage, he was clearly still in the growth phase. Nie Feng should be the same as Bu Jingyun.
Thinking of this,
Ding Ling said:
"Rest assured. I’m fine. I just had a sudden epiphany."
"Is that so?"
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann exchanged looks, finding it hard to imagine how someone could suddenly have an epiphany out of nowhere!
Moreover, it was an epiphany of two drastically terrifying energies!
That Demon Qi was so pure and deep that a mere glance seemed to make one lose oneself in it;
That War God Qi was so frightening and fierce it made one shiver just by sensing a bit!
This young lad Ding Ling,
though so young, has realized such energies.
It was terrifying!
With such thoughts, Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann exchanged glances and instantly understood each other.
Both simultaneously bowed respectfully to Ding Ling, solemnly saying:

"Young Hero Ding, your martial arts are supreme, and you are the Xuanyuan Sword Master; now, you’ve shown incredible abilities. We are willing to acknowledge you as master and follow your orders. But on the condition, you must stay in Lingyun Cave, protect the Dragon Vein, and safeguard all living beings! To let the people of Jiuzhou enjoy peace, preventing further descent into chaos.
Otherwise, if the Dragon Vein is lost, the Demon Dao will manifest, and Jiuzhou might sink into turmoil and flames. This is such a cruel and terrifying thing.
We implore Young Hero Ding to have mercy on the people of Jiuzhou. Please don’t refuse anymore."

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 594: Array Map Established
paragraphs: Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann were open and candid, speaking from the heart.
They treated Ding Ling with sincere loyalty.
Ding Ling was quite moved.
He greatly admired such selfless people, willing to sacrifice the small self for the greater good.
What a pity.
Currently, he wasn’t as great as they were.
Thus, Ding Ling refused without hesitation and said:
"I’m not suitable to stay and guard this place, I’m sorry."
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann wanted to persuade him further, but seeing Ding Ling’s resolute expression, they knew it would be useless, and they sighed with regret.
In Shenzhou Land, the place of the Dragon Vein, if there was someone as strong and talented as Ding Ling to protect it,
it would surpass them by an unknown number of times.
"Before leaving, I will lay down an array at the entrance and inside."
Ding Ling glanced at the two and said:

"I am proficient in Array Dao and can lay down the Eight Array Map left by Zhuge Kongming from the Three Kingdoms Era. This Eight Array Map, paired with the abundant Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi here, is a perfect match."
The Eight Array Map only had poor effects when deployed in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer and Divine Eagle World.
Only with the Celestial Might blessing of the Three Kingdoms World can it unleash godlike powers.
And this Lingyun Cave.
Is not to be underestimated.
If the Eight Array Map is set with the Dragon Vein as the center, its prowess would definitely not be inferior to that in the Three Kingdoms World.
Because Ding Ling had felt the Dragon Vein, the Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi within is extremely vast and magnificent, making it the center of the array perfectly, not weaker than Celestial Might!
"The Eight Array Map?"
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann exchanged glances, their eyes full of surprise:

"I didn’t expect Young Hero Ding to have inherited from Zhuge Kongming of the Three Kingdoms. It seems Young Hero Ding is exceptionally blessed, truly a favored son of heaven, a man of great Qi Fortune. In the ever-changing winds and clouds of this world’s future, we hope Young Hero Ding will always uphold the path of righteousness and protect Shenzhou from falling!"
"Rest assured."
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"I am also a citizen of Jiuzhou, naturally, I do not wish for Jiuzhou to shatter."
Even if he is a citizen of Jiuzhou from another world.
He still does not wish for this world to shatter.
After all, if later entrants ascend via the Celestial Ladder and fall into this world, among them could be his friends and family? Wouldn’t that be disastrous for them all?
This is not something Ding Ling wants to see.
"Thank you."
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann breathed a sigh of relief.
At the very least, Ding Ling was willing to protect Shenzhou, which was a fortunate matter for them.
Afterward.
Ding Ling entered the Dragon Vein area within Lingyun Cave and set up an Eight Array Map using the Dragon Vein as the eye of the array.
The moment the array was completed.
The winds and clouds of all directions surged, the mist billowed up, and the Killing Qi shot straight to the sky!
It seemed as if countless soldiers and armor were hidden within, gathering the mighty powers of the Eight Desolations!
A soul-stirring aura rushed forth.
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann’s breath caught, their faces flushed, both excited and joyful, they said in shock:
"This, this, this is?!"
"This is the Eight Array Map."
Ding Ling informed them of the Life Gate’s entrance and exit method and took them for a walk around the Eight Array Map.
The two entered the array and looked to the east, seeing the sand and stones constantly flying;
Looked to the west, seeing jagged rocks and Evil Qi forming swords;
Looked north, the sound of water roared, waves surged over a hundred feet, churning as if they could easily overturn great ships;
Looked south, mountains of earth linked one after another, seemingly endless to the eye;
Looked at the sky.
Dark clouds obscured sight, thunder and lightning densely interwoven;
Looked at the ground, Killing Qi crisscrossed, each step a perilous situation!
"What a powerful Eight Array Map!"
The two were shocked, admiringly looking towards Ding Ling, and with great ceremony said:
"Thank you, Young Hero Ding, for setting this array map. With this array map guarding the Dragon Vein, it’s as if we have an additional supreme expert protecting it! Truly a great blessing."
Ding Ling smiled slightly but did not speak.
The fact was as he expected.
The Dragon Vein is extraordinary, truly living up to being the gathering place of Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi, possessing incredible power! Not inferior to Celestial Might!
Only this place could harbor such an Eight Array Map.
Beyond here.
In the outside world, it’s impossible to lay such a heaven-shaking, earth-shattering Eight Array Map.
After all, the convergence of the Eight Array Map also requires the support of energy.
The Three Kingdoms World has Celestial Might; this world has the Dragon Vein.
Both are ingeniously similar, and according to this line of thinking, for Ding Ling to set arrays, he must possess a treasure no less than the Dragon Vein.
Moreover, the Dragon Vein concerns the lives and fates of Jiuzhou’s beings.
Ding Ling is unwilling to take it away.
His martial skill is extraordinary, along with the War God Technique, Demon Scripture, and Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture Basic Skill Full Level, he knows this Dragon Vein exceedingly well.
The surface and inner layers of this Dragon Vein are overflowing with Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi!
But in the deepest layer, it’s permeated with Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
This demonic Qi appears to come from the aura of Chiyou!

It’s a kind of mad blood demonic Qi from the same source as the Fire Qilin and Chiyou; if someone inhales this Qi, they would unwittingly become a mad demon, a truly irrational, only knowing slaughter individual.
And this Dragon Vein.
Is continuously absorbing and extracting this Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
This Mad Blood Demonic Qi comes from all directions.
Is the root in that coffin?
Or elsewhere?
Ding Ling also does not know.
But he knows one thing.
This Dragon Vein absolutely cannot be moved; otherwise, in the future, the world’s Mad Blood Demonic Qi is bound to grow increasingly turbulent and terrifying.
It’s said he moves this Dragon Vein.
It could loosen the coffin’s seal.
Thus, Chiyou might again split a soul? Or even the main soul could emerge?

"Currently, I do not have the confidence to decisively defeat Chiyou. Therefore, the Dragon Vein must guard this place, suppress Chiyou! When I am stronger, I’ll return to end Chiyou, and then there will naturally be no worries."
Ding Ling looked at Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann.
The two were still delighted by the Eight Array Map’s successful creation.
Profoundly grateful to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling thought for a moment and took the opportunity to propose an exchange of cultivation techniques.
To show sincerity.
Ding Ling taught the two the ’Sword God Breathing Technique.’
This Breathing Technique Ding Ling had taught to many people.

These two needed to stay and guard this place, protect the Dragon Vein, effectively helping to suppress Chiyou. Ding Ling now didn’t want to face Chiyou, nor did he want others to break into this place and take the Dragon Vein.
Therefore, enhancing the two’s combat abilities is very necessary.
With his Sword God Breathing Technique at Full Level, offering guidance was incisive and deeply insightful.
In a moment.
The two, in this environment of extremely rich Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi, managed to entry-level the Breathing Technique.
It can be seen their talent is high and indeed rare in the world.
But even having reached entry-level.
To achieve full level, the time required is counted by years. Ding Ling naturally did not have the patience to continue teaching.
The two also could not let Ding Ling continue teaching.
Yet, seeing Ding Ling transmit such a miraculous technique to them.
They were already respectful and admiring of Ding Ling, and coupled with the creation of the Eight Array Map, they were immensely grateful to Ding Ling.
Now having received a top-level secret technique.
They elevated their gratitude to a new level.
The two exchanged a glance, understanding each other’s intentions.
Immediately, Nie Renwang said:
"My Nie Family has inherited the secret technique Ice Heart Technique and Proud Cold Six Formulas. I can teach it to Young Hero Ding."
Marshal Duann then said:
"I can impart the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship and Duann’s Heart Method."

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 595: Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling relaxed internally, nodded with a smile:
"In that case, I will trouble the two of you."
"It’s our duty!"
Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang had great respect for Ding Ling.
Whether it was Ding Ling’s talent or his actions, both shocked and impressed them deeply.
Especially in his teaching of techniques and guidance, which surpassed even that of top professional masters by far!
Therefore.
The two did not dare to hold back.
First, Marshal Duann spoke in detail about the various esoteric truths and essence of the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship.

However, Ding Ling saw how he continued to speak, afraid it would take several hours, and by then more people would have entered the Lingyun Cave, and the opportunities like the Ten Strong Martial Dao might be lost to him.
Therefore.
Ding Ling decisively expressed that there was no need for explanation, only the technique and mantra were needed, and the moves should be practiced step by step.
Marshal Duann was somewhat puzzled as to why Ding Ling said this.
But still complied.
After he finished explaining and demonstrating once.
He asked if further explanation was needed.
Ding Ling shook his head indicating no.
He just slightly recalled.
Immediately, a new secret manual appeared on the library shelf.
Engraved with large characters, it was clearly the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship.
In an instant
[Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
It was clearly a top-notch sword technique, not at all inferior to the Celestial Frost Fist.
Especially since it was complete.
Much stronger than the incomplete Celestial Frost Fist.
If the Celestial Frost Fist was also complete, it could be compared with this Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship.
No wonder Duann Lang, practicing the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship alone, could later fight Bu Jingyun to a standstill, and even nearly defeat him in a tournament.
Without a teacher, Duann Lang was indeed gifted, but Bu Jingyun’s talent was absolutely top-notch too, and he had Xiong Ba teaching him; why did he nearly get defeated by Duann Lang?
Ultimately, the reason is that the Cloud-Pushing Palm is incomplete, while Duann Lang’s Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship is complete!
Practicing the incomplete technique inevitably has stagnations, unable to fully unleash its perfect might, while a complete technique is different.
"Continue."
Ding Ling asked Marshal Duann to speak about Duann’s Heart Method.
Marshal Duann was a bit confused:
"The Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship doesn’t need further explanation?"
In that instant just now.
He seemed to sense a powerful Sword Qi of the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship arise suddenly from Ding Ling’s body!
But this Sword Qi came swiftly and vanished even swifter.
Making Marshal Duann almost think it was an illusion, but upon hearing Ding Ling’s words, couldn’t help but ask:

"You can digest it yourself? There are quite a few difficult points in the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship. Without anyone explaining, fully understanding it would take years. I can patiently explain it to Young Hero Ding."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, not hiding it since this matter would be known sooner or later:
"I have already comprehended the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship. Please continue to impart Duann’s Heart Method to me."

Marshal Duann’s eyes widened in disbelief, though Ding Ling was indeed a favored child of heaven, equipped with great Qi Fortune, a figure of Xuanyuan Sword Master, he couldn’t openly question it, thus could only suppress his shock and puzzlement, continuing to speak about Duann’s Heart Method.
He spoke once through.
Ding Ling recalled, and the library immediately recorded it into a manual.
In an instant.
[Duann’s Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This is a heart method that can be cultivated to Grandmaster Level!
Though it doesn’t match up to War God Technique or other Shattering Level methods, it is still very remarkable.

It’s worth knowing that the techniques from worlds like The Smiling, Proud Wanderer or Divine Eagle are mostly First-class or Innate Level, a small part being Grandmaster Level, and very few reaching Grandmaster. Shattering Level techniques include only a rare few like Eternal Youth Technique, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
Whew!
With Duann’s Heart Method at Full Level, vast amounts of Spiritual Vitality from all directions came rushing in, engulfing Ding Ling.
However, in a flash.
Ding Ling activated Eternal Youth Technique to refine the Spiritual Vitality, adding a Longevity True Qi in his Dantian.
"It’s done?!"
Marshal Duann gasped!
This phenomenon just now.
Was clearly a celestial phenomenon that would erupt only when one’s Inner Power had achieved success!
Ding Ling simply listened to Duann’s Heart Method once, and directly cultivated it successfully!
"This, this, this..."
Marshal Duann was extremely shocked, finding it hard to believe:

"I’ve cultivated Duann’s Heart Method for decades, unable to reach Great Perfection, but just now the radiant aura that flashed over Young Hero Ding’s body was undoubtedly the hallmark of Great Perfection in Duann’s Heart Method. Young Hero Ding, you, you, you..."
He hesitated for a long time, finally gathering his thoughts, asked:
"Have you comprehended Duann’s Heart Method to the Perfect Realm?"
"Correct."
Marshal Duann was speechless, shaken, aghast, unable to believe, finding it hard to imagine:
"How is this possible?!"
Nie Renwang next to him was also stunned.
He and Marshal Duann were dear friends.
Naturally knowing the difficulty in cultivating the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship and Duann’s Heart Method.
Yet Ding Ling seemed to have reached the Perfect Realm in an instant! Such talent, what an astonishment? What an inconceivability!
Ding Ling turned to Nie Renwang.
Nie Renwang shivered slightly, hurried two steps forward, solemnly said:

"I shall first impart to Young Hero Ding the Ice Heart Technique, handed down by my family! Due to Mad Blood, my family must learn the Ice Heart Technique. This method is quite remarkable, created by my ancestor Nie Ying after studying the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts and based on a matchless scripture. It’s very unique, especially suitable for our Nie family. It’s a necessary practice for our Nie family members."
Without wasting words, after roughly explaining the origin of the Ice Heart Technique, he began to speak the mantra.
’When the heart is ice-clear, even if the sky falls, there is no fear, constant amidst changes, the spirit refreshed, Qi calm and still, self-forgetful guarding the one, six roots greatly settled...’
The mantra and esoteric truths of the Ice Heart Technique were not lengthy.
He soon finished speaking.
Ding Ling slightly recalled.
The next instant.
[Ice Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This was also a Grandmaster Level inner power heart method.
It can calm one’s mind, lessen demonic thoughts, making one’s heart without distractions, with thoughts ice-clear, thoroughly bright, the inner self as cool as snow, extremely composed!
Once achieving full level.
Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi surged in.
Eternal Youth Technique automatically ran to refine the Spiritual Vitality.
In just a moment.
Another Longevity True Qi appeared in the Dantian.
Combining with previous ones.
The three fused into one forming a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 33 points]
Ding Ling’s strength now had broken into the middle tier of Grandmaster Level.
Not far from the high tier either.
Whew!
Ding Ling stood satisfied, breathing a long sigh.
With the Ice Heart Technique at full level, Ding Ling will have a stronger defense for his heart in the future.
Because once the Ice Heart Technique reaches full level.
It will automatically operate at the heart, the Qi produced will condense into an icy gate protecting the heart.
This is what the full level Ice Heart Technique offers.
Without it being full level, it is absolutely impossible to reach this state.
Ding Ling looked at Nie Renwang, indicating for him to continue.
Nie Renwang was stunned, his entire being felt numb.
Though from the time Marshal Duann imparted Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship and Duann’s Heart Method, he sensed that Ding Ling’s talent was definitely earth-shaking, shocking even the ghostly gods.

This method is quite remarkable, created by my ancestor Nie Ying after studying the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts and based on a matchless scripture.
It’s very unique, especially suitable for our Nie family.
It’s a necessary practice for our Nie family members."
Without wasting words, after roughly explaining the origin of the Ice Heart Technique, he began to speak the mantra.
’When the heart is ice-clear, even if the sky falls, there is no fear, constant amidst changes, the spirit refreshed, Qi calm and still, self-forgetful guarding the one, six roots greatly settled...’
The mantra and esoteric truths of the Ice Heart Technique were not lengthy.
He soon finished speaking.
Ding Ling slightly recalled.
The next instant.
[Ice Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
This was also a Grandmaster Level inner power heart method.
It can calm one’s mind, lessen demonic thoughts, making one’s heart without distractions, with thoughts ice-clear, thoroughly bright, the inner self as cool as snow, extremely composed!
Once achieving full level.
Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi surged in.
Eternal Youth Technique automatically ran to refine the Spiritual Vitality.
In just a moment.
Another Longevity True Qi appeared in the Dantian.
Combining with previous ones.
The three fused into one forming a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 33 points]
Ding Ling’s strength now had broken into the middle tier of Grandmaster Level.
Not far from the high tier either.
Whew!
Ding Ling stood satisfied, breathing a long sigh.
With the Ice Heart Technique at full level, Ding Ling will have a stronger defense for his heart in the future.
Because once the Ice Heart Technique reaches full level.
It will automatically operate at the heart, the Qi produced will condense into an icy gate protecting the heart.
This is what the full level Ice Heart Technique offers.
Without it being full level, it is absolutely impossible to reach this state.
Ding Ling looked at Nie Renwang, indicating for him to continue.
Nie Renwang was stunned, his entire being felt numb.
Though from the time Marshal Duann imparted Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship and Duann’s Heart Method, he sensed that Ding Ling’s talent was definitely earth-shaking, shocking even the ghostly gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 596: Proud Cold Six Formulas
paragraphs: But when he truly touched and personally felt Ding Ling’s immense talent, Nie Renwang still found it somewhat hard to accept.
This is too powerful!
He had been cultivating the Ice Heart Technique for decades, and he was still a distance away from perfection, let alone the Great Perfection!
How did Ding Ling achieve Great Perfection in an instant?!
He was baffled, seeing Ding Ling as nothing short of a Celestial Being!
"Incredible."
Marshal Duann exclaimed repeatedly beside him:
"Unbelievable. Now I truly believe that Young Hero Ding learned the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship just by hearing and seeing it once."
"Indeed."
Nie Renwang was completely in awe:
"It’s simply unimaginable that such a genius like Young Hero Ding exists in the world!
It’s so unbelievable!"
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have won Marshal Duann’s high praise.]
[Medal also obtained: You have won Nie Renwang’s high praise.]
[Note: Your martial arts talent has completely captivated both of them.]
Previously, he had already earned two E-level medals from them.
Now, he earned two ordinary ones again.
It seemed that it was impossible to earn more medals from them.
Ding Ling understood and looked at Nie Renwang, indicating that they could continue.
Nie Renwang cleared his throat, his expression somewhat unnatural.
But he still kept his promise and began to speak of the Heart Method Mantra of the Proud Cold Six Formulas, while demonstrating the techniques methodically.
Knowing that Ding Ling’s talent was unparalleled and unmatched in this era!
Nie Renwang naturally wouldn’t waste time explaining any esoteric truths.
After he finished his demonstration.
Ding Ling only had to recall it slightly.
As a Secret Manual of "Proud Cold Six Formulas" appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Proud Cold Six Formulas Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
This was a superior saber technique stronger than the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship!
It was a top-tier saber technique that reached the Grandmaster Peak Level!
After reaching full level in an instant.
A uniquely strong Proud Cold Blade Intent naturally emanated from Ding Ling’s body!
This blade intent surged and contracted automatically with Ding Ling’s every breath.
Just for a moment, it was internalized by Ding Ling.
But even so.
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann saw it clearly and couldn’t help but be amazed:
"Too strong."
Nie Renwang further said:

"I had been cultivating the Proud Cold Six Formulas for decades and couldn’t comprehend the final move, Ice Blade Ice Heart, nor could I perfect the fifth move, Stepping on Snow to Seek Plum. Yet Ding Ling achieved Great Perfection in all six moves in an instant. It feels like a dream. Completely unimaginable."
Ding Ling deeply felt the sheer strength of the Proud Cold Six Formulas.
If combined with the War God Technique and the Ice Heart Technique, it would definitely unleash unimaginable power.

Now unexpectedly obtaining the Ice Heart Technique and the Proud Cold Six Formulas from Nie Renwang, Ding Ling was somewhat surprised because he knew that Nie Renwang’s saber techniques were all incomplete. He asked Nie Renwang, and Nie Renwang said:

"In the Lingyun Cave, there’s the remains of my ancestor Nie Ying, who etched the complete Proud Cold Six Formulas near his bones before his death. I saw it by chance, so I knew all the secrets and the entire book of the Proud Cold Six Formulas. And to prevent outsiders from learning the Proud Cold Six Formulas, I slightly modified the one beside the remains and erased the final move.
Even if outsiders found the ancestor’s remains and saw the Secret Manual of the Proud Cold Six Formulas, they would definitely not learn our real Proud Cold Six Formulas!"
Ding Ling was speechless.
Earlier, he was preparing to find Nie Ying’s remains to learn the Proud Cold Six Formulas.
Now it seemed, fortunately, he encountered Nie Renwang here and made an exchange with him.
Otherwise, he would likely have no chance to learn the Proud Cold Six Formulas.
The Proud Cold Six Formulas, combined with the Ice Heart Technique and the War God Technique, could entirely become a Shattering Level saber skill!
With this saber skill at full level and with a suitable saber.
The enhancement to Ding Ling’s attack power would be evident to the naked eye.
Ding Ling looked at the saber in Nie Renwang’s hand:
"This saber?"
"This is the Nie Family’s ancestral Treasure Saber, the Snow-Drinking Saber!"
"Snow-Drinking Saber."
Ding Ling thought of the scenes where Nie Feng ventured deep into Lingyun Cave and serendipitously obtained the Snow-Drinking Saber.
Then he realized.
It must have been Nie Renwang who, discovering the injured Nie Feng, secretly gifted him the Snow-Drinking Saber and guided him to find the Blood Bodhi and the Proud Cold Six Formulas.
Who knows, the Proud Cold Six Formulas Nie Feng saw back then might have been altered again by Nie Renwang.
Why would Ding Ling think so?
It was obvious.
Nie Renwang was now holding the Snow-Drinking Saber! If he hadn’t personally given it away, who could snatch the Snow-Drinking Saber from him?
He must have felt guilty towards Nie Feng, hence the initiative to provide resources and opportunities to Nie Feng.
But he also had to guard the Dragon Vein, so it was naturally inconvenient to meet Nie Feng, and he could only support him secretly.
He looked at the sword in Marshal Duann’s hand.
"This is the Fire Qilin Sword."
Marshal Duann volunteered:

"It is also my family’s heirloom Treasure Sword. However, this Fire Qilin Sword has an excessively demonic nature and evil nature. If one’s heart isn’t just, they can easily be tainted and eroded by its demonic nature, eventually becoming a demonic figure."
Indeed...
Ding Ling came to terms.
He had wondered how things could be so coincidental.
That Duann Lang happened to find the Fire Qilin Sword when he entered Lingyun Cave.
And Nie Feng also found so many opportunities coincidentally.
Turns out, the two of them were secretly giving them!
He gestured to Marshal Duann to let him see the Fire Qilin Sword.
Marshal Duann did not hesitate and immediately presented it to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling took it and felt it carefully.
Just as expected.
The blade inside the Fire Qilin Sword contained an astonishing amount of Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
This Demonic Qi was exactly like the one on the Fire Qilin.
Even a righteous person like Nie Feng would become unrecognizable under the influence of Mad Blood.
Duann Lang becoming increasingly ruthless later on was certainly related to the Mad Blood demonic nature in the Fire Qilin Sword, and he might have been tainted.
Ding Ling inquired Marshal Duann about his view on Duann Lang.
Marshal Duann sighed:

"Over the years, Brother Nie and I would occasionally disguise ourselves to go out and buy some food. We also learned about the current situation of my son and brother Nie’s son. I firmly believe that the Duann Family produces brave talents full of righteousness! My son Lang must be a good person!"
"My son must also be a good person."
Nie Renwang said confidently:
"Feng and Lang grew up as brothers, supporting each other, and I believe no difficulty can defeat them."
Ding Ling was speechless.
He wondered why Marshal Duann, knowing the evil nature of the Fire Qilin Sword, would still give it to Duann Lang.
Turns out he believed firmly that Duann Lang wouldn’t be affected.
What a pity.
Duann Lang faced too many setbacks and unfair treatments, and Marshal Duann thought setbacks could hone a person, not realizing that too many setbacks could also overwhelm a person.

Duann Lang was indeed more determined the more he was defeated in the early stages, but unfortunately, Duann Lang was too unlucky, as misfortunes kept finding him. Even Youruo took him as a substitute for Nie Feng, which completely destabilized his mentality, and under the influence of the Fire Qilin Sword, he was gradually invaded by the evil, becoming increasingly ruthless and errant.
Of course.
This hadn’t happened yet, and Ding Ling didn’t mention it to Marshal Duann.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 597: Refining Demons
paragraphs: Ding Ling simply utilized the Demon Scripture, boom!
The Fire Qilin Sword began to struggle violently.
But it was useless.
The Full Level Demon Scripture possesses the ability to devour and refine the Mad Blood Demonic Nature!

Although the power of the Mad Blood Demonic Nature is extremely strong, it meets its absolute nemesis in the Full Level Demon Scripture, and in the blink of an eye, its entire nature is refined away by the Demon Scripture.
[Inner Power Value +90]
The refined demonic qi automatically transformed into a pure Demonic True Qi, revolving endlessly around the Demon Path True Water.
"I did not expect that a mere Fire Qilin Sword could contain such abundant demonic qi."
’No wonder Duann Lang was influenced.’
Ding Ling came to terms with it.
Needless to say.
This Fire Qilin Sword must have absorbed the endless Mad Blood Demonic Qi of this realm over the years, becoming increasingly evil.
In the hands of someone as selfless and righteous as Marshal Duann, it naturally achieves little.
But in the hands of someone with flaws in their heart, this flaw would be magnified infinitely, ultimately destroying the person.
And now, Ding Ling’s Demon Scripture.
Can completely eliminate the madness from the Mad Blood Demonic Qi, leaving only the pure essence of Demonic True Qi.
This Demonic True Qi is naturally useful to Ding Ling, enhancing his strength.
"The Demon Scripture is indeed extraordinary. It is the nemesis of the Mad Blood Demon Dao. How did Chiyou fall into madness then?"
Ding Ling contemplated:
"I’m guessing Chiyou was corrupted and eroded by the Mad Blood Demonic Qi before the Demon Scripture reached Full Level."
Only the Full Level Demon Scripture has the ability to refine the Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
Even the Perfection Level Demon Scripture, when refining too much Mad Blood Demonic Qi, will still succumb to madness and pollution!
Only at Full Level, or Great Perfection, can such calamity be avoided.

Ding Ling didn’t know exactly how Chiyou was polluted by the Mad Blood Demonic Qi, but he knew one thing, that he had no fear of this Mad Blood Demonic Qi and could devour the blood of divine beasts in this world unscrupulously.
"As expected, the divine beasts in this world must be maddened! Their blood is all Mad Blood!"
Emperor Shitian seems completely normal, but in fact is somewhat deranged.
Whether Xiaao Sanxiaao is mad or not, it’s uncertain? But Xiaao Sanxiaao must have been influenced, too.
It’s just that perhaps the divine beast’s blood they devoured was from long ago, when the creatures had less Mad Blood demonic nature.
But even so, over time, these two would inevitably be polluted and eroded by the Mad Blood demonic nature unconsciously.
"It’s terrifying to think about. I hope it’s not as I imagined."
Ding Ling took a long breath and returned the Fire Qilin Sword to Marshal Duann.
Marshal Duann took it. Feeling something was off, he carefully sensed it and showed an astonished expression:
"This, this, this sword?!
"Gone are the evil and demonic nature?! Only pure divinity remains!!"
Nie Renwang also understood, moved, and glanced sideways:
"I didn’t expect Young Hero Ding could disintegrate such terrifying Mad Blood Demonic Qi?!"
He was overjoyed and excited:
"I wonder if you could disintegrate the Mad Blood of my Nie Clan?"
"I can try it."
Ding Ling told him to extend his hand.
Nie Renwang eagerly extended his hand.
Ding Ling grabbed Nie Renwang’s hand and carefully sensed it.
Sure enough.
His bloodline had already been thoroughly polluted by this Mad Blood demonic nature.
The difficulty in separating this Mad Blood demonic nature was comparable to reaching the heavens.
Yet the Full Level Demon Scripture was even harder than reaching the heavens!
Therefore, the Full Level Demon Scripture could perfectly disintegrate this Mad Blood demonic nature.
Ding Ling directly employed the Demon Scripture.
Boom!
Strains of pure Evil Demon Blood Qi were instantly separated and extracted from Nie Renwang’s blood, so fast that Nie Renwang couldn’t help but let out a cry of pain.
Ding Ling could only slow down.
After extracting for a moment.
A strain of Mad Blood Evil Demon Qi was extracted.
Then refined by Ding Ling’s Demon Scripture.
The Demon Scripture was like a grinding disc, easily crushing, absorbing, and refining any wicked demonic qi into pure Demonic True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +10]
Ding Ling continued extracting this Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
The quantity was unexpectedly large.
After extracting 120 points of Inner Power Value.
Nie Renwang’s overall power visibly dropped by almost one-tenth.
Ding Ling paused, asking if he should continue.
Nie Renwang grit his teeth and said to continue.
Ding Ling then continued.
Finally.
[Inner Power Value +230]
In the dantian, two strands of pure Demonic True Qi appeared.
Combined with the previous Demonic True Qi, they coalesced into a drop of Demon Path True Water.
[True Power Value: 34 points]
Strength increased once again.

The Demon Scripture’s capacity for crushing Mad Blood Demonic Qi also improved, not only speeding up the refining process but also enhancing the power, tolerance, and other degrees of devouring the Mad Blood Demonic Qi significantly.
The Demon Scripture is akin to the North Nether Divine Skill, able to devour demonic qi to upgrade its extraordinary wicked skill!
It would seem the original intention for Chiyou’s creation of this cultivation technique was indeed to eliminate the world’s Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
Unfortunately, he himself succumbed to the demon path.
"How do you feel?"
Marshal Duann, seeing Nie Renwang’s pale face, showed some concern.
"I feel incredibly good."
Nie Renwang laughed heartily twice:
"It’s like shedding a heavy burden and torment of the heart. From now on, I can advance fearlessly without worrying about going into insanity."
He looked gratefully at Ding Ling, about to kneel in thanks.
Ding Ling waved his hand, a wall formed by Vigorous Qi blocking his kneel:
"Alright, let’s skip the formalities."
He glanced at the Snow-Drinking Saber in Nie Renwang’s hand:
"If you really want to thank me, exchange weapons with me."
"Young Hero Ding can take the Snow-Drinking Saber if he wishes."
Nie Renwang, without much thought, directly untied the Snow-Drinking Saber from his waist and sincerely pushed it towards Ding Ling:
"Young Hero Ding, please accept this Snow-Drinking Saber."
Ding Ling coughed dryly, did not hesitate, took the Snow-Drinking Saber, and handed over the Hero King Sword along with nine Fire Qilin scales.
These scales of the Fire Qilin had absorbed all the demonic and evil nature through Ding Ling’s Demon Scripture, leaving only a trace of divinity within.
"This is for the exchange."
He said:

"To be honest, I do really like this Snow-Drinking Saber, chiefly because it is constructed from one of the four Great Divine Stones of heaven and earth, and this stone’s origins are quite remarkable—it is Bai Lu, the leftover of Nuwa repairing the heavens. I am exchanging these with you, thinking I come out ahead, so don’t refuse."
"Then... alright."

Nie Renwang initially did not want it, but with Ding Ling’s insistence, he could only accept it. He naturally knew the Hero King Sword and the Fire Qilin scales, and he exclaimed inwardly, questioning the source of Ding Ling’s Fire Qilin scales.
Ding Ling casually explained a couple of sentences, saying in the future he might use these scales to forge a new Fire Qilin Saber for him.
After exchanging thoughts for a while.
To ensure both of their battle capabilities, Ding Ling even wrote down the essentials of the Sword God Breathing Technique on paper and gifted it to them for reference later.
After all, Ding Ling did not want Chiyou to emerge, and it depended on these two to guard this place.

The Demon Scripture’s capacity for crushing Mad Blood Demonic Qi also improved, not only speeding up the refining process but also enhancing the power, tolerance, and other degrees of devouring the Mad Blood Demonic Qi significantly.
The Demon Scripture is akin to the North Nether Divine Skill, able to devour demonic qi to upgrade its extraordinary wicked skill!
It would seem the original intention for Chiyou’s creation of this cultivation technique was indeed to eliminate the world’s Mad Blood Demonic Qi.
Unfortunately, he himself succumbed to the demon path.
"How do you feel?"
Marshal Duann, seeing Nie Renwang’s pale face, showed some concern.
"I feel incredibly good."
Nie Renwang laughed heartily twice:
"It’s like shedding a heavy burden and torment of the heart.
From now on, I can advance fearlessly without worrying about going into insanity."
He looked gratefully at Ding Ling, about to kneel in thanks.
Ding Ling waved his hand, a wall formed by Vigorous Qi blocking his kneel:
"Alright, let’s skip the formalities."
He glanced at the Snow-Drinking Saber in Nie Renwang’s hand:
"If you really want to thank me, exchange weapons with me."
"Young Hero Ding can take the Snow-Drinking Saber if he wishes."
Nie Renwang, without much thought, directly untied the Snow-Drinking Saber from his waist and sincerely pushed it towards Ding Ling:
"Young Hero Ding, please accept this Snow-Drinking Saber."
Ding Ling coughed dryly, did not hesitate, took the Snow-Drinking Saber, and handed over the Hero King Sword along with nine Fire Qilin scales.
These scales of the Fire Qilin had absorbed all the demonic and evil nature through Ding Ling’s Demon Scripture, leaving only a trace of divinity within.
"This is for the exchange."
He said:

"To be honest, I do really like this Snow-Drinking Saber, chiefly because it is constructed from one of the four Great Divine Stones of heaven and earth, and this stone’s origins are quite remarkable—it is Bai Lu, the leftover of Nuwa repairing the heavens.
I am exchanging these with you, thinking I come out ahead, so don’t refuse."
"Then... alright."
Nie Renwang initially did not want it, but with Ding Ling’s insistence, he could only accept it.
He naturally knew the Hero King Sword and the Fire Qilin scales, and he exclaimed inwardly, questioning the source of Ding Ling’s Fire Qilin scales.
Ding Ling casually explained a couple of sentences, saying in the future he might use these scales to forge a new Fire Qilin Saber for him.
After exchanging thoughts for a while.
To ensure both of their battle capabilities, Ding Ling even wrote down the essentials of the Sword God Breathing Technique on paper and gifted it to them for reference later.
After all, Ding Ling did not want Chiyou to emerge, and it depended on these two to guard this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 598: Nie Feng
paragraphs: Ding Ling bid farewell to Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann.
He carried the Snow-Drinking Saber and the Xuanyuan Sword.
As he walked, the Soaring in the Void technique activated automatically, and with the sound of the wind, he swiftly covered hundreds of meters like a breeze.
He had obtained a complete map of the entire Lingyun Cave.
The map came from Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann.
They had stayed here for so long.
They were as familiar with Lingyun Cave as with their own backyard, knowing where the opportunities lay.
Naturally, Ding Ling also knew the location of the Blood Bodhi.
As for the Ten Strong Martial Dao?

The two really didn’t know that the Lingyun Cave contained the Ten Strong Martial Dao. It was evident that the Ten Strong Martial Dao was hidden very secretively, as they hadn’t discovered it despite being here for so long!
This shows just how strong Nie Feng’s qi fortune as the son of a plane truly is!
It was precisely because he had a son.
Nie Renwang was very warm towards Ding Ling, hoping that Ding Ling could help Nie Feng rid his bloodline of evil and demon nature!
Ding Ling accepted their benefits.

Moreover, he greatly admired people like Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann, who sacrificed personal interests for the greater good, and since the location of the Dragon Vein also needed the two to guard it, he naturally agreed to help.
As for when to resolve this matter?
Naturally, it’s when he met Nie Feng again.
Swoosh swoosh!
Ding Ling moved at a fast pace.
Following the map step by step.
He twisted and turned.
Walking an unknown distance, he finally arrived at his destination.
"It’s just ahead."
Ding Ling glanced at the map, confirmed it was correct, and looked ahead.
Sure enough.
Ahead was a dead end.
At the end, a flickering dark red light was glowing intermittently.
Ding Ling quickened his pace and walked over.
He saw a person constantly putting small reddish fruits into a bag.
The fruit was small, about the size of a thumb, but it exuded astonishing spiritual vitality, and the outpouring primordial spirit even caused slight disturbances in the Void World where it resided.
As this person ate and packed, it seemed he would soon finish picking all of them, but with a quick thrust, Ding Ling accelerated beside him, waved his hand, and with a crackling sound!
The remaining fruits were all caught by Ding Ling as if swept up like fallen leaves in autumn.
Just now.

He used the Dragon Capturing Skill, Crane Controlling Art, and Swallow Gathering Skill, three long-range grasping techniques, with a tenfold amplification of a Grandmaster’s skill and speed, to easily pick these fruits.
"Who?!"

The person filling the bag with fruits was a young man appearing around twenty years old. Seeing the fruits suddenly disappear, he was shocked and quickly turned his head to see Ding Ling, instinctively stepping back two paces with a vigilant look, saying:
"Who are you?"
"And who are you?"
Ding Ling saw this man, towering at eight feet, with a handsome appearance giving a friendly gentleman-like feeling, and noticed he bore a resemblance to Nie Renwang, sparking a thought in his mind:
"Are you Nie Feng?"
"Huh."
The man was even more surprised:
"I don’t think I’ve seen you before, how do you know my name?"
But quickly, he realized:
"I know, did you see me when I was fighting for the World Association? Unfortunately, I do not recognize you."
He thought of Ding Ling’s technique and speed just now, feeling moved and giving him a sidelong glance:
"Judging by your age, you and I are similar. Which school or sect do you belong to, and how can you have such impressive skills?"
"So, it really is you."
Ding Ling was somewhat surprised.
Nie Feng, the son of qi fortune.
To meet him now.
The previous No-Crying Death God, Bu Jingyun, was wildly arrogant and reached the sky, although later matured to be responsible, clearly, Bu Jingyun was still immature at this time.
In comparison, Nie Feng was a gentle and sincere gentleman from a young age, treating people sincerely and kindheartedly.
Ding Ling admired people like Nie Feng more.
Thus, after confirming it was Nie Feng, he directly took out the Snow-Drinking Saber and said:
"Recognize this blade?"
"This is..."
Nie Feng found the knife very familiar but couldn’t quite be sure.
Ding Ling spoke directly:
"Your father’s Snow-Drinking Saber."
"My father."
Nie Feng was elated, rushing towards Ding Ling, eyes full of eagerness and expectation, looking at Ding Ling:
"You’ve seen my father."
His lips were trembling, showing the waves of emotions in his heart.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling understood Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang’s good intentions, knowing they didn’t want the Dragon Vein secret to leak out.
After all, the fewer people who knew about this, the better.
Besides, they hid deep within Lingyun Cave and couldn’t communicate with the outside world for long periods, naturally hoping that Nie Feng and Duann Lang would grow up naturally.

However, Ding Ling felt that even if Nie Feng knew about Nie Renwang’s existence, it would be fine, as Nie Feng was very upright and righteous. Knowing what his father was doing, he would certainly be proud and cooperate with him.
"Where is my father?"

Originally, due to Mingyue’s death and Kong Ci’s sorrow, Nie Feng was deeply pained, drowning his sorrows in alcohol until he learned from the Alien that there were people in the world capable of reviving the dead. He reawakened and, after much ado, arrived at Lingyun Cave, inadvertently discovering his ancestral Proud Cold Six Formulas and the Blood Bodhi.
His power greatly increased!
Realizing the extraordinary nature of the Blood Bodhi, he took out a bag to gather them all, not wanting such treasures to fall into evil hands, given the mix of good and bad in Lingyun Cave.
Unexpectedly, a young man who knew his father appeared!
’You want to see your father, fine. Let me finish my business, and I’ll take you there.’
Ding Ling looked at the Blood Bodhi in his hand.
About thirteen left.
The rest had been picked by Nie Feng.
Nie Feng, looking slightly embarrassed, raised the bag in his hand and said:
"If you can take me to my father, this bag of Blood Bodhi is yours."
"Alright."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, directly swallowing one Blood Bodhi.
Once it reached his stomach.
Ding Ling sensed the peculiar medicinal strength and realized:
This Blood Bodhi could increase about twenty years of pure Inner Strength per fruit.
Truly remarkable!
Equivalent to creating a peak second-class martial artist with just one fruit!
Moreover, with extremely pure power.
However, Ding Ling didn’t use it to increase his Inner Power Value.
Instead, he used it to supplement the spiritual vitality and primordial qi needed for Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill and War God Technique.
The energy required for these two Divine Skills was vast.
And the primordial spirit in each Blood Bodhi surpassed even five or six hundred-year Great Medicine, with formidable power!
Perfectly suited for these two Divine Skills.
The previous enhancement of the War God Technique.
And the enhancement of Proud Cold Six Formulas, among others.
Had left Ding Ling feeling incredibly hungry.
After consuming three to five Blood Bodhi.
This hunger was immediately relieved.
Seven were consumed.
The hunger disappeared entirely, and his physical qualities began to increase again.
[Strength +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
[Defense +0.3]
Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill once again entered a rapid growth phase.
