chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 599: Blood Bodhi
paragraphs: The two divine forms, Dragon Form and Elephant Form, after devouring the massive Spiritual Vitality from the Blood Bodhi, also began to constantly refine themselves, becoming more and more real.
He consumed all the Blood Bodhi in one go.
The final result:
[Strength +1.1]
[Constitution +1.1]
[Defense +1.1]
If it weren’t for the earlier surge in physical fitness due to the War God Technique reaching full level, causing an urgent need for energy in the body.
This time, the increase in strength wouldn’t be this much.
But to be able to increase this much.
Ding Ling was satisfied.
An increase of 1.1 points is already quite impressive.
He glanced at his Character Panel:
[Bone 6, Wisdom 7.5, Strength 109.8, Agility 83.7, Constitution 109.8, Defense 108.1, Charm 13. True Power Value: 34 points]
The attribute points of Strength, Constitution, and Defense increased rapidly.
About to break through again.
This breakthrough.
Ding Ling had a feeling.
The two divine forms, Dragon Form and Elephant Form, would definitely undergo subtle changes.
He glanced at Nie Feng.
Nie Feng was also looking at Ding Ling, his eyes full of astonishment:
"You ate that much? No problems?"
"What’s the problem?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Didn’t you eat a lot too?"
"I actually only ate four or five pieces."
Nie Feng laughed awkwardly:
"I didn’t eat much. You saw me picking and eating just once, but didn’t see the many times I didn’t eat earlier."
Ding Ling didn’t comment, glanced around, and casually asked:
"Have you seen the Ten Strong Martial Dao?"
"No."
Nie Feng was puzzled:
"What kind of martial arts is the Ten Strong Martial Dao? Is it buried here in Lingyun Cave?"
"I hope you can find this martial art well, once you find it, I’ll take you to see your father immediately."
Ding Ling took out a scale of the Fire Qilin and gave it to Nie Feng:
"Keep this well. I have some matters to attend to first, I’ll come back to find you later. Remember. First help find the Ten Strong Martial Dao. As long as you find it, I won’t go back on my word."
Nie Feng’s Qi fortune was extremely thick.
He could find the Ten Strong Martial Dao, which others couldn’t, showing his incredible luck.
Ding Ling walked all the way, turning corners, occasionally probing the stone walls and cave walls of Lingyun Cave, but unfortunately, he never found where the Ten Strong Martial Dao was.
It seemed the Ten Strong Martial Dao must be well hidden, difficult to find with ordinary methods, so they could only hope for the lucky Nie Feng.
"You must give some hints."
Nie Feng was a bit bewildered:
"Otherwise, how to find it?"
Ding Ling then described some features of where the Ten Strong Martial Dao might be and let him figure it out himself.
Once he finished,

Ding Ling performed the Lightweight Skill of the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, stepping on a dragon-shaped Vigorous Qi, his body seemed like a lightning bolt, disappearing instantly from where he stood.
"Hey, hey. Brother, you haven’t told me your name yet!"
"Ding Ling!"
Two words floated over from afar.
Nie Feng pondered:
"This name sounds so familiar, I feel like I’ve heard it somewhere before?"
Suddenly, he remembered:
"Isn’t this the number one person among the aliens as spoken of by the aliens, ascending from the lower realm, the Emperor of the Great Ming? Didn’t expect to meet him here!"
Nie Feng was moved:
"This Emperor of the Great Ming looks younger, more handsome, and more overbearing than I imagined!"
But soon.
He thought of his father again, feeling excited, clutching the scale in his hand, glanced around, and walked in a determined direction:
"The priority is to try and find this Ten Strong Martial Dao that Ding Ling mentioned."
Ding Ling followed the map.
Returned once again to the Fire Qilin’s residence.
Saw the Divine General and Ice Emperor waiting nearby the lava.
The two were clearly impatient and restless from waiting.
The Ice Emperor’s voice was loud and full of fury:
"Is this guy made of fire? He’s been down there for so long! And he still hasn’t come up? Divine General, you better listen to me, go down and take a look."
The Divine General was unwilling:
"It’s been several hours. He’s been down so long, seems like this guy is indeed extraordinarily talented. If I go down and accidentally fall into his trap, wouldn’t that be bad?"
"How is that possible!"
The Ice Emperor was enraged:

"I went down to check. Below is scorching and corrosive, endlessly. That young man is strong, but much weaker than the two of us together. Even if we join forces, we can’t do anything about this lava pool. How could that young man set traps in this lava pool?
Divine General, you’re just shirking responsibility!"
"Hehe."
The Divine General sneered:

"What responsibility do I have? Ice Emperor, you started all this. If it wasn’t for fear of that young man’s revenge later, I wouldn’t stay here waiting with you! Now you even start to slander me. Alright. If you’ve got the guts, you go down first, and I’ll follow right after!"
Ice Emperor stopped talking.
He had gone down the lava pool three times.
Each time, he couldn’t endure and was forced to leap back to the shore.
He couldn’t imagine how Ding Ling stayed so long in the lava pool, it was terrifying.
"After this long, even a steel divine weapon would melt into water."
The Divine General pondered, contemplating:
"Could that guy have encountered some crisis inside, and was then crushed and melted by the power of nature?!"
"It’s quite possible."
The Ice Emperor’s eyes brightened with joy, but his peripheral vision suddenly caught a familiar figure, and he abruptly turned his head, meeting Ding Ling’s eyes, who was coming like the wind.
"Ah!"
The Ice Emperor was initially stunned, then shouted in disbelief:
"Divine General! That guy is there!"
He pointed towards where Ding Ling was.
The Divine General turned, saw Ding Ling clearly, and was equally incredulous:
"How is this possible?! How could he appear at the entrance of the cave?! Could I have been wrong all along? Didn’t he enter the lava pool at all? But how could that be?
This place is fully visible! Besides this lava pool where one can hide, where else could he be hiding?"
The Divine General was truly puzzled, and couldn’t help but shout loudly:

"Young man, where on earth did you go? Why did you leave and then come back? What, are you simply here to have a chat with us? To negotiate peace? Or to kill us? Haha, after several hours have passed, do you really have the absolute confidence to defeat us?"
The more he spoke.
The more the Divine General was confused.
He only felt his heart tied in knots.
But Ding Ling didn’t answer, suddenly extracting the Snow-Drinking Saber from his back, slashing fiercely towards the Ice Emperor and Divine General.
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Ice Blade Ice Heart!
Even a lion uses its full force to catch a rabbit.
Ding Ling’s first move was the most powerful ultimate technique of the Proud Cold Six Formulas, combining the power of the Ice Heart Technique, Dragon Form, and Elephant Form.
With the Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification.
As soon as it was slashed.
Rumble!
A saber eighty meters long appeared instantly in the void.
This saber was as if it had substance, one side of the blade engraved with a lifelike Divine Dragon;
The other side engraved with a Thunder Elephant covered in lightning!
Clearly, the power of the divine forms was perfectly infused by Ding Ling into this sword technique.
Combined with the Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification.

The Divine General pondered, contemplating:
"Could that guy have encountered some crisis inside, and was then crushed and melted by the power of nature?!"
"It’s quite possible."
The Ice Emperor’s eyes brightened with joy, but his peripheral vision suddenly caught a familiar figure, and he abruptly turned his head, meeting Ding Ling’s eyes, who was coming like the wind.
"Ah!"
The Ice Emperor was initially stunned, then shouted in disbelief:
"Divine General!
That guy is there!"
He pointed towards where Ding Ling was.
The Divine General turned, saw Ding Ling clearly, and was equally incredulous:
"How is this possible?!
How could he appear at the entrance of the cave?!
Could I have been wrong all along?
Didn’t he enter the lava pool at all?
But how could that be?
This place is fully visible!
Besides this lava pool where one can hide, where else could he be hiding?"
The Divine General was truly puzzled, and couldn’t help but shout loudly:
"Young man, where on earth did you go?
Why did you leave and then come back?
What, are you simply here to have a chat with us?
To negotiate peace?
Or to kill us?
Haha, after several hours have passed, do you really have the absolute confidence to defeat us?"
The more he spoke.
The more the Divine General was confused.
He only felt his heart tied in knots.
But Ding Ling didn’t answer, suddenly extracting the Snow-Drinking Saber from his back, slashing fiercely towards the Ice Emperor and Divine General.
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Ice Blade Ice Heart!
Even a lion uses its full force to catch a rabbit.
Ding Ling’s first move was the most powerful ultimate technique of the Proud Cold Six Formulas, combining the power of the Ice Heart Technique, Dragon Form, and Elephant Form.
With the Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification.
As soon as it was slashed.
Rumble!
A saber eighty meters long appeared instantly in the void.
This saber was as if it had substance, one side of the blade engraved with a lifelike Divine Dragon;
The other side engraved with a Thunder Elephant covered in lightning!
Clearly, the power of the divine forms was perfectly infused by Ding Ling into this sword technique.
Combined with the Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 600: The 80-Meter Saber
paragraphs: This move could be said to instantly elevate the power twentyfold!
Far surpassing the original energy of Ice Blade Ice Heart.
Divine Form Tenfold Amplification;
Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification!
Under the twentyfold amplification!
The power of this move is nothing short of earth-shattering!
Once slashed out, an eighty-meter saber light manifested in the void, booming as it crashed towards the head of the Divine General and Ice Emperor!
The captivating Sword Qi, like the Proud Cold Blade Intent capable of freezing the world, rushed forth.

Ice Emperor and Divine General gasped, stunned by the overbearing aura, fierce strength, and absolute coldness of this sword, and found it incredible how Ding Ling had become so strong in just a few short hours!
They even thought Ding Ling was likely melted in the magma pool, now realizing it was all in their imagination!
"Ah!"

After all, Ice Emperor and Divine General were peerless masters. Seeing the unstoppable eighty-meter saber light pressing down, the two of them simultaneously revealed their might, shouting angrily, unleashing their full power, and their martial arts moves followed one after another towards the saber light.
Snow Blood Claw!

Ice Emperor’s ten fingers spread out angrily, crazily dancing Ice Storms towards the saber light’s position, storms condensed into a tornado shape, carrying frost and blood claws, sweeping forward with a roar!
Fire Thunder Gang Qi!
World-Ending Demon Body!

From Divine General’s ten fingers shot out one after another of lightning flames, the speed akin to thunder, instantly dozens of Gang Qi condensed into huge thunder fire, resembling a torch-like thunderstorm, rushing forward with the Snow Blood Claw Ice Storm.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
Three energy storms collided in the blink of an eye, and visibly, the eighty-meter long saber heavily cut into the thunderfire and ice storm!
On the saber surface, Dragon Form and Elephant Form continuously roar and shout, making the saber seem to breathe, its power relentlessly exploding.
From the initial balance to overwhelming the storm!
Only occurred in an instant.
Less than a breath’s time.
The eighty-meter saber light, with a rumbling sound, crack! Forcefully sliced through the two storms, slashing towards the faces of Divine General and Ice Emperor.
"Not good!"
"How is this possible?!"
Divine General and Ice Emperor reacted quickly, and with their exceptional lightweight skill, narrowly evaded it, boom!
The saber light slashed at their previous landing point, carving out a deep, narrow saber path!
"Such strong Saber Technique!"
"Such fierce Sword Intent!"
"Such astonishing explosive power!"
Divine General and Ice Emperor were astounded and terrified, exchanging a glance, clearly seeing confusion, bewilderment, and perplexity in each other’s eyes!
Clearly, they were overpowering Ding Ling before!
Forced Ding Ling to retreat.
But just a few hours!
Ding Ling can now single-handedly overpower them with one saber!
Forcing them into suffocation, almost smelling the scent of death!
"Crack!"
Ding Ling saw the two narrowly dodged the first move, but wasn’t surprised, swiftly slicing horizontally!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
A Glimpse of Cold!
This saber, simple and fierce, focused on extreme speed!

Especially suitable for switching Sword Technique, right after Ding Ling slashed one saber, precisely when the old force dissipated and new force hasn’t formed, in which the enemy’s counterattack is most dangerous, and A Glimpse of Cold was born for this, with a wrist flip, casually slicing horizontally to the right.
Another eighty-meter saber light appeared abruptly!
With the sound of dragon roars and elephant shouts, slashing swiftly towards Divine General and Ice Emperor.
"How could the switch between Sword Technique be so fast, and the transition smooth as flowing clouds? Clearly, the Sword Technique has been cultivated to the Great Perfection Ruyi Realm!"

The Divine General was shaken, just like the Ice Emperor began using Lightweight Body Technique to dodge this saber, with a leap of several tens of meters, then a flip, tens of meters more, landing far away, dodging this saber, boom!
Seeing this saber neatly and lightly carving a trench into the cave wall, he felt a toothache:
"Such strong Sword Technique! Didn’t see the young man use a saber before, how did he suddenly start using a saber, and that saber is evidently a peerless Divine Weapon!"
"Not only the saber. The sword on him also gives me an unsettling feeling, clearly not ordinary."
Ice Emperor’s movements were no weaker than the Divine General’s, narrowly dodging the second move, landing not far away.
However.
Once Ding Ling’s Sword Technique is demonstrated.
It is endless, like thunderstorm outbursts!
Full Level Proud Cold Six Formulas in action!
Along with Divine Form Tenfold Amplification!
Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification!
Unstoppable.
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Stepping on Snow to Seek Plum!
Once executed, paired with Ding Ling’s amazing body technique, chasing the Divine General and Ice Emperor as he fiercely slashed, slashing them into a defensive panic, utterly disarrayed.
Poof!
Ice Emperor, careless, brushed by the saber light on his scalp, instantly shedding all his white hair, becoming bald!
Ice Emperor only felt a chill on his scalp, then a sharp pain invaded his mind, he touched it, feeling a handful of blood, horrified, roaring:
"Divine General, fight him to the death! If this continues, we’re dead for sure!"
Ice Emperor felt the chaos of the world was indeed too bizarre!

From initially thinking Ding Ling was a soft target, to evenly matched, then being chased by Ding Ling, later teaming with Divine General to chase Ding Ling, but after just a few hours, it was Ding Ling chasing them again!
Too unbelievable.
"How exactly has this guy been cultivating! Was he hiding his prowess initially?!"
Ice Emperor had a thought flash through his mind, but quickly denied it, as Ding Ling had no need to hide his prowess!
If he originally had such strength, he could directly fight them, no need to hide for hours!
"Indeed."
Divine General barely dodged the saber light, cold sweat pouring out, feeling that if hit by the Sword Technique, even his World-Ending Demon Body could be broken!
Thus, hearing Ice Emperor’s words, he responded without hesitation:
"Use our strongest kill move together, apply the ice-fire double heaven!"
"Alright!"

Ice Emperor roared, leaping, dodging another saber light by the skin of his teeth, sensing his scalp shaved again, blood streaming down, almost obstructing his vision, knowing he can’t delay anymore, or the next saber will severely wound him!
Though he and Divine General considered escaping, Ding Ling blocked the exit, leaving no escape except plunging into the magma pool like Ding Ling.
However, Ice Emperor couldn’t stay long in the magma pool, would lose all his Gang Qi, leading to death beyond control, dying faster and more miserably.
Therefore.
The thought of a do-or-die fight entered his mind.
He immediately collaborated with Divine General, transforming into an overwhelming Ice Storm at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 601: Godslayer
paragraphs: The Divine General transformed into a storm of lightning and fire that covered the sky and earth.

As the frost met the lightning and fire, it instantly turned into a Taiji ice and fire millstone, one half bursting with raging lightning and fire, the other like frost and snow capable of freezing everything.
The millstone formed by these two powers came rumbling towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was not afraid at all!
He let out a long roar.
Poured all his power into the Snow-Drinking Saber!
Unleashing an incredibly powerful strike!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Ice Blade Ice Heart!
Boom!
The massive eighty-meter blade manifested once again!
This time, the blade radiance was even more concentrated, vivid, overbearing!
This was because Ding Ling injected the entirety of his Divine Form Power into the blade, making the dragon and elephant forms on the blade almost come alive!
All the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique was also poured into this strike!
This was Ding Ling’s most powerful strike ever!
Fusing all of his inner strength, vigorous qi, and divine form power!
With the Snow-Drinking Saber as the Divine Weapon in hand.
As the blade slashed down!
The massive eighty-meter blade came crashing down on the millstone amidst dragon roars and elephant trumpets.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The millstone and the sword clashed incessantly in the void, for quite a while, crack! The massive eighty-meter blade chopped into the millstone inch by inch.
With cracking sounds, the entire millstone was split into two.
Boom!
As the millstone shattered, screams echoed to the ends of the earth, as both the Ice Emperor and the Divine General had their arms severed entirely!
This very move.
Was their most perfectly executed attack, winning or losing.
If defeated.
The consequence would be severe injury!
Now with their arms broken off, their power suddenly dropped by half, trying to escape was already too late!
"Die!"
Ding Ling roared angrily.
Wielding the great blade horizontally!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Chilling Glimpse!
This slash was the fastest, in a flash, the massive eighty-meter blade sliced across the sky! Poof poof!
Two crisp sounds rang out as both the Ice Emperor and Divine General were cut through at the waist.

They tried to escape, even exerting all their strength to leap high into the air, weaving and changing, but Ding Ling’s blade technique shifted even faster, Chilling Glimpse repeatedly performed, slashing one after another, in an instant five slashes were made!
Two of the slashes hit them, cutting both of them down from midair, plonk! Plonk!
The two fell to the ground like kites with broken strings, each with a ghastly face, eyes filled with fear, but they could only breathe in, unable to breathe out.
Ding Ling stepped forward immediately, using the Dragon Capturing Skill to drag their mutilated bodies over.
One in each hand!
Eternal Youth Technique operated, whoosh whoosh! The True Qi from both surged incessantly into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
The Breathing Technique, Eternal Youth Technique, and other Techniques all displayed their power simultaneously.
As soon as this True Qi entered the Dantian, it was rapidly refined into Longevity True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Inner Power Value +100]
The strength of two peerless masters was truly extraordinary.
Ding Ling’s power soared, feeling as if he was ascending into the Immortal Realm, shivering with pleasure.
"How, how is this possible?!"
The Divine General and Ice Emperor felt their power being absorbed, shocked and confused at the same time:
"So young! Such power! Such means!"
"Who exactly is he?!"
"Whose disciple, whose subordinate, cultivated him to be so terrifying?!"
They couldn’t understand, nor could they accept.
They died just like that!
Their ambitions, their goals, all unfulfilled, they didn’t want to die!
"How did he suddenly become so strong?"
With confusion written all over their faces.
With hearts full of bitterness, resentment, anger, frustration, and remorse, the two collapsed lifelessly to the ground.
[Received D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate the Divine General.]

[Note: The Divine General came to Lingyun Cave with the intention of reaching new heights. He wouldn’t stop until achieving his goal. Your appearance disrupted his plans. But with the Ice Emperor as a partner, he didn’t see resolving you as troublesome. However, your progress was beyond imagination! Making him die with bewilderment and reluctance!]
He wanted to know why you progressed so quickly even till his last breath!
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate the Ice Emperor]
[Note: Once again, you crushed the Ice Emperor! His mentality collapsed completely, defense broken!]
Received another D-level.
As for the earlier D-level from the Ice Emperor, now unexpectedly received an E-level.
It seems earning achievement medals again is a process that gradually decreases.
Ding Ling pondered.
He casually discarded the two corpses drained of True Qi onto the ground.
Both were cut in half.
The speed at which their True Qi dissipated was rapid.
Even as Ding Ling fully absorbed, he still managed to extract a considerable amount of True Qi from their meridians and mutilated bodies.
[Inner Power Value +1500]
This was from the Ice Emperor.
[Inner Power Value +1600]
This was from the Divine General.

If not for their extensive expenditure of True Qi in the battle against Ding Ling and being cut in half with considerable dissipation of True Qi, the inner power value absorbed by Ding Ling would definitely have been greater.
[True Power Value: 44 points]
A full 31 strands of Longevity True Qi appeared out of nowhere in the Dantian!
The Longevity True Qi gathered into 10 drops of Longevity True Water.
The True Power value instantly rose by 10 points!
True power surged.
Battle power soared.
Ding Ling instantly reached the level of a high-tier Grandmaster!
"The Divine General and Ice Emperor died worthy deaths, their demise accomplished me!"
Ding Ling never expected the True Qi of these two, after being consumed of so much and with some dissipated, would still be refined into such pure Longevity True Water.
It was evident that the cultivation techniques of these two must not be much weaker than the Eternal Youth Technique, and perhaps even on par with it.
Why say so?
Simply because the absorbed True Qi was extremely pure and remarkable.
The impurities refined were extremely few.
Nearly 90% of the True Qi was refined into Longevity True Qi!
"Reached the ability level of a high-tier Grandmaster. Now, in this vast world, aside from a few individuals, who could be my opponent?"
Ding Ling glanced at the Divine General and Ice Emperor.
The Divine General was stronger than the Ice Emperor.
Unfortunately.
They were enemies, not friends, and had to engage in a duel to the death.
Ding Ling habitually performed a corpse looting action.
He used the Dragon Capturing Skill to open their clothes, inspecting them.
And he indeed discovered a secret manual, a scroll, and a weapon.
The secret manual and weapon came from the Divine General.
The scroll came from the Ice Emperor.
He opened the scroll and took a close look.
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened:

"It’s actually a detailed map of the Celestial Gate Human Realm Territory, with even some maps of the Celestial Realm. It seems the Ice Emperor is very dissatisfied with Emperor Shitian. Otherwise, how could he secretly draw such a detailed map? Even marking the residence of Emperor Shitian in the Celestial Realm and the suspected locations of ’Holy Heart Technique,’ ’Snow Blood Claw,’ and other techniques?"

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 602: Free-Will Ascension Step
paragraphs: The Ice Emperor is a disciple of Emperor Shitian.
He cultivates the Snow Blood Claw along with its corresponding inner power, which is extraordinarily remarkable.
The quality attributes are just slightly inferior to the Eternal Youth Technique.
It’s evident that Emperor Shitian invested considerable effort and resources in his early cultivation.
Unfortunately, the Ice Emperor was defiant and was ultimately sealed in ice during a great battle.
His early unsealing was somewhat related to the intervention of an alien.

Even after being unsealed, the Ice Emperor’s ambitions to ascend were undying; Emperor Shitian surely knew this but considered the Ice Emperor as nothing more than an insignificant pest, thus did not perform a body search on the Ice Emperor.
And this proved to be advantageous for Ding Ling.

"With this map, the Celestial Sect’s Unmoving Human Realm and Free Earth Realm hold no secrets for me. Even the location of the Void Sacred Realm’s library is somewhat clear to me. When I am strong enough, the first thing to do upon breaking into the Celestial Sect is to seize these books!"
As long as I have the books in place.
Resources in place.
I can ascend to the heavens in one step!
Achieve greatness in a short time!
Ding Ling places the map into the storage pouch.
He takes out the weapon of the Divine General for a glance.
It’s a dagger.
He draws it! Clang! The blade is intimidating, infused with True Qi, and slashes towards the side earth realm! Buzz!
A thin line is carved into the earth realm!
It turns out to be a Divine Weapon that can cut strands of hair and slice through iron like mud. Though finely crafted, it’s far inferior to the Snow-Drinking Saber. Should the two collide?
It’s likely that this dagger would be instantly severed by the Snow-Drinking Saber.

This might be why the Divine General didn’t use this Divine Weapon in the confrontation; if he were to face the Snow-Drinking Saber directly, the Divine Weapon would be chopped apart, and in the ensuing chaos, the Divine General might meet his end even sooner!
The Divine General has extensive battle experience, such mistakes are naturally avoided.

Ding Ling casually places the dagger into the storage pouch. Although it can’t match a Divine Weapon like the Snow-Drinking Saber, it is as remarkable as the Heaven-Swaying Sword and worth collecting.
He retrieves the secret manual.
Opens it.
Inscribed are five large characters ’Free-Will Ascension Step’!
"This cultivation technique sounds very familiar."

Ding Ling initially expected to acquire profound martial arts such as World-Ending Demon Body or Fire Thunder Gang Qi from the Divine General, but unexpectedly, he obtained a lightweight body technique that even the Divine General hadn’t seemingly mastered.
Unable to restrain himself, Ding Ling read it attentively.
Upon reading.
He was greatly astonished.
The intricacies in speed and maneuverability of this Free-Will Ascension Step were unexpectedly superior to ’Soaring in the Void’!
The lightweight body technique of Soaring in the Void was already the best among all of Ding Ling’s lightweight techniques!
It is, indeed, a Shattering Level body technique.
Yet this Free-Will Ascension Step is even three points superior to Soaring in the Void!
"If Soaring in the Void is a body technique manual at the Shattering Initial Tier Level, then this Free-Will Ascension Step surely reaches the Middle Tier of Shattering!"
Ding Ling pondered:
’Why didn’t the Divine General use this technique?’
Ding Ling was certain that the Divine General hadn’t mastered it, simply because the Divine General never used this body technique from start to finish.
"Could it be granted by Emperor Shitian?"
Thinking of Emperor Shitian.
Ding Ling finally remembered this cultivation technique.
Apparently, this Free-Will Ascension Step was Emperor Shitian’s hidden ultimate lightweight technique.
It is a lightweight body technique attached to the Holy Heart Technique.

To fully master and perfectly utilize this lightweight body technique, one must have top-notch inner strength like the Holy Heart Technique to stimulate it; otherwise, even if mastered, it’s rather useless.
"I see."
"It’s a pity, a pity, this move is useless to me."
Ding Ling quickly finished reading the secret manual.
In an instant.
[Free-Will Ascension Step Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.2]
In a flash, Ding Ling cultivated the Free-Will Ascension Step to Great Perfection.
Within Ding Ling’s Dantian, both the Demon Path True Water and Longevity True Water were generated by extremely high-level inner power heart methods.
Plus, upon reaching full level in the Free-Will Ascension Step, his body naturally generated a steady stream of special vigorous qi.
This vigorous qi was ethereal like a celestial being, its quality completely equal to the Demon Path True Water and Longevity True Water.
As the Longevity True Water stimulated this vigorous qi.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s entire being became like a phantom, flickering in and out unpredictably within the cave.
The speed was swift.
As if instant teleportation!
Ordinary people couldn’t even discern Ding Ling’s figure clearly. Only truly innate experts could catch a glimpse of Ding Ling passing by like a phantom!
"So fast! So fast!
Ding Ling exclaimed with delight:
"Such a powerful Free-Will Ascension Step!"
Ding Ling moved back and forth, turning adeptly in mid-air, shrinking distances on the ground, like a ghostly presence, indiscernible to the naked eye!
"Such a powerful Free-Will Ascension Step."
Ding Ling suddenly stopped to marvel:

"Regarding agility in maneuverability, speed technique, and the depth of esoteric truths, this truly surpasses Soaring in the Void by more than a notch. Yet it doesn’t fly as high as Soaring in the Void. Combining Soaring in the Void and this Free-Will Ascension Step, I am invincible in terms of body technique."
Ding Ling was also satisfied.
He hadn’t expected to accidentally acquire such a top-tier lightweight skill this time.

"It goes without saying that the Divine General will surely pledge allegiance to Emperor Shitian and agree to serve him, Emperor Shitian will surely reward him. And this Free-Will Ascension Step would be the first reward? If the task was done well afterward, Emperor Shitian would grant him a second reward?"
The specific facts.
Ding Ling knew not.

But it’s certain that Emperor Shitian harbored ill intentions because the Free-Will Ascension Step’s cultivation difficulty is akin to ascending to the heavens; without the Holy Heart Technique’s auxiliary, ordinary people wouldn’t learn it successfully, nor could they cultivate the special Free-Will Ascension vigorous qi.
This vigorous qi is extremely mysterious and extraordinary.
Only when the Free-Will Ascension Step is at the Great Perfection can it naturally be generated from within, and then be utilized by other techniques.
Otherwise.
If not at Great Perfection, unless stimulated by a technique similar to the Holy Heart Technique, otherwise it’s rather useless.
"Only when the Great Perfection is achieved can one truly realize the difficulty of this technique’s learning."
Before reaching Great Perfection.
Ding Ling had speculated.
But the speculation was inaccurate.
Now at Great Perfection, he believed his speculation was nearly correct.
The Divine General surely couldn’t cultivate this Free-Will Ascension Step to Great Perfection, naturally couldn’t utilize or stimulate it.
"Emperor Shitian presented a seemingly enticing bait to induce the Divine General. The Divine General was unfortunate, but it proved beneficial for me."
As long as the library collected the cultivation technique.
As long as the technique is within the world’s limits.
It can be instantly maxed out, regardless of prerequisite conditions!
"It’s a pity such technique too greatly consumes True Qi. Similar to the previous twenty-times magnification, they all require a large amount of True Qi."
If using ordinary techniques in battle.
Ding Ling can fight for ten days and nights without issue.
But if using the Divine Form, Breathing Technique with twenty-times magnification.
The consumption of True Qi is equally twenty times usual, possibly even more.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 603: Second Dream
paragraphs: Such a large consumption of True Qi.
Naturally, it is difficult to sustain.
Ding Ling did not worry much about this.
The twenty-fold increase is naturally used only when encountering masters, usually, he wouldn’t waste True Qi by using it casually.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling glanced around this cave.
This place could be considered his blessed land.
Thinking about the eight Qilin eggs hidden beneath the mysterious realm under the magma pool.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly, shook his head, and turned to leave.
Those Qilin eggs cannot be moved.
Once moved.
The array breaks.
The coffin’s seal would also be released, at that time, with the Immortal Demon God of War Chiyou emerging, he’d be doomed.
Currently, he’s not stronger than Chiyou.
But it doesn’t mean he won’t be stronger than Chiyou in the future.
If he can’t win now, he’ll suppress Chiyou first.
When he becomes stronger than Chiyou in the future, he can naturally come to kill him. Ding Ling knows how to choose.

Of course, the most fundamental reason is that Ding Ling doesn’t have absolute confidence in breaking that array, and even if he could break it, he isn’t entirely sure he could get out safely. Who knows if the master behind the array has any other hidden tricks.
So, unless it’s absolutely necessary, without unmatched skills and an extremely high realm, Ding Ling would never fight that array head-on; it has no meaning.
Whoosh whoosh!

Ding Ling used the Free-Will Ascension Step to move, his True Qi now abundant and flowing like the sea; although using the Free-Will Ascension Step consumes more True Qi than other Lightweight Skills, Ding Ling can afford it.
Whoosh whoosh!

Like lightning, more like Shrinking Inches, Ding Ling disappeared on the spot in an instant, and in the next moment, he was hundreds of meters away, as fast as wind and lightning, yet remarkably without stirring even the slightest ripple!
This Lightweight Skill is different from other Lightweight Skills; when other skills are deployed, the surroundings are often quite disturbed, usually accompanied by anomalies.
But not with this Cultivation Technique.
Silent and soundless.
It doesn’t even create a gust of wind!
All the way, as people walk past, it’s hard for others to detect that someone just passed by their side!

The reason lies in this Lightweight Body Technique’s Vigorous Qi being extremely mysterious; once activated, it forms a rotating circle of Vigorous Qi on the body surface and throughout the body. This Vigorous Qi automatically displaces air, so even with great speed, there will be no sound breaking through the air!
Precisely because of the excellence of this body technique.
Ding Ling swept through passages, walking past people; unless seen with their own eyes, generally, people are completely unaware.
"Did you see that person just now?!"
A master who had intruded into Lingyun Cave pointed to the place where Ding Ling disappeared with a face of shock:
"So fast, as fast as lightning! Disappeared in the blink of an eye. If it weren’t for my high self-esteem, it would be impossible to have hallucinations! I would have thought I saw it wrong!"
"Pig Emperor."
Another master with disheveled hair, a resolute appearance, and a domineering aura, yet an eight-foot-tall robust middle-aged man, frowned and said to the man beside him:
"Don’t talk nonsense, okay! I didn’t feel anything!"
"Dad."

Beside this sturdy, eight-foot-tall middle-aged man was a graceful young girl with a veil on her face, willow brows, and enchanting eyes. She couldn’t help but glance at where Ding Ling vanished and murmured:
"I saw it too just now!"
"What? Even you saw it!"
The middle-aged man’s face grew even more unsightly, almost incredulous:
"Why didn’t I see it?!"

"Sword Emperor, you were just now facing away from that master, it’s normal not to see. We happened to face him. Therefore, we saw it more clearly, but the man’s speed was too fast. I just vaguely saw his face, a very handsome young man!"
The Pig Emperor, a large and honest-faced man carrying a big knife, glanced at the robust middle-aged man and said:
"So you don’t have to care too much."
"How can I not care?!"
The Sword Emperor’s face twisted in anger:

"I came to this Lingyun Cave to seek opportunities to return and defeat the Evil Emperor! To reclaim what is mine as the first! After arriving here, I found so many masters! Some are not much weaker than the Evil Emperor! I, I, I..."
He was torn and tormented! His heart was in turmoil and unrest.
Particularly the words Pig Emperor and his daughter Second Dream had just exchanged struck him like a thunderbolt:
"Especially the young man you mentioned just now?! With such speed, if he wanted to kill me, wouldn’t I be powerless to resist?"
"That’s not necessarily true. That young man looks very young. Perhaps he’s just fast."
Pig Emperor reassured him.
Second Dream, however, had a peculiar gaze. She hadn’t really discerned the face of that young man just now, only seeing a shadow swoosh across her eyes because it was too fast.
At one point she thought it was an illusion.
Until her uncle Pig Emperor mentioned it, she was certain she hadn’t seen it wrong. Her heart was shocked, and she couldn’t help but think:

"The world is becoming more and more treacherous and unpredictable. One master after another appears, unbelievably powerful. Perhaps my father will give up on challenging Uncle Evil Emperor again? After all, even if he beats Uncle Evil Emperor, so what? He will still not become the World’s Number One. As long as he understands this, he should stop fighting with Uncle Evil Emperor."
Second Dream was thinking about how to persuade the Sword Emperor.
Yet, unbeknownst to her, the Sword Emperor was already obsessed with the pursuit of becoming the World’s Number One.
He looked towards where Ding Ling had disappeared and said firmly:
"No matter what. I must become the World’s Number One! Since there are so many masters here. After I seize the opportunity, I will challenge them one by one!"
Second Dream’s lips twitched bitterly, exchanging glances with Pig Emperor.
Ding Ling gave Nie Feng a scale from the Fire Qilin.
And on this scale, he had infused his unique Longevity True Qi from the Eternal Youth Technique.
Thus, activating the Tracking and Tracing skill afterward.
Ding Ling zigzagged around, resembling a lightning bolt traversing various parts of Lingyun Cave.
Midway, he saw far too many masters and players.
Ding Ling lost count of how many people he encountered.
He just occasionally saw fights, assassinations, and other conflicts erupting in Lingyun Cave.
Players suffered innumerable casualties but pressed forward without relent.
After all, the Fire Qilin had died.
Their hopes reignited.
As for how the players knew the Fire Qilin was dead?
It was no surprise to Ding Ling that they would know the news in time, as they have their ways.
After all, the area around Lingyun Cave had the most players.
Once one person knew, unless the news was tightly guarded, essentially everyone would know.
The Fire Qilin had died.
Players naturally dared to venture into Lingyun Cave again in search of opportunity.
The Fire Qilin had fallen deeply into madness, killing anyone in sight.
Yet the natives hadn’t gone as far as to become inhumane.
This remains the reason players dare to step in.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 604: Ten Strong Martial Dao
paragraphs: However, among the natives, there were people like the Ice Emperor, cruel and reckless, who enjoyed slaughter. When encountering such people, players can only consider themselves unlucky.
Ding Ling witnessed many incidents where these native experts killed players effortlessly.
Of course.
Most natives didn’t bother with players.
Naturally, Ding Ling wouldn’t intentionally cause conflict or disputes with players.
He mostly passed by fleetingly.
The players’ strength was too insignificant. Often, even with their eyes open, they might not notice someone suddenly darting in front of them.
They merely seemed to see a dark line flash by in a daze, but upon closer inspection, there was nothing unusual.
They would never associate this dark line with a person.
Because, in their view, it was too far-fetched!
No matter how advanced the Lightweight Skill was, how could it be so remarkably extraordinary?!
Currently, the experts they had encountered were at the level of Nie Feng and the Pig Emperor, and those slightly stronger would be the Ice Emperor and Divine General.
Even the Lightweight Body Technique of the Divine General was far inferior to Ding Ling.
It’s completely normal for players to have this perception.
Ding Ling was completely unaware of this.
Even if he knew.
He wouldn’t be too interested.
After some time.
Ding Ling didn’t know how long he had been walking.
He finally found Nie Feng.
Nie Feng was in a special stone chamber, staring blankly at the cave wall.
This stone chamber was obviously punched through by someone, resembling a secret chamber.
Ding Ling glanced around with interest.
He couldn’t help but think:

"This place is hidden too well. It’s concealed on the side of a thick cave wall in one of the eight corridors. Even if an ordinary person tried to probe and tap the cave wall, it would be useless because it’s too thick, making it difficult for a regular person to notice any difference between this spot and other places.
Nie Feng managed to find it, but he truly is the child of destiny, extremely fortunate."
Ding Ling didn’t anticipate Nie Feng’s ability to find the Ten Strong Martial Dao.
He actually found it.
He didn’t disturb Nie Feng.
Instead, he stepped forward and began examining the martial arts recorded in the stone chamber.
With just one glance.
He recognized that the martial arts recorded in the stone chamber were of the Shattering Level!
The power was astonishing!
Beyond comprehension!
The foundation of Ding Ling’s martial arts was already incredibly profound, reaching an extraordinary realm, allowing him, though lacking in innovation, to have exceptional insight and observation.
Recognizing at a glance that the supreme skills recorded on the stone wall were of the Shattering Level was naturally easy for him.
"Indeed the Ten Strong Martial Dao!"
Ding Ling was quite delighted.
"Having Nie Feng look for this Cultivation Technique was indeed the right choice."
If Ding Ling searched by himself.
He would definitely find it.
But the time and effort required would be enormous! Moreover, with so many experts in Lingyun Cave, who could guarantee that someone else wouldn’t find the Ten Strong Martial Dao before him?
If the Ten Strong Martial Dao were found and then destroyed by someone else, Ding Ling estimated that he wouldn’t have fate with this Technique.
Without delay, he immediately began to examine it closely.
He perused the Sword Technique.
With just one instance.
A new Secret Manual instantly appeared on the library bookshelf.
Four large characters distinctly engraved on the cover: "No-Two Blade Technique"!
In an instant.
[No-Two Blade Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
This is a Saber Technique of Initial Tier of Shattering!
Once at full level.
A domineering Sword Intent seemingly capable of shattering everything erupted from Ding Ling’s body!
This Sword Intent was even stronger than the Proud Cold Blade Intent!
Making the sharpness emanating from Ding Ling’s body even more intense.

Momentarily awakening Nie Feng, who was immersed in ’Enlightenment’. Seeing the visitor was Ding Ling, he was quite startled, he had penetrated the Lingyun Cave for countless miles, and yet Ding Ling could still locate him precisely!
This ability to find people was truly remarkable.
Besides, Nie Feng was most surprised that Ding Ling had actually mastered a Sword Intent!
Nie Feng had been here comprehending the Ten Strong Martial Dao for some time.
Still a while away from mastering it.
Not to mention mastering it to the Perfect Realm or even Great Perfection.
While Ding Ling?!
In an even shorter time, he had mastered a Saber Technique, and it had reached the flawless Supreme Wishing Realm!
Nie Feng, with extraordinary talent and profound insight, recognized at a glance that Ding Ling’s No-Two Blade Technique had reached the Supreme Perfection of the Flawless Realm.
This made him profoundly shocked and felt incredible!
Ding Ling was unaware that Nie Feng was observing him.
He continued, self-absorbed, to look at the next Spear Technique.
Soon he finished.
[Heaven-Questioning Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
Bang!
Another proud Spear Intent surged instantly from Ding Ling’s body!
This Spear Intent was blazing and dazzling, seeming to pierce and shatter the heavens!
Clearly showcasing the manifestation achieved only at the Great Perfection Realm.
Nie Feng was astounded.
The Sword Intent had just erupted, causing constant changes in the wind and clouds here, how long had it been? Another activation of Spear Intent?!
Ding Ling continued examining the Sword Dao.
Equally quickly, he scanned through it, finishing in less than a dozen breaths.
[Celestial Destiny Sword Dao Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
Once this Sword Technique reached full level.
Waves of Sword Qi instantly surged forth from Ding Ling’s body, this Sword Qi was like a Sword River, like snow pouring, more like a carp leaping over the Dragon Gate, a king traversing the world!
An imagery of the Divine King traveling the earth with a sword filled the entire stone chamber.
Nie Feng was stunned, completely speechless, as if witnessing a myth.
Ding Ling continued.
[Great Yi Halberd Manual Full Level]

Once this Halberd Manual reached full level, Ding Ling’s demeanor dramatically changed, seeming to transform into a specter single-handedly wielding a halberd against ten thousand troops! One strike, and it could defeat thousands of soldiers! Heaven and Earth shook!
[Tiger Roar Staff Collection Full Level]
Once this Staff Technique reached full level, a tremendous aura of the Tiger King spontaneously arose from Ding Ling, standing there, resembling a Divine Beast White Tiger!
[Mountain and Sea Fist Scripture Full Level]
A vast and colossal Mountain Sea Fist Intent hovered on Ding Ling’s body, enhancing Ding Ling’s image as a Mountain God descending to the mortal realm, a Sea God roaming the earth!
[Black Tortoise Divine Palm Full Level]
[Fierce Strong Leg Technique Full Level]
[Harmonious Golden Finger Full Level]
[Armor Bone Dragon Claw Full Level]
The Ten Strong Martial Dao, all reached full level in a matter of moments.

The moves of the Ten Strong Martial Dao here were all succinct, directly targeting the core, each move containing multiple transformations, with mantras hidden within, allowing Ding Ling to read quickly.
Learning was even faster.
After all the Ten Strong Martial Dao reached full level.
Ding Ling saw the final move.
[Ten Directions Invincible Offensive Move Full Level!]
This offensive move was a supreme killing technique formed by the integration of the Ten Strong Martial Dao!
The ten types of martial techniques of Shattering Level condensed into one.
Transformed into one move!
Instantly exploding with more than tenfold power!
This Ten Directions Invincible Offensive Move was also a Supreme Technique of augmentation.
Comparable to Ding Ling’s Divine Form Power.
Divine Form Tenfold Amplification.
This Ten Directions Invincible Offensive Move could also be amplified tenfold.
Combined with the Breathing Technique Tenfold Amplification.
It’s equivalent to Ding Ling now being able to amplify the Ten Directions Invincible Offensive Move thirtyfold!
Believe that once this move is used.
Few in the world could resist!
Besides these moves.

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 605: Black Tortoise True Skill
paragraphs: Ding Ling also saw the energy flow path of the Black Tortoise True Skill.
This path runs through the entire cave wall.
Hidden within the techniques of the Ten Strong Martial Dao, unless one has keen insight, even if they learn the Ten Strong Martial Dao, they would definitely not be able to see this energy flow path.
And this energy flow path is the foundation of the Ten Strong Martial Dao.
Only by mastering the Black Tortoise True Skill.
Can one perfectly coordinate with the Ten Strong Martial Dao to unleash moves of Shattering Level power.
Ding Ling carefully finished looking.
In an instant.
[Black Tortoise True Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi surged in, instantly engulfing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling instinctively activated the Eternal Youth Technique to absorb and refine.
But found it could not be absorbed.
As expected.
With the rapid operation of Black Tortoise True Skill.
These Spiritual Qi, Primordial Qi transformed into three streams of Black Tortoise True Qi swirling above the Tai Chi Diagram.
This True Qi indeed somewhat resembled the divine beast Black Tortoise.
Sitting in the Dantian.
Defensive and offensive, both hard and soft.
Unless something unexpected happens.
If further developed, as long as the opportunity is right, this Black Tortoise True Skill should also be able to transform into a very strong Divine Form.
"Whew."
Ding Ling exhaled a long breath.
The opportunity here was completely obtained and thoroughly controlled by him.
And because of the full level of Black Tortoise True Skill.
He could even borrow the abundant True Qi in the Dantian to perform the initiation move of Ten Directions Invincible!
Ten Directions Invincible is composed of many techniques.
Here only the initial move is found.
It can be imagined.
When Wu Wudi came to Lingyun Cave, either he hadn’t comprehended the other techniques, or he didn’t carve them down even if he had.
No matter what the truth is.
Being able to obtain such a top-level Shattering Technique, Ding Ling is very content.

’Black Tortoise True Skill has remarkably reached the High Tier of Shattering. It actually surpasses the Demon Scripture by a notch, truly worthy of being a technique that can fight beyond levels, growing stronger as you fight more!’
’Ten Directions Invincible is a skill that has reached the High Tier of Shattering.’
When the technique and skill combine.
Henceforth rampaging, unmatched!
Wu Wudi.
Indeed shockingly powerful.

However, this technique of fighting beyond levels is extremely consuming of True Qi, if the physical strength is not strong enough, it’s very likely that once the True Qi is exhausted, the whole person would collapse.
But Ding Ling has no such worries, even if his True Qi is exhausted, his ability in Body Refining is enough to overpower grandmaster-level experts!
Therefore.
Ding Ling can recklessly unleash the power of Black Tortoise True Skill + Ten Directions Invincible + Divine Form Power + Breathing Technique!
Thirty times amplification of Black Tortoise True Skill.
How strong is the power exactly?
Ding Ling also very much wants to know.
With a twenty times amplification, he can fight across two levels as if it were nothing.
If it’s a thirty times amplification?
Can he directly transcend a whole level?
Ding Ling thinks it shouldn’t be a big problem. Just thinking about it makes Ding Ling involuntarily exhilarated.
He exhaled a long breath, glanced around the entire cave, confirmed there were no other opportunities, and then couldn’t help but look at Nie Feng.
Nie Feng was completely numb, plunged into deep shock and disbelief.
After confirming several times that it wasn’t an illusion, and that there indeed was a person like Ding Ling in front of him, he couldn’t help but clench his teeth, feeling a sense of toothache.
He had yet to achieve initial mastery of the Ten Directions Martial Dao.
What about Ding Ling?
Did the gap between people have to be this big?!
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: You have earned Nie Feng’s deep admiration.]
[Annotation: Your speed makes Nie Feng feel inferior, your ability moves him, your talent astonishes him, making him admire you greatly!]
Hearing the prompt, Ding Ling understood, everything that had just happened must have been seen by Nie Feng, so he said:
"Nie Feng, do you want to continue comprehending the Ten Directions Martial Dao now, or shall I take you to see your dad?"
"Of course, to see my dad."

Nie Feng instinctively replied, but seeing the Ten Directions Martial Dao here, he felt reluctant, not knowing if there would be another chance to return and continue to comprehend after leaving this time.
Even if he returned.
Wouldn’t the Ten Directions Martial Dao here be discovered and consequently destroyed by others?
"If you’re reluctant, then take a good look. I don’t mind waiting here for half a day for you."
Ding Ling had obtained the greatest opportunities in Lingyun Cave, Ten Directions Martial Dao, Fire Qilin, and so on.
For a while, there was no urgency to leave.
He planned to sort out what he had learned here, to consolidate himself, only by integrating what he learned into one can he exert the maximum combat power.
"How could I accept?"
Nie Feng felt somewhat embarrassed.
"Hehe.
Ding Ling chuckled:
"If that’s the case, then let me guide you in training. This way, your speed to initial mastery will definitely be faster."
Nie Feng’s eyes lit up, but his handsome face blushed due to embarrassment, yet perhaps because he was eager to see his father, he sincerely bowed to Ding Ling, thanking him for the trouble.
Ding Ling carefreely waved his hand, and began to guide Nie Feng from a high vantage point.
His Ten Directions Martial Dao was at full level.
Guiding Nie Feng’s training, he naturally hit the nail on the head.
Nie Feng occasionally fell into an enlightened state of sudden realization, feeling a profound comprehension of what had just been partial understanding.
Like enlightenment, he immediately went from partial understanding to deeply perceiving the Heaven-Reaching Dao.
The speed of his comprehension of Black Tortoise True Skill visibly soared.
Ding Ling was also inwardly moved, Nie Feng’s talent was indeed stronger than those like Huang the Herbalist, Little Dragon Girl, truly an extraordinary genius seen once in a millennium!
Thinking of Emperor Shitian saying that Wuming, Nie Feng, and Bu Jingyun were the three most talented he had seen in over a thousand years, Ding Ling understood.
Perhaps Emperor Shitian was covering up the existence of Wu Wudi, hence not mentioning Wu Wudi.
But even if mentioned.
The aptitude talent of Nie Feng and others could certainly match that of Wu Wudi.
Wu Wudi was indeed an absolute underdog, undertook Reverse Ascension against Celestial Sect, stood strong against Emperor Shitian, and even won!
This shows Wu Wudi’s martial arts aptitude must have reached a staggering level.
Thus several hours passed.
All of Nie Feng’s Ten Strong Martial Dao reached initial mastery, and he successfully cultivated Ten Directions Invincible and Black Tortoise True Skill.
Though only at entry level.
The gap to Great Perfection might as well be a distance of eighty thousand miles.
But to achieve initial mastery in just a few hours.
Is something beyond even ordinary talents’ imagination.
After all, these are Shattering Level techniques! Reaching initial mastery is almost as difficult as ascending to heaven.
Yet for Nie Feng, it was as natural as drinking water, practicing with ease.
With Ding Ling’s incisive guidance, his progress was exceptionally smooth.
"Thank you!"
Nie Feng bowed again to express his gratitude.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced at the cave, thought for a moment, and with a casual wave, destroyed the stone walls.
Nie Feng was puzzled.
Ding Ling explained:

"Lingyun Cave is mixed with fish and dragon, good and evil intermingled, if some villainous people learned this Ten Directions Invincible and Black Tortoise True Skill, the consequences could be endless."
Who knows how many from the Celestial Sect had come to Lingyun Cave.
If someone from the Celestial Sect obtained Ten Directions Invincible.
Wouldn’t it be providing resources to the enemy?
Ding Ling would not do such a thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 606: Treading on the Thunder Elephant
paragraphs: Nie Feng breathed a sigh of relief, no longer asking more questions, and instead urgently inquired about his father.
Ding Ling didn’t say much, merely grabbing Nie Feng’s arm and saying, ’Stand firm.’
Then he performed the Free-Will Ascension Step, and in a flash, vanished like a streak of light!
He disappeared in an instant.
"So fast, too fast!"
Nie Feng, known as the ’Wind God,’ his Wind God Leg is unmatched. However, compared to Ding Ling’s speed, it pales in comparison, completely incomparable.
He widened his eyes, experiencing for the first time the absolute disparity between himself and Ding Ling.
He had sensed it before.
But felt it not deeply.

Now, firsthand experience and contact, Nie Feng was embarrassed and admired, even finding it hard to believe how Ding Ling at this age could be so invincible in divine skill, with speed being extremely top-notch?
But thinking back to Ding Ling’s scenes of learning Ten Directions Martial Dao.
He was relieved.

Each Supreme Skill in Ten Directions Martial Dao is stronger than the Wind God Leg! Yet Ding Ling mastered them in an instant, reaching the stage of Great Perfection, the various Sword Intent, Spear Intent, Fist Intent surging from his body as evidence!
Later, when Ding Ling advised him, he realized the gap in talent and comprehension between him and Ding Ling, which cannot be calculated by reason.
He admired Ding Ling to the extreme.
Whew whew!
In Nie Feng’s daze, Ding Ling proceeded Following the Map, and after some time, suddenly stopped, saying:
"We’re here."
"We’re here?"
Nie Feng shook his head, the speed was too fast, he didn’t see clearly how Ding Ling traveled along the way, thus how this path was walked.
He didn’t remember.
He quickly scanned the surroundings, and soon his gaze froze on a tall figure ahead.
"Father!"
He couldn’t help but call out.
"Feng’er."
Nie Renwang was practicing the Breathing Technique with Marshal Duann with closed eyes, hearing the sound, opened his eyes, coincidentally colliding his gaze with Nie Feng’s, he was astonished.
But soon, he saw Ding Ling, a moment of realization, he also excitedly stood up, walked over swiftly, and embraced the approaching Nie Feng.
"Father!"
Nie Feng’s heart was in tumultuous waves, immensely delighted, he didn’t expect his father to still be alive! This was truly wonderful!
In the worldly world, consecutive setbacks.
Once left Nie Feng disheartened.
But the joy of seeing Nie Renwang again dispelled this feeling of despair and sorrow, greatly invigorating Nie Feng.

Ding Ling stood nearby, watching the father and son express care for each other, talking about their past, he couldn’t help but daze slightly, yet in this moment, he reminisced about Diao Chan, Little Dragon Girl, and others.
He didn’t have much attachment to the real world.
The people he missed were basically in worlds like the Three Kingdoms.
A full half an hour.
Then Nie Renwang brought Nie Feng before Ding Ling, solemnly thanking him, exclaiming:

"Originally I lacked the courage to meet Feng’er again, if it weren’t for Young Hero Ding bringing Feng’er here of his own accord, I’m afraid I wouldn’t have met Feng’er even in death. So I must thank Young Hero Ding greatly."
"Thank you!"
Nie Feng solemnly expressed gratitude, of course, he didn’t forget his promise, without further ado, he took down a bag hanging from his waist and presented it to Ding Ling:
"This is what we agreed upon before."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, reached out to take it, saying:
"I do need these fruits, I won’t be polite."
"It’s as it should be."
Nie Feng laughed heartily:
"Meeting my father again is the happiest and most exciting thing in my life. Just some fruits, not nearly enough to express my gratitude to you!"
Ding Ling smiled. To avoid unwarranted trouble, he directly opened the bag and began eating in front of them.

But with each Blood Bodhi entering the stomach, the hunger quickly disappeared, and power grew again.
After eating 24 pieces.
[Strength +2.9]
[Physique +2.9]
[Defense +2.9]
Earlier 13 pieces consumed, the three-dimensional Attribute Points only increased by 1.1 points.
Now, consuming 14 pieces, also increased by about the same amount.
But having supplemented the deficit from the Ten Strong Martial Dao and other upgrades, the Attribute Points began to soar.
The growth speed was even faster than before.
After eating 6 pieces more.
[Strength +1.1]
[Physique +1.1]
[Defense +1.1]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Root Bone 6, Wisdom 7.5, Strength 118.4, Agility 88.5, Physique 118.4, Defense 112.1, Charm 13. True Power Value: 45 points]
"Feels like strength is about to break through a major barrier."
Ding Ling was thoughtful.
Started eating again.
After eating 9 more pieces.
[Strength: 120. Physique 120. Defense 113.7]
Boom!

Ding Ling seemingly broke through the barrier, the Dragon Form and Elephant Form on his body suddenly transformed, becoming extremely refined as if concrete, from a previously illusory clear state to an actual clear state.
Each scale on the Divine Dragon’s body was clearly visible, like a real object.
The Thunder Elephant’s eyes lively and spirited, also seemingly sublimated from a stiff state to a vibrant state! As though it came to life.
Whirr! Whirr!
Special Vigorous Qi swirled around Ding Ling.
Ding Ling stood in place, foot on Thunder Elephant, body around Divine Dragon, resembling a majestic deity emerging from ancient times!
Yet, unknowingly.
The two Divine Forms activated out of Ding Ling’s body, one beneath Ding Ling, lifting him, one continuously encircling him.
Two Divine Forms ’emerged,’ this time the divine body once made people feel they were living beings.
Before, they were blurry.
Ordinary people would know it was fake.
But now ordinary people couldn’t see through, surely thinking it’s a real Divine Dragon, Thunder Elephant.
Only those above Innate experts, detecting the commotion in the void, would know this must be the manifestation of a Perfected Divine Skill.
Nie Feng, Nie Renwang, Marshal Duann were all stunned:
’This, this, this is?!’
"It is a Tongtian phenomenon automatically manifested when an Unparalleled Divine Skill reaches perfection."
Whirr! Whirr!
Rolling Spiritual Vitality surged from all directions, being automatically refined by the Dragon Form, Elephant Form.
The two Divine Forms thus kept growing stronger.
Having broken through a major barrier.
Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill has finally reached the state of perfection.
Only one step away from Great Perfection.
Once Great Perfection is achieved.
The Dragon Form, Elephant Form can leave the body by dozens of meters, transforming into a real Divine Object to guard Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 607: Followers
paragraphs: This divine skill has reached an extraordinary level.
Nie Renwang, Marshal Duann, and Nie Feng are all remarkable individuals.
They can grasp some understanding, after all.
But have they ever cultivated their divine skill to such a level?
Their amazement, admiration, and envy reached the extreme.
"Young Hero Ding, so young, yet his divine skill has achieved great success. The future is boundless for him."
Nie Renwang was deeply moved, and couldn’t help but look at Nie Feng:
"Feng, you must closely follow Young Hero Ding’s footsteps in the future. As long as it doesn’t involve principles, do whatever he asks."
"Father. I want to stay with you."
"There’s no need for you to stay here. Just me and your Uncle Duann will suffice."
Nie Renwang shook his head, his eyes twinkling as he stared at Ding Ling:

"Young Hero Ding’s talent reaches heaven and earth, his fortune unmatched. Following him, you will definitely gain extraordinary opportunities. Feng, don’t miss this chance. If you consider me your father, listen to me!"
It was apparent.
Nie Renwang is astute.
He wanted to follow Ding Ling earlier.
But he couldn’t leave because he had to guard the Dragon Vein.

Now meeting Ding Ling again, after seeing him crazily consume the Blood Bodhi, his divine skill immediately reached perfection without hesitation, he promptly pushed Nie Feng forward, hoping he could follow Ding Ling in his stead. This way, in the future when Ding Ling achieves success, Nie Feng could also benefit.
Marshal Duann also came to realization, quickly pulling Nie Feng aside, solemnly instructing:
"Feng, when you go out, you must find your brother, my son Duann Lang, and ensure he also follows Young Hero Ding wholeheartedly. Can you do this for me?"
Nie Feng was startled, but he nodded solemnly:
"I will do my best."
He also understood Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann’s intentions.
Especially after hearing some of Ding Ling’s deeds from their mouths, he admired Ding Ling even more.
So young,
With extraordinary fortune.
Heaven-defying talent.
Battle prowess that shakes the earth and sky, he is undoubtedly a true dragon in the future! To follow such a person, how could it be lacking in any way?!
Thinking about how Xiong Ba passed on the Wind God Leg to him, holding back.
While Ding Ling just guided him in the Ten Strong Martial Dao, such heaven-defying supreme skills, without any reservation in the stone cave.
Nie Feng couldn’t help but sigh:
"The difference between people, how can it be so vast?!"
He fought at the frontlines for Xiong Ba, having endured hardships, yet ultimately got schemed against!
And Ding Ling?
A mere acquaintance.
Showed such heartfelt trust in him!
Recalling Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann’s words, seeing Nie Renwang’s anxious expression, he couldn’t help but agree.
Nie Renwang was overjoyed, heavily patting Nie Feng on the shoulder:
"Good son! Indeed, you take after your wise father!
Nie Feng awkwardly smiled.
And Ding Ling at this moment gradually awakened from his realization.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Two divine forms moved according to his will, turning into two streams of light and entering his body.
Swoosh, swoosh!
With each breath, Ding Ling felt a surging flow of Dragon Form and Elephant Form Vigorous Qi circulating within his limbs and bones, every move seemed to possess the power to hold the sky!
"Indeed, after breaking the shackles, the power of the two divine forms has become stronger. Now, the tenfold amplification power of the divine form must be even greater!"
Ding Ling felt joyful.
He glanced at the bag in his hand.
Dozens of Blood Bodhi still remained.
Without hesitation.
Continued eating.
After eating 23 pieces.
[Defense +4.5]
[Defense: 118.2]
Defense soared again.
Ding Ling’s Dragon Form and Elephant Form undoubtedly became more refined, increasingly agile and real!
The power of divine form grew more abundant and powerful!
Rolling like a tide, rushing throughout the body!
"The Blood Bodhi is all gone."
This bag contained 62 Blood Bodhi.
Ding Ling consumed them all.
"Some defense short of reaching 120."
Ding Ling foresaw.
When defense reaches 120.
Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill will definitely achieve great perfection.
At that time, the power of divine form will undergo a complete transformation.
With the strength of one dragon and one elephant upon him.
Ding Ling gently clenched his fist, feeling an immeasurable strength.
This is the power of divine form!
"This is the true Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!"
"Power that takes ten thousand years of cultivation to master, comparable to deities!"
Ding Ling felt relieved.
He looked at Nie Feng, Marshal Duann, and Nie Renwang, then bid them farewell.
The three snapped back to their senses.
Nie Renwang dragged Nie Feng, stepped forward, gave Ding Ling a grand salute, and proposed letting Nie Feng follow Ding Ling, hoping Ding Ling would agree.
His words were earnest.
His attitude sincere!
Ding Ling thought of those tasks, considering he might unify this world and become an emperor, needing capable people under him, and if he ascended and left this world.
Someone is needed to manage this world, so he agreed.
Nie Renwang happily dragged Nie Feng to thank him again.
Marshal Duann also stepped forward, stating he has a son named Duann Lang, hoping Ding Ling, upon meeting him, would accept him and stated: "As a subordinate, my son is absolutely qualified!"
Ding Ling noncommittally responded that if Duann Lang is agreeable, he would accept him.
Marshal Duann breathed a sigh of relief.
Afterward.
Ding Ling purged the Mad Blood in Nie Feng’s bloodline.
[Inner Power Value +50]
Although Nie Feng’s current skill has advanced to innate, it is still far inferior to Nie Renwang.
So when the demonic nature and demon nature in the bloodline was extracted and purged by the Demon Scripture.
The inner power value provided to Ding Ling was not much.
Of course.
Ding Ling didn’t wish for too much either, otherwise, if Nie Feng was drained in one go, wouldn’t he be ruined?
"This feeling?"
Nie Feng found it hard to believe.
"This is my Nie Clan’s Mad Blood. Now the malicious nature and demon nature within the Mad Blood has been purged, naturally giving you a sense of relief and comfort from the bottom of your heart..."
Nie Renwang explained.
Nie Feng comprehended, quickly thanking Ding Ling again.
Because he wanted to follow Ding Ling.
Nie Feng addressed Ding Ling as Venerable Lord.
Ding Ling initially wanted him to use his name.

Nie Renwang considered it disrespectful, and Nie Feng felt it was inappropriate both emotionally and rationally, so he insisted on calling Ding Ling Venerable Lord, and Ding Ling, seeing no reason to argue, let it be.
After a while.
Ding Ling, with Nie Feng, arrived at the entrance of Lingyun Cave.
This time.
Ding Ling intended to go to Unrivaled City to visit the Sword Saint. To see if he could learn the Twenty-Third Sword, a heaven-defying martial art that could freeze time!
Nie Feng had been to Unrivaled City.
Was very familiar with Unrivaled City.
Volunteered to lead the way.
Though an occasional look of sorrow flashed across his face.
He apparently still couldn’t let go of Mingyue’s death at Unrivaled City.
Clatter, clatter!
Lingyun Cave’s entrance remained crowded, and Ding Ling and Nie Feng’s appearance instantly drew everyone’s attention!
Swish, swish!
Everyone uniformly paid attention to Ding Ling and Nie Feng.
The players, seeing the two, exclaimed:
"How did Ding Ling come together with the Wind God Nie Feng?!"
"Nie Feng’s luck is invincible. The Ten Directions Invincible might fall into their hands!"

Immediately, some people quietly left.
Ding Ling and Nie Feng didn’t pay much attention.
Nie Feng was unconcerned because he didn’t know what was going to happen later.
Ding Ling wasn’t worried even though he knew.
His strength is now skyrocketing!
The Divine Form Power has reached its peak.
Infused into the Snow-Drinking Saber, it can increase the power of the Saber Technique by more than ten times!
The previous tenfold increase was barely achieved.
Now, the tenfold increase is effortless and can be controlled freely, wielding the saber with ease!
His strength has increased by at least one to two percent.
At Ding Ling’s level in the Martial Arts Realm.
An increase of one to two percent is enough to easily crush a typical High-tier Grandmaster.
Whizz whizz!

Ding Ling grabbed Nie Feng, used Soaring in the Void, and with a swift leap, they leaped out of Lingyun Cave. In the next moment, they were already a hundred meters away, and within a few breaths, they gracefully landed in the distance, disappearing without a trace shortly after.
His divine presence and demeanor were dazzling and majestic, akin to gods and immortals;
His stature and bearing were boundless and magnificent, like the sea and the sky!
"Truly the strongest among us players!"
The players watched fervently, with envy, admiration, and jealousy.

The enthusiastic ones were mostly Ding Ling’s fans, constantly cheering and shouting, hoping Ding Ling would respond and notice their existence. But Ding Ling just glanced at them casually and left, leaving them somewhat disappointed.

Some female players who prided themselves on their looks felt dejected, thinking: "I heard Ding Ling was in Lingyun Cave, so I specially dressed up today, but Ding Ling showed no interest upon seeing me?! Alas, how can I get close to Ding Ling? How to win Ding Ling over?!"
Ding Ling is undoubtedly the top star King!
If one became Ding Ling’s girlfriend.
One could imagine the fame, wealth, status, power, and everything else would surely be abundant!
And Ding Ling is also a supreme Martial Artist, if taught one or two Top-level Martial Arts by Ding Ling, it wouldn’t be surprising to maintain eternal youth.
Some with keen interest have long noticed Ding Ling’s reverse aging!
This further stirs countless people into excitement and uproar!
Ding Ling is growing younger!
Who wouldn’t envy this? Desire this? Especially women, who yearn for it exceedingly!
Thus, female players wanting to win Ding Ling over are as numerous as fish crossing the river, countless in numbers!
However, Ding Ling keeps female players at a respectful distance, avoiding any flirtations.
Therefore.
The female players collectively returned empty-handed!
To win over Ding Ling, many female players even formed numerous related groups on some chat software in reality: [Ding Ling Hardcore Fan Group]
[How to Win Ding Ling Group]
[Ding Ling Discussion Group]
Such things are numerous, showcasing Ding Ling’s current popularity.
And the jealousy and resentment from players towards Ding Ling need not be elaborated. Reaching Ding Ling’s height, the number of those slandering him out of envy was vast!
After all, among the players, there are good people and bad people.
And the presence of those who can’t stand seeing others do well is substantial.
This is one reason why Ding Ling is unwilling to interact with players.
He doesn’t know which players are bad or good, so he simply avoids all contact.
This way is more appropriate.
"Is this Ding Ling, the strongest among the Aliens? Indeed extraordinary in demeanor! Exceptional in speed!"
Other native people observed the players’ reactions and were all taken aback, each with their guesses, but without exception, they all grew warier.
For the first time paying some attention to the player group.
Changing the stereotype of Aliens being ’weak’ because of one person.
Ding Ling’s strength is evident.
Whizz whizz!
Ding Ling took Nie Feng and flew swiftly.
Nie Feng marveled, feeling that Ding Ling’s Lightweight Skill surpassed his Wind God Leg, truly remarkable.
He was about to ask Ding Ling what this Lightweight Body Technique was called, when swoosh!
Two people suddenly appeared in the void ahead.
"Halt."
One of these two was over seven feet tall, handsome, with narrow eyes, appearing rather sinister;
The other was eight feet tall, seemingly strong and burly, yet his face was simple and honest, like a straightforward person.
Clearly, these two had the sinister one as the leader.
He reached out to stop Ding Ling and Nie Feng.
Ding Ling stopped, standing in mid-air, releasing Nie Feng’s shoulder.
With the Wind God Leg, Nie Feng performed an airborne spin, stepping on a wind cluster, gently landing on the tip of a large tree.
Ding Ling glanced at the two and said:
"I wonder who you two are?"
"Haha..."
The leader laughed twice and said:
"I am Wude. The person behind me is my junior, Taiyi. We have come specially to invite you two to Phoenix Island.
"Phoenix Island?"
Ding Ling raised his brow:
"Excuse my poor eyesight. I wonder whose disciples you two are? And why specifically invite us?"
"Are you Ding Ling and Nie Feng?"
"Yes."
"Then it is indeed you."
Wude’s eyes glimmered as he scanned the two, eager to try:
"My master is the Living Immortal Xu Fu! And I am his chief disciple. This time, under my master’s order, I have come to test your skills and see how brilliant they are!"
He looked at Ding Ling:
"Rumor has it you easily defeated Bu Jingyun and Qin Shuang. The most outstanding young elite today, and the leading figure among Aliens. I want to test your skills. Please accept my challenge."
Upon saying this.
He suddenly attacked Ding Ling.
Upon his attack.
It was the earth-shattering ’Iron Bone Claw’!
Rip and tear!
A claw tearing violently towards Ding Ling in mid-air, condensed vigor forming a furious claw, seemingly capable of tearing the sky.
Ding Ling raised his brow, drew his saber!
With a casual slash of ’A Cold Glance’, he struck forth.
Boom! An eighty-meter-long saber manifested in mid-air, the loud boom directly splitting the furious claw, persisting for three breaths before Iron Bone Claw was smashed.
"Haha..."
Wude was pleased, laughing heartily and said:
"Indeed quite capable, not bad, not bad. Take another move."
He suddenly waved both hands continuously.
In mid-air.
Furious claw forms kept manifesting.
Visible to the naked eye.
Huge claws, seemingly able to tear steel, crush the earth, condensed in the void, continually clawing at Ding Ling’s key points.
Ding Ling frowned, not expecting Wude to reach a High-tier Grandmaster level.
This was somewhat beyond his prediction.
It seems, as expected.
Wude undoubtedly received special instructions from Xu Fu, becoming stronger.
But this is not a problem for Ding Ling.
He was simply casually slashing earlier, if utilizing tenfold increase, Wude would have been instantly chopped dead.
Therefore, seeing Wude earnestly attack him, Ding Ling didn’t hold back.
