chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 609: Proud Cold Six Formulas vs. Dry Ice Palm
paragraphs: Ding Ling directly infused the power of the Divine Form into the Snow-Drinking Saber.
Clang clang clang!
The Snow-Drinking Saber resonated with a tremor.
As the power of Dragon Form and Elephant Form poured in.
One side of the sword blade depicted a clear manifestation of a Divine Dragon, while the other side featured a roaring Thunder Elephant.
One Dragon and One Thunder Elephant, the aura was several times more profound than before, and their appearances were similarly clearer by several times!
Once infused into the sword blade.
With Ding Ling’s casual swing downwards!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
A Chilling Glance!
Though this sword’s power was ordinary, it was the fastest, most rapid, and with the power of the Divine Form infused, its speed reached an unbelievable level.
It slashed down like a streak of lightning.
Boom boom boom!
The furious claws in the void were swiftly destroyed like bubbles!
Like the autumn wind sweeping fallen leaves;
Like thunderbolts sweeping corn stalks!
It swept everything before it, instantly shattering dozens of furious claws, slashing towards Wude.
"How is this possible?!"
Wude was horrified and retreated violently, but it was already too late.
He was too arrogant.
He looked down on Ding Ling.
He thought that despite Ding Ling’s youth, no matter how strong he was, he couldn’t be stronger than him!
He made his move this time with a mindset of certain victory and amusement.
He believed that in the vast world, except for his master Xu Fu, there could hardly be anyone who could be his opponent, and as for the so-called first of the Alien?
Nothing more than a locust in his hand, a plaything in his eyes!
However.
With Ding Ling’s slash, his complacent and carefree mentality collapsed in an instant, his eyes almost popped out, and his face was full of incredulity:
"Why is he so strong! And still so young!"
Seeing the eighty-meter-long saber descending upon him.
There was no time to think it over.
Wude let out an angry roar, activated the full power of his Grandmaster’s skills, and formed a condensed Protective Gang Qi Shield.
At the same time, his hands waved continuously with the Iron Bone Claw!
Condensing furious claws in front of him!
But it was useless!
The ’eighty-meter-long saber,’ infused with the power of two Divine Forms, was fiercely overwhelming!
Slashing all the way down!
Its speed was too fast for the naked eye to discern!
In less than half a breath, it had already descended!
The newly condensed furious claws weren’t even fully formed before being effortlessly sliced apart, then with a booming sound, it landed on the Protective Gang Qi Shield, crack!
The eighty-meter-long saber cleaved into the shield.
The shield lasted only a moment before shattering easily.
Boom!
The sword beam struck Wude!
Wude barely managed to avoid his vital points, but in the next moment, splat!
The sword beam cut off his left arm.
Splat!
Blood gushed out.
Wude screamed in agony, flying back dozens of meters, shouting loudly:
"Wait, I surrender!"
"Heh!"
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, thinking that once a battle has started, how can it be stopped at will?
Phoenix Island, Xu Fu.
Ding Ling finally remembered who Wude was.
Xu Fu was Emperor Shitian!
This Emperor Shitian, finding life boring, masqueraded as a righteous person under the alias Xu Fu on Phoenix Island and took in a few disciples.
Wude was the senior disciple among them.
He consumed a pill given by Emperor Shitian, extending his life by a hundred years, so although Wude looked young now, he was already over a hundred years old!
His skills obviously reached the Transformation Realm!
According to the original plot, Xu Fu would have killed Wude to show his grandeur, but with the interference of players, secrets were no longer secrets, so Xu Fu took Wude in for his own use!
After all, Wude was insidious and vicious enough, suitable to act as a pawn for the Celestial Sect.
Having thought it through.
How could Ding Ling hold back?

Regardless of whether Wude struck first just to spar, two undeniable facts were that Ding Ling had killed the Ice Emperor, the Divine General, and was a mortal enemy of the Celestial Sect, and Wude had just tried to kill him.
So how could Ding Ling hold back?
Thus, regardless of Wude’s words,
Ding Ling’s sword did not pause.
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
A Chilling Glance!
Ding Ling used no other technique, just this fast enough sword technique.
One slash after another.
In an instant, he slashed out six times!
Six sword beams manifested in the void, merging in a grid shape, pressing down towards Wude and Taiyi.
The two had nowhere to hide, avoided or evade!
The eighty-meter-long sword. Six slashes, blocking all retreat and escape routes.
Plus, its speed was like lightning!
The two could not escape!
They could only roar in unison, activating all their skills, unleashing their strongest moves in an attempt to break this blockade.
’Iron Bone Claw!’
’Dry Ice Palm!’
One poured all his power into his right hand, delivering an all-out blow with the Iron Bone Claw, condensing into a bleeding furious claw, grabbing toward the sword beams!
One stood in place, continuously striking with his palms, making the world tremble, condensing into massive frosty palms, hitting towards the sword beams!
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The sword beams collided fiercely with the Iron Bone Claw and Dry Ice Palm in the void for just a moment.
Then cut through the furious claw and frosty giant palm as easily as pressing a mountain on an egg.
With lightning speed!
Quickly slashing down!
Splat!
Splat!
Two crisp sounds echoed across the Celestial Extreme.
Upon a closer look, Taiyi and Wude had already been cleaved into two, flipping over on the ground, on the brink of death.
Ding Ling executed the Free-Will Ascension Step, Shrinking Inches, and appeared before the two in a blink, using the Dragon Capturing Skill, and grabbed their broken bodies in midair.
Activated the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
Whoosh whoosh!
Rolling True Qi poured into the Dantian, quickly refining into strands of Longevity True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In just a moment of effort.
The True Qi of the two Grandmaster-level experts was completely drained.
Wude and Taiyi stared wide-eyed at Ding Ling, dying with unfulfilled wishes!
Wude’s face and eyes were filled with resentment, frustration, unwillingness, pain, and regret, emotions as complex as could be.
Taiyi, on the other hand, was mostly bewildered and confused.
Apparently, he couldn’t understand up until his death that he only came out to be a ’spokesperson,’ yet suddenly a fight broke out!
And he was implicated and killed!
[Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: Overpower Wude.]
[Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: Overpower Taiyi.]

[Note: The two came to you at the behest of Xu Fu (Emperor Shitian). Wude looked down on you, faced you with a playful attitude to spar, but was unexpectedly killed effortlessly by you! Even unto death, he was puzzled!
He couldn’t believe, and was even more shocked, that someone so young as you could possess such power and skills!

He died with open eyes! At one point he suspected you might also be an ancient monster, hundreds or even thousands of years old! Otherwise, how could someone with such terrifying skill be killed by you so easily?]
Gaining two D-level Achievement Medals.
This was indeed an unexpected delight.
For being able to easily kill these two extraordinary masters, Ding Ling was not surprised at all.
The tenfold amplification of the Divine Form Power was much stronger than ever before.
Besides, he was already a High-tier Grandmaster!
Under tenfold amplification.
It was equivalent to ten High-tier Grandmasters striking the two.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 610: Perfected Realm
paragraphs: Though Wu De and Tai Yi are strong, how can they withstand the tenfold increase of the Proud Cold Six Formulas?!
They were easily killed.
It is as normal as can be.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have earned Nie Feng’s profound admiration.]
[Annotation: Your power leaves Nie Feng utterly shocked! He has once again deeply realized the absolute disparity in strength between you two! He regards you as a Celestial Being!]
Nie Feng had acquired one before.
Now he has acquired another.
It seems that the achievement medals here with Nie Feng are unlikely to occur anymore in the future.
Ding Ling was indifferent.
He casually flipped over Wu De and Tai Yi’s clothes, and as expected, there were things on their bodies.
Ding Ling grabbed a pouch and three scrolls from mid-air.
Among them, the pouch and two scrolls were discovered from Wu De’s embrace.
Ding Ling didn’t dawdle.
He directly opened the pouch for a look.
Inside were sharp hidden weapons.
The hidden weapons were of purple blood color.
They had grooves.
They resembled a miniature four-sided sword.
"Could it be that these are Wu De’s Purple Blood Needle?"
Wu De was adept at deploying the Purple Blood Needle as a hidden weapon.

Yet in the battle with Ding Ling just now, due to the saber techniques being so swift, and the saber light falling and crushing too fiercely, he didn’t even have the time or opportunity to take out the Purple Blood Needle from his embrace before being slain.
But even if he had taken out the Purple Blood Needle, it would be useless against Ding Ling.
The most toxic part of the Purple Blood Needle is just a bit at its tip.
And Ding Ling is immune to all poisons.
This measly toxin is of no harm to him.
Nonetheless, this Purple Blood Needle hidden weapon is evidently quite admirable, so Ding Ling casually put it away.
He looked at the other three scrolls.
He opened one.
The first three words that came into view made Ding Ling’s heart skip a beat.
These three words were none other than the Holy Heart Technique!
"Emperor Shitian actually gave Wu De the Holy Heart Technique?!"
Ding Ling found it somewhat incredible, until he skimmed through it roughly:
"It’s actually a fragmented heart technique of the Holy Heart Technique."
Ding Ling quickly scanned through.
[Holy Heart Technique (fragmented) - Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +150]
Surging Primordial Spirit energy came rushing in.
Ding Ling instinctively operated the Eternal Youth Technique, only to find it couldn’t be refined.
After a short while.
A particularly unique Holy Heart True Qi emerged within his Dantian.
This True Qi bore wings, with tail wings, and when it spread them, it resembled a phoenix.
Moreover, the healing power of this True Qi was extremely strong.
Wherever it passed.
It could soothe all disturbances.
Its ability to mediate was top-notch.

"It is rumored the Holy Heart Technique can render the cultivator immortal, bring them back to life; I used to have doubts, but now it seems if the non-fragmented Holy Heart Technique reached full level, the inherent Holy Heart True Qi indeed possesses the power to prolong life.

Of course, the premise is that it must be full level, and this Holy Heart True Qi must be sufficiently abundant, otherwise, if the Holy Heart True Qi is lacking, how much can life expectancy actually extend?"

"It’s unfortunate that the inner power heart technique of the Holy Heart Technique is fragmented; if it were complete, reaching full level, it would definitely be top-tier inner power heart technique, comparable to the Demon Scripture."
Ding Ling put the scroll into his storage pouch.
He picked up the other two scrolls once again.
He opened them one by one.
Among these two scrolls, there was also a scroll of the fragmented Holy Heart Technique, identical to the previous one.
And this fragmented scroll came from Tai Yi.
No need to say.
Xu Fu certainly granted the same reward to both of them.
Ding Ling looked at the last scroll.
It clearly recorded the martial arts heart technique content of the Dry Ice Palm.
Ding Ling quickly finished reading.
[Dry Ice Palm - Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
This is evidently a shattering initial tier palm technique, comparable to Celestial Destiny Sword Dao and Black Tortoise Divine Palm.
Ding Ling swiftly mastered it to full level.
Thus, he knew how strong this palm technique was.
Even compared to the complete version of Celestial Frost Fist, it was superior by more than a notch!
Whoosh whoosh!
The Extreme Cold Martial Dao True Intent surging out of Ding Ling’s body kept swirling, finally retreating into Ding Ling’s body amidst the whooshing sound.
With the mastery of Dry Ice Palm.
Ding Ling’s understanding and control of extreme cold, utmost cold deepened further.
"That Wu De actually possessed the scroll of Dry Ice Palm’s secret manual, needless to say, either he learned it illicitly, or Tai Yi gave it to him. As for why Tai Yi gave it?"
Ding Ling found this impossible to comprehend.
But no matter what.
He had obtained the benefits and was disinclined to ponder the rationale.
He softly closed his eyes.
Carefully sensed himself.
He had just absorbed as much as 1000 Inner Power Value from Wu De.
And 700 from Tai Yi.
Not comparable to the 1500 and 1600 from Divine General and Ice Emperor.
The root cause.
Naturally, lies in that the two’s strength fell short of Ice Emperor and Divine General.

Furthermore, Wu De and Tai Yi spent all their energy in a desperate final strike, consuming a lot of True Qi, and were chopped into pieces by Ding Ling, causing their True Qi to disperse more swiftly.
So in the end, Ding Ling absorbed this much Inner Power Value.
But even so.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
This was much quicker than consuming Great Medicine.
After absorbing these two’s True Qi.
Ding Ling’s Dantian gained as many as 17 Longevity True Qi.
Combining with the earlier Longevity True Qi, it finally amassed into 6 drops of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 51 points]
"Great Perfection at Grandmaster level!"
Ding Ling never expected advancing in Grandmaster level to be so challenging.
Only complete at 51 points!
This shows that the disparity among Grandmasters is as vast as an abyss.
Grandmaster at Great Perfection can easily crush initial tier Grandmaster experts!
"It seems the more progress in martial arts, the greater the gap between each rank becomes!"
At early stages of martial arts.
Initial tier, middle tier, high tier differences are not very big.
But as progression continues, the gap may appear small, but compared to earlier ones, the difference is vast. Unfathomable.
"Reaching Grandmaster at Great Perfection, fewer people in this world can withstand me!"
Ding Ling’s confidence soared.
Nie Feng was left completely stunned beside him.
The whole person was dumbfounded!

Ding Ling’s mastery of the Proud Cold Six Formulas he heard from his father, but Ding Ling’s Proud Cold Six Formulas were so aggressive that it left a profound impact on him! He couldn’t help but produce an absurd thought in his mind: Was the Proud Cold Six Formulas really the Nie family’s family heirloom saber technique, or the Ding family’s?
No wonder he thought so.
It’s simply because his father’s Proud Cold Six Formulas, and including his own, were too far apart from Ding Ling’s!
It felt like Ding Ling’s Proud Cold Six Formulas was the authentic one.
And what they learned seemed fake!
Besides this.
The sight of Ding Ling flipping through the scrolls, secret manuals, and instantly mastering them to Great Perfection was also captured by him, causing his eyes to twitch continuously, exclaiming:
"The talent of the Venerable Lord is truly inhuman!"
If quickly mastering the Ten Strong Martial Dao was merely luck, or inherent compatibility with the Ten Strong Martial Dao.
Then how to explain now mastering the enemy’s palm and inner power heart techniques so swiftly?
All that’s left to say is.
His Venerable Lord, is one with unprecedented talent, grand beyond belief, a prodigy!
He is a myth set to ascend!
He is a star on the rise, a true dazzling sun!

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 611: Wind God Leg Full Level
paragraphs: Nie Feng was completely in awe of Ding Ling.
He wholeheartedly believed and agreed with his father’s evaluation of Ding Ling.

Despite Ding Ling’s youth, his martial prowess was extraordinary, cutting down the peerless masters before Nie Feng as effortlessly as slicing vegetables. Nie Feng gasped in amazement, his heart filled with shock, admiration, and boundless excitement.
"Such a Venerable Lord. Too powerful!"
Ding Ling took a long breath and opened his eyes.
He glanced around.

In the dense forest surrounding him, on the wide avenue to the right, many masters were watching from afar. As Ding Ling gazed in their direction, these masters instantly snapped out of their stunned, bewildered state, and with a loud bang, scattered like startled animals!
These masters had retreated early from Lingyun Cave to encircle Ding Ling and Nie Feng and seize the benefits of the Ten Strong Martial Dao from their hands.
The aliens knew many secrets, and their words were considered highly credible.
This was a fact known by many native masters.
And the aliens said that Nie Feng and Ding Ling had most likely obtained the benefits of Ten Directions Invincible.
Naturally, they approached with the mindset that they should rather believe it is true rather than risk missing out.

However, Ding Ling’s recent battle with Wude and Taiyi shattered their perceptions, frightening them into a cold sweat. When Ding Ling looked over, they were scared out of their wits, and hurriedly fled at full speed.
It was that previous battle.
They deeply realized the absolute gap between themselves and Ding Ling.
"Too strong. It feels like he could easily wipe me out with a single slash ten times, a hundred times!"
"I have the same feeling, and we foolishly thought to encircle him? Fortunately, we didn’t act, or we would have ended up like those two masters earlier!"
The masters discussed amongst themselves, their hearts shaken, faces full of terror and lingering fear.
Wude and Taiyi’s strength already made them look up in awe!
And Ding Ling instantly killing these two experts.
Made them feel as if witnessing the frantic rise of a legend, a myth!

"How can there be such a powerful person in the world?! Originally, I thought my Grandmaster cultivation could dominate the Ten Directions Realm. Now it seems I am still too weak. In front of this Ding Ling youth, I am simply powerless!"
The masters were thoroughly intimidated by Ding Ling.
They all fled for their lives, faster than rabbits.
[E-level Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Sword Demon]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Sword Greed.]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Ao Tian.]

[Note: Your battle with Wude and Taiyi made earth-shaking waves, leaving all witnesses stunned and horrified! They felt such an overwhelming gap between you and themselves that they had no courage to confront you and fled in droves.]
The dense sound of prompts rose.
Ding Ling observed the rapidly escaping individuals, and after a moment of reflection, understood the reason.
He did not pursue these people.
Just glanced at the prompt messages,
Obtained 3 E-level medals.
Gained 11 ordinary ones.
Needless to say.
There were indeed many strong people among these spectators.
But compared to Wude, Ice Emperor, and others, they were not comparable at all.
Landing in Ding Ling’s hands, their fate was to be instantly killed.
Ding Ling naturally had no interest in chasing down these people.
He called out to Nie Feng, and continued on the road.
This time they were heading to Unrivaled City, quite a distance away.
Throughout the journey, Ding Ling constantly guided Nie Feng in practicing Black Tortoise True Skill, Ten Strong Martial Dao, Proud Cold Six Formulas.
Causing Nie Feng’s martial arts cultivation to soar continuously.
He was a once-in-a-millennium peerless genius, and once enlightened, his cultivation speed was rapid, not comparable to ordinary people.

Previously, the Wind God Leg he practiced, along with its accompanying Internal Power, was already extraordinary, but compared to Black Tortoise True Skill, Ten Strong Martial Dao, it was far inferior.
Now successfully transitioning to Black Tortoise True Skill.
Nie Feng’s True Qi level instantly elevated to a higher level, and his cultivation continued to grow day by day.
Therefore.

When Ding Ling mentioned wanting to see Nie Feng’s Wind God Leg mantra technique, Nie Feng only hesitated briefly before revealing the Wind God Leg’s mantra, techniques, and accompanying Internal Power Heart Technique.
In Nie Feng’s view.

He was no longer a member of the World Association, and no longer had a mentor relationship with Xiong Ba, who had always been using him and indirectly killed Kong Ci and others, and now intends to kill him and Bu Jingyun!
Nie Feng is not a fool, realizing this, then thinking about Ding Ling’s help to him, his father’s evaluation of Ding Ling.
More importantly, Ding Ling was still his Venerable Lord.
He really couldn’t think of a reason to refuse!
Ding Ling listened carefully.
[Wind God Leg Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Wind God Leg External Heart Method Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Instantly at full level.
Rushing Primordial Qi surged in, engulfing Ding Ling.
The Eternal Youth Technique rapidly operated, and in an instant, transformed the Spiritual Vitality, making an additional thread of Longevity True Qi appear in his Dantian.
Unquestionably.
The Wind God Leg was similarly flawed.
Only the first six moves existed: Chasing Shadows, Wind-Resistant Grass, Torrential Rain and Strong Wind, Thunderous Wind, Wind-Rolling Ruins, Divine Wind Roar.
Ding Ling mentioned the flaw in the Wind God Leg.
Nie Feng regained composure from the shock and said:
"I’ve been aware of this for a long time. But I don’t have the final move, and I don’t know exactly what it is."
Ding Ling instantly mastered the Wind God Leg.
Nie Feng thought about how he had studied the Wind God Leg for many years.
While Ding Ling achieved Great Perfection instantly.
He couldn’t help but feel distressed.

But he quickly picked himself up, thinking that as his father said, someone as rare as the Venerable Lord might only exist in this era. Comparing oneself to such a prodigious talent has no meaning, not to mention it would cause frustration, which would be a rather unwise thing.
"When the opportunity arises, we could have Xiong Ba tell us the final move of the Wind God Leg."
Nie Feng was speechless, but thinking of Ding Ling’s skills and martial arts, he nodded and said:

"Although Xiong Ba is extremely powerful, compared to you, Venerable Lord, he is far inferior. Even Wude easily defeated Xiong Ba. You might not even need a single strike to defeat Xiong Ba. If he wants to survive, he might indeed tell you all the secrets of the Wind God Leg."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"In that case, we’ll visit the World Association sometime."
Nie Feng’s eyes lit up, feeling quite thrilled, he nodded in agreement.
Xiong Ba always said "Success and failure both lie in Fengyun!"
Nie Feng really wanted to see what Xiong Ba’s expression and thoughts would be when defeated by the Venerable Lord!
On that day.
Ding Ling and Nie Feng arrived at an inn in a small town.
They had just finished their meal.
As they stepped out of the inn’s front door.
A man appeared before them, full of spirit, with a refined appearance, wearing a gray robe, looking around fifty years old.

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 612: Emperor Shitian
paragraphs: Ding Ling and Nie Feng saw the man walking toward the direction of the inn, and stepped aside.
Unexpectedly, the man also followed suit and moved to the side.
Ding Ling thought it was a coincidence and moved to the other side.
The man nonchalantly arrived at the other side as well.
His speed seemed slow but was actually fast, like instant teleportation, hard to discern by the naked eye.
The technique used to block Ding Ling was profoundly subtle, ordinary people would find it hard to detect.
Ding Ling’s pupils contracted, but he was the first to notice the anomaly.
And he knew that the visitor must have come for him.
He stopped and looked at the man, saying:
"Who are you? Why are you blocking me?"
"Heh heh."
The visitor stroked the three wisps of long beard under his jaw, looked Ding Ling up and down, and laughed, "You must be Ding Ling?"
’Indeed.’
"You truly have an impressive appearance, with a restrained overbearing aura. No wonder you were once an emperor in the Lower Realm."
The man laughed heartily while holding his waist, but in an instant, his face turned grim, squinting his eyes slightly, looking down on Ding Ling:
"I sent someone to invite you, if you don’t want to come, fine, but you actually dared to attack my disciple! I have no choice. I can only come personally to invite you."
Suddenly, his aura was released.
A vast power transformed into a storm sweeping in all directions.
Where it passed.
Buildings collapsed with a rumble;
Passers-by screamed as they were blown away.
A large tree on the left was swaying unstably under this overwhelming wind force, seemingly ready to be uprooted anytime!
Nie Feng’s expression changed dramatically, using the Wind God Leg, like a gust, stepping on the wild wind to rescue each child, woman, and elderly blown away and place them in a safe area.
No matter how fast he was, he couldn’t save everyone; some strong men survived their fall, but the elderly and children did not, so Nie Feng first rescued the weaker ones.
Ding Ling activated the Profound Skill and Breathing Technique, standing rooted like a tree, he was taller than the man, slightly looking down at him, and said:
"Should I call you Xu Fu or Emperor Shitian?"
"Haha. As you wish!"
The man looked with peculiar interest, laughed out loud, "Such boldness. No wonder you dared to kill my useless disciples!"
Suddenly, he withdrew his laughter, speaking in a deep voice:
"Since you know I, Xu Fu, am the Emperor Shitian of the Celestial Sect, you still dare to kill! How bold you are!"
He glared at Ding Ling, his eyes wide open, staring at Ding Ling, his voice sometimes heavy, sometimes erratic, sometimes with laughter, sometimes with Evil Qi.
His appearance changed with his voice alike.
Mysteriously unpredictable in a short time.
Like a schizophrenic.
Severely neurotic!
Ding Ling’s complexion slightly altered, he didn’t expect the visitor to indeed be Emperor Shitian, encountering this lunatic so soon was somewhat beyond his expectations.
He truly didn’t expect this behind-the-scenes boss to come forth personally!

Though thinking of Wude, Divine Generals, Ice Emperor as his top subordinates, almost all of whom were killed by him, maybe Emperor Shitian had no one to employ, or deemed no one could confront him, Ding Ling, hence why he personally stepped in?
Ding Ling became enlightened, then said:
"I wonder what Emperor Shitian wants to invite me to Phoenix Island for?"
"Heh heh."

Emperor Shitian restrained his anger, chuckled while stroking his beard, "I am conducting an experiment, desperately needing a genius like you for assistance, after surveying the Jiuzhou Land, you, Ding Ling, are the most suitable, so I dispatched Wude and Taiyi to invite you.
Unexpectedly, they’re so useless.
Not only couldn’t invite you.
But lost their lives. Truly an embarrassment for me. At over a hundred years old, yet can’t defeat you, a mere boy! Shouldn’t they die? Aren’t they hateful? Shouldn’t I be angry?"
He chuckled:
"Thus, such trash dying is good. Saves me from seeing them and getting annoyed."
He looked Ding Ling up and down, clicked his tongue in admiration:

"So young and yet your skill has reached the Transformation Realm. Seems you’ve also cultivated Divine Form Power, impressive, truly impressive. I desperately need a young talent like you as an assistant."
He paced back and forth, rubbing his hands, eagerly looking at Ding Ling, saying:
"Young man, come, help me. If you assist me, I’ll make you the Vice Sect Leader of the Celestial Sect, allowing you to be the absolute ruler below one and above thousands in this world.
Even I can pass my Holy Heart Technique to you."
He waved his hand, various vivid illusion beasts formed from True Qi in his hand out of thin air:

"See that? This is the True Qi of the Holy Heart Technique. Once mastered, achieving immortality, resurrecting the dead, are simple tasks. With your high talents, cultivating my Holy Heart Technique, you can attain immortality like me.
Then, live for thousands of years, you would be the true Deity still alive."
He sighed:
"I live in this world too lonely. I need a god to accompany me."
"Don’t you know about Xiaao Sanxiaao’s existence?"
Ding Ling questioned frankly:
"Emperor Shitian, have you acted so much that you’ve touched yourself?
Emperor Shitian’s face darkened, said:

"Xiaao Sanxiaao is unpredictable, he’s not like me! We could only be enemies, how could we be friends! Only recently did I know of his existence, that’s why I am urgently seeking an ally. And after examining this Jiuzhou, only you, Ding Ling, perfectly meet my criteria! Only you could quickly master the Holy Heart Technique and subsequently become a god!"
His voice rose, seemingly excited and thrilled:
"Once you become a god. Then join forces with me, kill Xiaao Sanxiaao, that old undying, haha. I can strip out his Dragon Turtle Blood alive.
The efficacy of this Dragon Turtle Blood is not much less than Phoenix Blood."
At this point.
He suddenly fixed his eyes on Ding Ling, his voice erratic, hard to determine his current mindset:
"Ding Ling, you wouldn’t refuse me, would you?"
"You pass me the Holy Heart Technique, and I’ll cooperate with you."
Ding Ling’s full-level acting activated, becoming extremely sincere:
"I, Ding Ling, a spit like a nail. As long as you, Emperor Shitian, don’t go back on your word, naturally, I don’t have a reason to back out."
"Venerable Lord!"
Nie Feng was somewhat anxious.
Who is Emperor Shitian?
On the way, he heard quite a few rumors.
Long been aware.
Just a pervert, a lunatic!
Cooperating with such a person?
Wouldn’t that be like seeking skin from a tiger?
Nie Feng naturally doesn’t want his Venerable Lord to ally with such a person.
Ding Ling gestured for Nie Feng to calm down.
Only then did Nie Feng quiet down, standing atop a wind cluster, watching Emperor Shitian nervously, always ready to start fighting.
As for the inn’s guests, the owner, and others, they had long run away frightened.
Even those with courage who hadn’t run.
Under Nie Feng’s indication, they also scattered and fled far.
At this moment.
Within a few miles, aside from Ding Ling, there was no one else.
The girls and elderly who fled slowly were directly carried by Nie Feng using Wind God Leg to faraway places.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 613: Negotiation
paragraphs: This was originally a small town.
There weren’t many people here.
Now everyone near the inn had fled, making the small town eerily quiet.
The only sound was the wind stirred by Emperor Shitian’s released Qi.
It could be said that all was silent, and you could hear a pin drop.
Whoosh!
Even the sound of each other’s breathing was crystal clear.
The soft thud of spinning leaves falling to the ground sounded like thunder in the ears.
Nie Feng’s heart was in his throat as he watched Emperor Shitian and Ding Ling without daring to blink.
"Oh?"
Emperor Shitian circled Ding Ling a couple of times with a pensive look and suddenly asked:
"You killed the Divine General and the Ice Emperor, right?"
"Who are the Divine General and Ice Emperor?"
Ding Ling was bewildered.
Ding Ling’s acting was like a textbook performance, perfect and natural.
Even the skilled actor Emperor Shitian wasn’t sure if Ding Ling was acting, he just looked at Ding Ling with some suspicion and uncertainty and said:

"This is baffling. The Ice Emperor and Divine General have disappeared with no news of return. Later, I sent people to Lingyun Cave to investigate and gather evidence. After careful analysis, I guessed that the likelihood that you killed them was high. You now say you didn’t kill them. Then who did?"
"I don’t even know who the Divine General and Ice Emperor are, how could I have killed them?"
Ding Ling’s expression was calm and composed:
"Emperor Shitian, are you going to teach me the Holy Heart Technique or not?"
"Don’t be in such a hurry."
Emperor Shitian chuckled:
"I want to tell you, whether or not you killed the Ice Emperor and the Divine General, I’ve decided I want you to be the Vice Sect Leader of my Celestial Sect."
He glanced at Ding Ling with admiration:

"Your acting skill is impressive. Although I don’t have enough evidence to prove you killed the Ice Emperor and Divine General, from some clues and others’ words, it’s not hard to conclude that you did kill them.
It doesn’t matter if you don’t admit it.
After all, those two were not my trusted aides. I wanted them dead long ago, but thought it would be a waste to just kill them because they were strong, so I decided to use them for my own benefit.
If I could tolerate someone like the traitor Ice Emperor, why wouldn’t I take in someone with high potential like you, Ding Ling?"
He smiled at Ding Ling:
"I just want to show you how much I value you, to make you understand that even if you killed those two, it’s all right."

At this moment, he seemed to become more benevolent: "I hope we can eliminate these unnecessary misunderstandings and barriers, to get along harmoniously and cooperate amicably! Ding Ling, do you understand my good intentions now?"
Ding Ling was speechless.
But he had to admit that Emperor Shitian personally dealing with someone like this.
For ordinary people, it would be hard to resist, and they might bow and call him Sect Leader.
But Ding Ling was different. He had traveled across many worlds and had developed a strong pride. If it’s not someone he respects and acknowledges, it’s extremely difficult for him to bow.
Of course, if it’s just an act, it’s another matter. But the act now has been seen through by Emperor Shitian, so there’s no need to continue.
But to give up on the Holy Heart Technique, Ding Ling was unwilling, so he wanted to try and see if he could succeed.
"If you truly value me and genuinely want to cooperate amicably, teach me the Holy Heart Technique."
"Okay."
Emperor Shitian paced back and forth for a while, then suddenly stopped and pulled out a scroll from his pocket for Ding Ling:
’This is the Holy Heart Technique.’
Ding Ling wasn’t going to be polite with Emperor Shitian, and immediately took it and started to read.
But soon.
He was disappointed:
"I already have this half-scroll."
He returned the scroll to Emperor Shitian.
"Oh? I forgot, you killed Wude and Taiyi, those two."
Emperor Shitian suddenly realized and chuckled:
"Sorry about that. I only have this half-scroll with me now."
"You can orally describe the other half."
"I don’t have the habit of orally describing."
"You lack the sincerity for cooperation."
"I’ve come to see you personally."
Emperor Shitian was taken aback, incredulously:
"I’ve already pardoned you for the great sins of killing Wude, Taiyi, the Ice Emperor, and the Divine General. Do you still think this sincerity isn’t enough?"
Even though Ding Ling didn’t admit to killing the Ice Emperor and Divine General.
Emperor Shitian still placed the blame on Ding Ling.
It was evident that his intelligence network had already been effective, surely detecting something.
"Wude attempted to kill me. I don’t think there was anything wrong with killing him."
As for killing the Ice Emperor and Divine General.
That was even more justified.
Ding Ling didn’t say this last part.
"But they were my disciples after all."
Emperor Shitian smiled as he said the first half of the sentence, then suddenly his face darkened, and he demandingly asked:
"Ding Ling, don’t refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. I’ll ask you one last time, will you go to Phoenix Island? Will you be my Celestial Sect’s Vice Sect Leader or not?!
"Emperor Shitian, are you trying to force me?"
Ding Ling said without anger, calm and unperturbed:
"Weren’t we supposed to cooperate amicably?"
Emperor Shitian was just a madman.
He treats all beings like chess pieces or playthings.
If it weren’t for Xiaao Sanxiaao’s existence alerting him, Ding Ling reckoned he would still be preparing for the great dragon-slaying endeavor years in the making.
Now that he has appeared early.
Apart from the arrival of the alien, it’s mostly Xiaao Sanxiaao’s existence that unsettles him.
He is no longer the one and only god in the world!
He naturally would have a sense of crisis.

But such a person, Ding Ling wouldn’t believe his words, with five out of ten sentences being lies, and Ding Ling being adept at the Observing People Skill and acting, even though Emperor Shitian disguised himself well.
But Ding Ling had long seen through him.
Emperor Shitian was deceiving him.
The goal was to trick him into going to Phoenix Island.
As for what to do after going to Phoenix Island?
Ding Ling did not know.
But it surely would be a matter of life and death out of one’s control, likely being manipulated by Emperor Shitian.

After all, Emperor Shitian surely knew that he was the first among the aliens, and knowing that aliens can log in and out anytime, he wanted to kill him, trap him in one place, that would be the safest way.
This was probably the reason Emperor Shitian was willing to suppress his thoughts and try to persuade or convince him.
The purpose was to trick him into going to Phoenix Island.
But knowing that he was being deceived, how could Ding Ling fall for it?
"Amicable. Of course, we need to be amicable."
Emperor Shitian laughed loudly, then suddenly his eyes gathered a dazzling light, which concentrated into two icy glances, shooting towards Ding Ling’s position!
Holy Heart Technique!
Shocking Gaze Tribulation!
Once this tribulation emerged, it seemed that the void was frozen.
The breathtaking gaze penetrated the void, directly targeting Ding Ling’s heart and soul, seeming intent on shattering Ding Ling’s spirit and freezing Ding Ling’s thoughts!
Ding Ling had long been on guard against Emperor Shitian. At the moment Emperor Shitian initiated the Shocking Gaze Tribulation, he also quickly drew his saber, angrily slashing at the icy glances!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Clouds Breaking Through the Blue Sky!

This saber strike gathered all of Ding Ling’s abilities, not to mention the infusion of Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique, the power of Divine Form, the strength from the Black Tortoise True Skill, and Ten Directions Invincible!

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 614: Ding Ling vs. Master of the Celestial Gate
paragraphs: Momentarily, a thirtyfold surge!
A spectacular saber, a hundred meters long, materialized in the void, slicing toward the tangible icy gaze with a thunderous roar.
With this slash, crackling and popping!
The gaze and the saber light violently collided in the void for merely an instant.
The saber light, with unstoppable momentum, shattered the gaze and slashed at Emperor Shitian, instantly severing his arm.
Emperor Shitian let out a miserable scream.
He grabbed the severed arm in mid-air, employed Shrinking Inches, and retreated violently a hundred meters.
He stood afar, attaching the arm back to his body, looking at Ding Ling with great suspicion:
"Ten Strong Martial Dao?! Are you Wu Wudi’s heir?!"
From Emperor Shitian’s sudden attack.
To Emperor Shitian’s arm being sliced off and his violent retreat.
This all happened in the blink of an eye, faster than lightning, leaving Nie Feng stunned, unable to react as the first exchange ended.
The speed, truly like thunder and lightning, was just too quick!
Nie Feng shuddered, sensing that should he intervene in this fight, he would be instantly shattered to pieces, without the slightest chance of survival.

Seeing Ding Ling’s gesture, indicating him to stay back, Nie Feng decisively utilized Wind God Leg to run far away; this level of combat was beyond his interference; his best course of action was not to hold anyone back.
Meanwhile.
Player spectators in some secluded corners.
These players were numerous, present in this small city on their way to Unrivaled City, witnessing the battle between Emperor Shitian and Ding Ling, dumbfounded and their blood boiling.
Many guessed at who might ultimately prevail and some even began gambling over it.
"Hmph."
Ding Ling was decisive in his lethal actions, once engaged, there was no stopping.
After one slash.
He without hesitation unleashed another slash!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Sky Dome Fury!

This slash was the strongest of the No-Two Blade Technique, amalgamating the strength of Black Tortoise True Skill and Ten Directions Invincible, infused with Divine Form Power, vividly inscribed on both sides of the saber. As the saber light cleaved out, the world trembled and Heaven and Earth roared. This slash seemed to harness the power of the world!
The instant the saber light emerged.
The entire Sky Dome appeared to compress downward, emanating an unavoidable, unstoppable grandiose and vastness.
"Indeed, it’s Ten Strong Martial Dao!
Emperor Shitian, bewildered, yet acted swiftly, thrusting both palms to unleash a raging Frost Storm that rolled toward the hundred-meter saber.
Ka-cha!

At the collision between storm and saber, it felt like a giant axe cleaving a mountain. The two sides clashed briefly, and then the storm was noisily shattered in Emperor Shitian’s fear-stricken gaze, ka-cha ka-cha!
The storm was obliterated!
The saber’s force swiftly cleaved downward, targeting the vulnerability at Emperor Shitian’s head.
"Such a formidable Ten Directions Martial Dao. This must have reached the Transformation Realm!"

Emperor Shitian screamed sharply, no longer composed, his form swiftly changing in the void, executing Free-Will Ascension Step flawlessly, appearing like phantoms skimming through the void, shifting dozens of positions in a blink, retreating a hundred meters.
Rumble!
The hundred-meter saber light descended, slicing through a three-story pavilion, instantly splitting it apart; the buildings, trees, mounds, and rockeries behind it were all halved by this slash.
The saber’s might was ferocious beyond words.
As if nothing could block its path.
Ding Ling, calm and composed, his clothes flapping in the fierce wind, decisively unleashed yet another slash after the first.
No-Two Blade Technique!
Mountain City Torrential Rain!

This was the swiftest slash, transforming most rapidly and expediently, following the strongest stroke Sky Dome Fury, upon exhausting old force and before new force arises. This transition was timely!
As this slash cut forth.
Instantly.
A dense array of hundred-meter saber lights filled the sky, like pouring rain!
Forming characters like ’井’ and ’田’, oppressing toward Emperor Shitian.
Emperor Shitian was instantly cornered, with his paths of advance and retreat blocked, only left to confront head-on.
His face changed dramatically, issuing a long howl.
Rapidly forming seals with both hands!
Following his shout!
Holy Heart Technique!
Ten Thousand Ridges Piercing the Clouds!
The churning, surging frost and snow transformed into a swarm of blades, densely filling the void. With a wave, Emperor Shitian unleashed them like ferocious birds, crashing into the saber lights.
Crackling and popping!
Rumble!
Upon contact, the battle was instantly driven to a fever pitch!
Almost as if a fight to the death.
Both sides unleashed their ultimate techniques, back and forth.
Looking broadly.
Saber lights and blades crisscross and collide continuously in the small city, thunderous noises never ceasing.
Ding Ling and Emperor Shitian seemed like deities incarnate, battling in the skies, slicing and shattering clouds, fissures appearing in the void as if capable of tearing the dome of heaven.
Occasionally battling to the Earth Realm.
Where trees toppled and grass buckled, buildings crumbled, the earth shook and fractured, crisscrossed with cracks, as if cleansed by celestial fire and thunder, a devastated scene painful to behold.
Their battle.
Turned the small city into near ruins.
Alarmed, Nie Feng whisked away elderly and children to maintain safety.
Rumble!
Standing further away.
One could faintly see beneath the Sky Dome, two figures stirring endless storms, each clash resounding with thunder, involuntarily shaking one’s heart and spirit, scalp tingling uncontrollably.
"So powerful."
Nie Feng was dazed, muttering:

"This is truly the power of the divine! How can humans obstruct? I never thought that Venerable Lord’s godly might could reach such a level! Moreover, I never imagined the Celestial Sect’s Emperor Shitian to be so strong?!"
He couldn’t fathom who could withstand if such individuals decided to toy with someone?!
Thankfully, Venerable Lord is here!
"Terrifying!"
The players were startled, some failing to escape and being impacted, their bodies instantly disintegrated into ashes by the saber lights and lightning!
With no resistance at all.
Those not impacted fled in panic, only daring to glance back after running far, speaking fearfully:
"Has Ding Ling grown this powerful?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 615: Sword River in Torrential Flow
paragraphs: Ding Ling is very strong.
The players have long been aware of this.
Yet, no one ever expected Ding Ling to reach such an astounding level of power!
He truly seems like a deity in the mortal realm, unbelievably powerful!
"Could it be because of the Celestial Might blessing again?"
The Historical Plane world has the blessing of Celestial Might.
Since a player accidentally discovered this secret and shared it online, almost all players have come to know about it.
Some players then realized why Ding Ling was so powerful in the Three Kingdoms World.
They still hold Ding Ling in awe, but no longer fear him like a tiger.
However, witnessing the aftershocks of Ding Ling’s battle with Emperor Shitian, which could easily destroy the players’ bodies, they were once again shocked and terrified.
Because the power in the game world can synchronize with the real world!
If Ding Ling is this powerful in the real world, who can withstand his strike after strike?! Wouldn’t Ding Ling be a walking Death God?!
"So terrifying."
"Cultivating martial arts to such a level, simply unbeatable! If only I were as strong as Ding Ling, how great would that be?!"
The players were both fearful and longing, fervently excited.
Thinking of more expectations for the future!
Each one silently resolved to find a famous teacher, learn an Unparalleled Technique, become a Supreme Martial Artist, and become famous across the world!
Bang!
Bang bang bang!
The saber in Ding Ling’s hand had never stopped swinging, each slash faster than the last! The more he fought, the more fervent he became!
The more he fought, the more his combat power soared!
All of what he had learned began to slowly merge during the fierce battle with Emperor Shitian, although his thirtyfold power amplification was somewhat scattered before!

But during the fierce battle with Emperor Shitian, he was like a great hammer, constantly forging Ding Ling, making this thirtyfold amplified battle power more and more refined, now reached a solid and unbreakable state, as steady as a mountain!
If the previous thirtyfold amplification was like flowing water, elusive, and could collapse at any time.
The current thirtyfold amplification was like a mountain, a divine blade, heavy yet sharp, difficult to resist and collapse!
As Ding Ling kept swinging his saber.
The thirtyfold Power Amplification could be said to have been perfectly infused into the Sword Technique!
Making each move successfully unleash thirtyfold Power Amplification!

The Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique, the Divine Form Power, and the Ten Directions Invincible Power of Black Tortoise True Skill, were all intertwined and condensed into one at this moment like a hemp rope!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Draw Sword and Cut Water!

Ding Ling let out a long howl, slashing down, this slash seemed to cut through the Yangtze River and Yellow River, the splendid saber glow accompanied by a turbulent surging Sword Intent and Battle Intent, roared down! It was like the Celestial River pouring into the mortal world, ferocious and domineering to the extreme!
Emperor Shitian saw he couldn’t evade it!
He let out an angry roar!
Holy Heart Technique!
Emperor Heaven Frenzy Thunder!
Rumble! A multitude of ice shards transformed into rays of thunder, densely covering the void, starting to explode thunderously, blocking the surging saber light from slashing down!
However, Ding Ling’s combat power had reached its peak now, and fighting beyond his level was as easy and natural to him as eating and drinking!
He drew the Xuanyuan Sword, one hand with the saber, one hand with the sword.
Left-Right Mutual Struggle activated.
It was as if two people were using different techniques at the same time.
The saber in the right hand moved!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Unique and unrivaled!
The sword in the left hand was spinning!
Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Sword River Snow Surge!
With a slash from the right hand, an unprecedented Void Blade Light cut through the sky! This slash seemed to exist and not exist, elusive, even more difficult to imitate, unique, invincible with me!

The left hand thrust a sword, a river formed by the condensed sword light manifested in the void, in an instant this sword light gathered into falling snowflakes! Sword River, Snow Surge, flowing eastward, straight towards Emperor Shitian!
These two moves were launched simultaneously, encircling Emperor Shitian.
Emperor Shitian never expected Ding Ling could not only wield two weapons at once but also perfectly execute such Shattering Level Saber Technique and Sword Technique at the same time!
He was internally shocked and horrified, continuously activating and unleashing Holy Heart Technique, Emperor Heaven Frenzy Thunder, Ten Thousand Ridges Piercing the Clouds, rumble!
The saber light, sword rain, and thunder light were continuous.
Ding Ling, wielding a saber in one hand, a sword in the other, seamlessly switched and exerted force, as if two people were attacking Emperor Shitian at once.
Initially, Emperor Shitian could block one or two moves.
But after just a brief moment.
He was killed into a fluster, somewhat unable to cope.
One lapse.
Poof!
The topknot on his head was shattered by a Sword Technique move ’Who Carries Out the King’s Will’.
He felt a chill on his scalp, retreated a hundred meters, reaching up to touch and feeling a handful of blood.
His body slightly trembled, and his face twitched slightly.
The battle by now.
Had lasted for half an hour.
Ding Ling remained vigorous and lively, seemingly unharmed.
Yet he was covered in wounds, slashed by countless sabers and swords!
His whole body was in excruciating pain and soreness, how many years has it been?
Except for the last time with Wu Wudi, where he suffered a silent loss, this was the first time someone had injured him so!
"How long can you last?"
Emperor Shitian looked at Ding Ling suspiciously and uncertainly.

He only later realized Wu Wudi’s combat method couldn’t be sustained for long, although he was defeated by Wu Wudi and fled embarrassingly at the time, upon reflecting, meticulously deducing, he felt there was no way Wu Wudi could defeat him so effortlessly, almost chopping off his head!
After all, people’s battle intent could be boundless, but True Qi was finite, when True Qi was depleted, how could Wu Wudi kill him?
But now Ding Ling’s True Qi seemed to still be surging abundantly!
Moreover, with a tendency to become braver the more he fought.
This made Emperor Shitian somewhat doubt life:
"Could my previous deduction be wrong? Wu Wudi’s Black Tortoise True Skill and Ten Strong Martial Dao didn’t deplete True Qi that badly? Can last long?"
Thinking of this.
Emperor Shitian couldn’t help but feel the urge to retreat.
Unable to defeat Ding Ling.
Instead, being beaten and crushed by Ding Ling all the way.

Now his whole body was in pain, his arms had been severed three times. Although reattached, to achieve perfect recovery still required some time, that’s why when he saw Ding Ling let out a long howl, saber moves and sword moves coming one after another, increasingly fierce rushing towards him, the intention to retreat in his heart instantly surged to the peak.
He blocked and dodged Ding Ling’s sword and saber moves with full effort.

While trying to use the ’Godslaying Tribulation’ of the Holy Heart Technique experimentally, at the next moment! Boom! Winds and clouds changed, a huge human face appeared in the void, the face roared, raged, making the firmament seem to darken at this moment.
Whoosh whoosh!
Endless gales whistled.
Dark clouds covered the sky, blocking out the sun.
With the emergence of Godslaying Tribulation, heaven and earth seemed to fall into apocalypse at this moment.
Yet Ding Ling remained unflustered, drawing back his Consciousness Body to the side of the library, the speed at which he unleashed his saber moves and sword moves became faster and faster.
One slash after another, one thrust after another, like falling stars or meteors breaking through the sky, killing towards Emperor Shitian.
Seeing Ding Ling not defending, Emperor Shitian was revitalized, letting out a long laugh:
"See who dies first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 616: Full Level Godslaying Tribulation
paragraphs: Whoosh!
In the void, a giant human face instantly transformed into a stream of light and charged at Ding Ling! This face seemed both illusory and nonexistent, utterly unavoidable and inescapable.

In just a moment, it crashed into Ding Ling’s sea of consciousness. Just as the face was about to wreak havoc and shatter his consciousness body, a library buried deep within his sea of consciousness trembled slightly.
Boom!
The face disintegrated and shattered instantly, like ice and snow meeting a blazing fire.
"Ah!"
Emperor Shitian let out a scream, blood and tears streaming uncontrollably from his eyes. He looked at Ding Ling with terror:
"Why is your primordial spirit so powerful?!"
He had cultivated for over a thousand years, yet the Godslaying Tribulation technique he refined was shattered in an instant!
He felt as if his head had been hammered repeatedly, and his mind buzzed with chaos, as if it was about to explode.
This was the sign of the Godslaying Tribulation being broken.
A symptom of primordial spirit damage!

At that moment, Emperor Shitian’s sense of shock reached its peak, and he dared not hesitate further. He activated the Free-Will Ascension Step, using the full power of the Holy Heart Technique, transforming into a stream of light. In a flash, he disappeared into the void, flying over a hundred meters in an instant.
Ding Ling let out a long howl:
"Where do you think you’re going!"
With a sword in one hand and a knife in the other, he fiercely pursued Emperor Shitian for over a hundred miles before finally turning back.
"Huff, huff."
Ding Ling panted heavily after the battle; he had expended ninety percent of his true qi.
If the fight continued, the likelihood of him losing was quite high.
Emperor Shitian’s Holy Heart Technique’s endurance was exceptionally strong.
Moreover, Emperor Shitian’s martial strength was greater than Ding Ling’s.
Ding Ling was battling above his level.
Though he fought with increasing courage and strength, he had reached the end of his resources.

Had it not been for the library shattering the soul fragment that forcefully entered his sea of consciousness and scaring off Emperor Shitian, Ding Ling estimated that if the fight continued, he might have been exposed.
Had Emperor Shitian chosen not to flee, it would have been troublesome.
"Venerable Lord."
Nie Feng, using the Wind God Leg, approached Ding Ling like the wind, calling out respectfully.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced at Nie Feng, used the Wind God Leg, stepping as if on clouds, seemingly becoming the child of the wind, and left.
Nie Feng followed closely, guiding the way.
The direction they headed was Unrivaled City.
Due to the low true qi consumption and high speed of the Wind God Leg technique,
Ding Ling chose this lightweight skill for travel.
[Gained a D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Emperor Shitian (Xu Fu).]

[Note: Emperor Shitian intended to kill you while also taking down Xiaao Sanxiaao. He thought that by making the first move this time, he could surely succeed easily. However, unexpectedly, you were so fierce and powerful, comparable to Wu Wudi, or even better to some extent! This left him deeply shocked, particularly after one shred of his primordial spirit was shattered; he believed your primordial spirit was also extremely strong and dared not face you head-on again.]
Having heard the prompt sound,
Ding Ling glanced at the library.
After shattering one shred of Emperor Shitian’s primordial spirit this time,
the bookshelves and the Martial Arts Melting Furnace body grew increasingly dim.
Ding Ling thought,
"Though the library’s passive skill is remarkably strong and can protect the consciousness body, it seems to be usable only a few more times."
Having used it once before,
the glow of the bookshelf and furnace had already dimmed noticeably.
This time it became extremely dim.
Estimating it can be used at most one more time.
Then the bookshelves and furnace would become completely dim, unable to perform the passive skill again.
To unleash the passive skill once more,
more books must be filled onto the shelves.
The Martial Arts Melting Furnace must also be strengthened.
Thunk!
The lid of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace suddenly opened, and a stream of light flew out.
The stream of light hovered over a bookshelf for a moment, condensed into a book, and suddenly fell onto the shelf.
In the next instant,
[Holy Heart Technique’s Godslaying Tribulation Full Level]
[Wisdom +0.8]
Ding Ling’s sea of consciousness seemed to condense.
His memory improved significantly, with many past memories surging, allowing him to recall many martial details.
His understanding of techniques and analysis of skills also greatly enhanced.
Ding Ling even felt as though his consciousness body had subtly grown stronger.
"As expected."
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly.
Whenever the passive skill exerted its power,
any primordial spirit body entering the sea of consciousness would be shattered, its memory refined by the Martial Arts Melting Furnace!
The same happened with Chiyou’s soul fragment before.
Now a shred of Emperor Shitian’s primordial spirit directly refined a ’Godslaying Tribulation’ cultivation technique mantra.
Aside from that,
there were also some scattered fragments of Emperor Shitian’s memory.
They didn’t form a cohesive whole.
Upon careful examination, Ding Ling found nothing useful and decided not to look further.
He regretted slightly:

"If all of Emperor Shitian’s primordial spirit had entered my sea of consciousness, it could have been directly shattered, allowing the Martial Arts Melting Furnace to refine all of his primordial spirit memories, thus granting me all of Emperor Shitian’s martial arts!"
Thinking of this,
Ding Ling felt a faint excitement in his heart.
But soon, he shook his head and dismissed the idea.
The stronger the primordial spirit body shattered by the shelves and furnace, the greater the energy consumption.
If the entire primordial spirit body of Emperor Shitian entered, the shelves and furnace might fail to shatter him, which would be troublesome.
As for what the exact reality would be?
Ding Ling did not know.
He didn’t wish to experiment with such matters.
His only option was to find ways to strengthen himself.
However, mastering the Godslaying Tribulation at full level provided Ding Ling a new technique for protecting his primordial spirit.
Whoosh!

He operated the technique of the Godslaying Tribulation, instantly covering his sea of consciousness with a frigid glow, condensing into human faces that blocked the entrance of the sea of consciousness.
Anyone wanting to penetrate the sea of consciousness next time would first have to break Ding Ling’s Godslaying Tribulation.
But Ding Ling’s Godslaying Tribulation was at full level.
For an ordinary person to break through it would be extremely difficult.

"It’s just a pity I don’t have the Holy Heart Technique, and my consciousness body isn’t strong enough to deploy the full potential of Godslaying Tribulation, only allowing it to protect the consciousness body."
His Holy Heart Technique was incomplete.
By operating just half of the Holy Heart Technique and combining with Godslaying Tribulation, he could only achieve this much.
Even so,
Ding Ling felt satisfied enough.
Compared to when his sea of consciousness had no defense at all,
at least now there was an additional layer of defense.
He carefully gauged the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 64%]
Previously the progress was at 56%.

During this time, Ding Ling learned the Proud Cold Six Formulas, Ice Heart Technique, Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship, Duann’s Heart Method, Ascension Step, Black Tortoise True Skill, Ten Strong Martial Dao, Wind God Leg, Dry Ice Palm, Holy Heart Technique (fragmented), Godslaying Tribulation, etc.
Causing the body progress to jump up by 8 percentage points.
"Indeed, quality is paramount."
This time, the quality level of the Ten Strong Martial Dao, Black Tortoise True Skill, etc., was extremely high.
This also led to significant progress of the body.
Moreover, Ding Ling was correct in his speculation.
With the full mastery of the Godslaying Tribulation,
the brightness of the shelves and furnace increased once more.
As long as the brightness is adequate,
the passive skill will be able to be unleashed again when the time comes.

In the void, a giant human face instantly transformed into a stream of light and charged at Ding Ling!
This face seemed both illusory and nonexistent, utterly unavoidable and inescapable.
In just a moment, it crashed into Ding Ling’s sea of consciousness.
Just as the face was about to wreak havoc and shatter his consciousness body, a library buried deep within his sea of consciousness trembled slightly.
Boom!
The face disintegrated and shattered instantly, like ice and snow meeting a blazing fire.
"Ah!"
Emperor Shitian let out a scream, blood and tears streaming uncontrollably from his eyes.
He looked at Ding Ling with terror:
"Why is your primordial spirit so powerful?!"
He had cultivated for over a thousand years, yet the Godslaying Tribulation technique he refined was shattered in an instant!
He felt as if his head had been hammered repeatedly, and his mind buzzed with chaos, as if it was about to explode.
This was the sign of the Godslaying Tribulation being broken.
A symptom of primordial spirit damage!

Ding Ling was battling above his level.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 617: Nie Feng vs. Profound Nether Two Elders
paragraphs: Ding Ling glanced at the task progress.
The progress of Task 1 was impressive.
The progress of Task 2 remained at 0%.
The progress of Task 3 was slowly rising.
If nothing unexpected happens, as his feat of defeating Emperor Shitian spreads far and wide, the progress of Task 3 might surge dramatically with it.
Previously, the progress of Task 3 hardly moved.

Despite defeating Qin Shuang, Bu Jingyun, and others, in the eyes of the world, including the players, the world’s number one was undoubtedly Emperor Shitian, Xiaao Sanxiaao and the like, rather than him, Ding Ling.
And Emperor Shitian’s retreat.
Would bring his popularity to a new peak.
Making people in the world start believing that he was the genuine world’s number one.
Of course.
The progress of Task 2 is at 0.
This also confirmed to Ding Ling one thing, that Emperor Shitian is not the world’s number one here.
"Then who is? Xiaao Sanxiaao? Or someone else?"
Ding Ling pondered thoughtfully.
Now, although he could defeat Emperor Shitian, he couldn’t kill him because his combat power couldn’t last long.
The maximum duration was about one hour.
Beyond one hour, his True Qi would be exhausted, and he might end up being meat on the Emperor Shitian’s chopping block.
This is not what Ding Ling hoped to see.
"So strengthening oneself is the premise."
Ding Ling gazed at the direction Emperor Shitian had fled, thinking:
"Now that Emperor Shitian has been defeated by me, his Primordial Spirit is damaged. He should not have the guts to challenge me again."
As long as Emperor Shitian doesn’t show up.
And Xiaao Sanxiaao remains unseen.
This world will allow him, Ding Ling, to roam freely.
"It seems the plan to unify the Martial Arts world must be advanced."
Ding Ling sighed.
’The Venerable Lord intends to unify the Martial Arts?’
Nie Feng turned his eyes.
"Exactly."
Ding Ling said:

"You’ve also seen the might of Emperor Shitian. He has many experts in his Celestial Sect and Phoenix Island. We must gather the two major forces of the world, Unrivaled City and World Association, before he consolidates the Celestial Sect’s strength. Once we’ve drawn these two major forces together, Jiuzhou will almost be in our grasp. With enough resources by then, you and I will advance rapidly in skill. When we confront Celestial Sect again, it will be much easier."
"I follow the Venerable Lord’s lead."
Nie Feng said solemnly.
Ding Ling said nothing.
In addition to needing Great Medicine for unifying the Martial Arts, he needs a large amount of Secret Manuals.
And these require someone to help collect them.
Collecting them alone is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and not pleasing.
After all, in this world, there are many people who don’t fear death, some would rather bury Secret Manuals in the ground than hand them over.
Others need to come up with ways to help.
This world doesn’t lack smart people, these people will naturally formulate strategies based on human and geographical conditions to obtain these Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling felt this deeply in previous worlds, and this time he will naturally do the same.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling and Nie Feng’s speed was quick.
Apart from stopping twice halfway.
The rest of the time was spent traveling.
On this day.
The two arrived at a Bamboo Forest Residence outside Unrivaled City.
This was Mingyue’s residence.
Nie Feng, touched by the sight, showed a face full of bleakness.
He was about to turn and leave when suddenly there was a loud explosion.
The entire Bamboo Forest Residence was blown apart.
Accompanied by a series of angry swearing, a group of over ten people emerged from one side of the Bamboo Forest Residence.
"You, you actually destroyed this?!"
Nie Feng roared in anger.
"So what?"
These dozen individuals varied in appearance.
One had a face as pale as snow, a slim build, with his right arm fitted with an iron hook, a middle-aged man full of Evil Qi, and cold:
Another had narrow eyes, a malevolent face, and laughed eerily;
One laughed heartily, like a smiling Buddha, was full of kindness in appearance while hiding a knife in his smile;
There was one with a Yin-Soft appearance, ambiguous gender;
There was a half-human half-ghost figure, with hair covering his face, emitting an air of gloom, the whole person seemed shrouded in dark;
More than ten people.
Each had different looks.
But an ordinary person could see that they were not to be trifled with.
At this moment, the one who spoke was an old man with white hair and a sinister face, laughing and shouting:
"This is the territory of our Heroes Gathering. We’ll do whatever we want. You, an outsider, meddling?"
"This is clearly Unrivaled City!"
Nie Feng retorted:
’Since when did it become Heroes Gathering’s territory? And what is Heroes Gathering anyway?’
"You’ve just underestimated us.
The old white-haired man laughed:
"Our Heroes Gathering is formed by heroes from different worlds. Now standing in front of you is Lul Zhangke from the shattered void!"
"Lul Zhangke? Shattered void?!"
Nie Feng’s pupils constricted, instinctively glancing at Ding Ling beside him.
Ding Ling looked expressionlessly at this group.
Lul Zhangke?
He remembered.
Isn’t this one of the Profound Nether Two Elders in "Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber"?
This person was extremely lascivious, sinisterly vicious and treacherous.
Claiming to be a hero?
And saying he came from the shattered void?
Isn’t this just boasting?
He’s at most an Ascender!
"Senior brother, why waste words with him."
The man beside Lul Zhangke, with hair hanging over his shoulders, plain-looking with a short beard, upon hearing Lul Zhangke’s words, impatience led him to suddenly attack Nie Feng:

"This person suddenly appeared here with clear intent, and is extremely furious about us destroying this Bamboo Forest Residence. He must know its former owner. It’s possible he has secrets related to City-Overturning Love on him, capture him! Don’t let him escape."
Bang!
The man’s palm technique was insidious and fierce, once he struck, a terrible cold intent came crashing towards Nie Feng!
Clearly aiming to severely injure Nie Feng.
Nie Feng grew increasingly furious.
Suddenly activated Wind God Leg.
With a move ’Wind-Resistant Grass’, his body like a floating plant, legs like lightning, with a loud crash, he collided heavily with the man’s palm, the man was instantly kicked several meters away.
The man looked confused and shouted:
"The target is difficult. All together!"
Lul Zhangke immediately joined forces with the man to attack Nie Feng.
Both had excellent skills, and seemed to have practiced Breathing Technique, with tenfold amplification, they fought Nie Feng evenly, with no apparent outcome for a while.

Ding Ling watched and raised an eyebrow, thinking: "The transformations of this world are getting bigger and bigger. The world of Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber must have also changed significantly. These Profound Nether Two Elders seem to have received extraordinary fortune. Their skills far exceed my previous stereotypical cognition of them. Clearly, the world is changing.
The strength of these native individuals is rapidly transforming as well.
Some are becoming stronger and stronger. Others may fade into the long river of history during battles."
Ding Ling noticed the skills of Profound Nether Two Elders had reached the level of Innate Peak Great Perfection.
With tenfold amplification.
Moreover, they could engage in magical battles with Grandmasters.
Clearly, the opportunities Profound Nether Two Elders had in the past were profound.
