chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 618: The Generation’s Twin Heroes and the Ten Great Evildoers
paragraphs: Could it be that the Profound Nether Two Elders acquired their fortune with the help of the players?
Or were they aided by other Ascenders to complete their destined transformation.
The original trajectory of the Profound Nether Two Elders was undeniably certain death.
Yet now, they’re alive, having ascended to the Wind and Cloud World, their cultivation transcending the norm, truly extraordinary.
Nie Feng was much younger than the two.

Additionally, the time he had spent cultivating the Black Tortoise True Skill and Breathing Technique was limited; his cultivation of Profound Skill and Breathing Technique had just barely reached Entry Level, with Minor Achievement still some distance away.
Adding to that, his cultivation was inferior to the Profound Nether Two Elders.
Now it was two against one.
Over time, the situation gradually turned against him.

Feeling things were worsening, Nie Feng immediately switched to Wind God Leg, drawing his sword, executing the Proud Cold Six Formulas and No-Two Blade Technique one after another, which were resisted by the joint forces of the Profound Nether Two Elders, generating a crushing momentum against Nie Feng.
Until Nie Feng inadvertently activated the Black Tortoise True Skill’s Ten Directions Invincible.
Boom!
A move ’Draw Sword and Cut Water’ cleaved down, unexpectedly sending Lul Zhangke flying in an instant.
Only then did the dozen or so people watching the spectacle show great movement and shock:
"What a powerful sword technique. What a strong explosive force. Who are you?!"
"Nie Feng!"
The words Nie Feng spat out agitated the crowd a bit.

Immediately, a man stepped forth, with three sword scars on his face, tall stature, a wide-brimmed hat on his back, dressed in golden garments, his fingers long and slender, gripping a sword in his left hand.
He looked at Nie Feng, eyes lifeless grey, devoid of emotion, like a robot viewing a corpse:

"So it turns out to be Nie Feng, Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall from the World Association! No wonder you have such skill. Our Heroes Gathering has long resolved to strike at the World Association. Since Nie Feng you are here now, let’s settle this today."
As his voice fell.
He suddenly joined forces with the Profound Nether Two Elders to assault Nie Feng.
His sword was extremely fast.

So fast that it was eerie and strange, no one could predict where his sword would land, which direction it pointed, clearly slanted, yet giving a terrifying sense that it might at any moment target the opponent’s vital point.
In coordination with the Palm Force of the Profound Nether Two Elders.
The three joined forces.
Again forcing Nie Feng into a difficult position, he struggled to hold on.
His Ten Strong Martial Dao had only just crossed the Entry Level stage, Ten Directions Invincible was merely learned, still far from crossing Entry Level.
Thus, it was hard for his Ten Directions Invincible to always remain activated like Ding Ling!
Without the boost from Ten Directions Invincible.

Merely occasionally reinforced by Breathing Technique, he found it hard to contend with the three, and soon Nie Feng was struck in the chest by Lul Zhangke’s palm, spewing a mouthful of blood, flying several zhang away, landing not far from Ding Ling’s side.
He looked ashamed, not daring to face Ding Ling directly.
"Haha... The Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall, no more than this. It seems that the World Association has no one left. Our Heroes Gathering’s domination of the world is just around the corner!"
Lul Zhangke laughed arrogantly:

"Bu Jingyun from the World Association has defected. Nie Feng has been defeated by us, only leaving a mere Qin Shuang, World Association will soon be out of action. Xiong Ba shall step down and become one of our Heroes Gathering, that is his ultimate destiny!
"Absolutely right."
The man beside Lul Zhangke was Hebi Elder, one of the Profound Nether Two Elders, speaking excitedly:
"Let’s capture Nie Feng first."
"Indeed."
The dozen or so people behind Hebi Elder also approached, laughing:

"Rumor has it that City-Overturning Love is extremely formidable. If mastered, it could even easily destroy a huge city, whether true or false we don’t know. But no matter what, Nie Feng, if you don’t want to die, just comply, tell us where the Bamboo Forest Residence’s owner has hidden the City-Overturning Love?!"
Nie Feng did not answer, merely stood and walked to Ding Ling’s side.
Ding Ling placed his hand on Nie Feng, slightly circulating the Longevity Venerable Qi.
Whish Whish!
Venerable Qi flowed into Nie Feng’s wounds.
In a moment.
Nie Feng was perfectly fine once more.
He looked at Ding Ling with gratitude, amazement, and admiration.
Yet throughout, he completely ignored the Profound Nether Two Elders and others, seeing only Ding Ling.
This elicited great wrath from the Profound Nether Two Elders and the group:
"Stubborn ignorance, courting death, refusing a toast and eating penalty. Attack!"
Lul Zhangke made a sudden rush towards Nie Feng.
From start to finish he had ignored Ding Ling, for in his eyes, how powerful could someone as young as Ding Ling be?
Even the Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall of the World Association, the most famous young expert Nie Feng, was defeated by them.
What can Ding Ling do?
It’s just a matter of a slap!
However.
He just thought so.
Yet suddenly felt a wind sound from beside him.
Then.
He felt his whole body as if struck by lightning, as though his entire skeleton had been hit by a mountain, flying uncontrollably dozens of zhang away.
Midair.
He could no longer endure, spewing several jets of blood!
Each jet seemed to contain fragments!
His vital organs had been forcibly shattered, causing the eruption right now!
"Who on earth?!"
Lul Zhangke was stunned, terrified, and despaired:
"With shattered organs, I’m doomed!
"Senior brother!"
Hebi Elder couldn’t believe it, suddenly looked at Ding Ling:
"You harmed my senior brother!"
Though extremely angry, he was highly cautious, retreating dozens of zhang, standing alongside the previous group, loudly shouting:
"Jing Wuming! Du Sha! Li Dazui, Tu Jiaojiao, Xuanyuan Sanguang, Tie Zhan... attack all together!"
The dozen or so exchanged glances.
Then jointly displayed their might.
Suddenly charged at Ding Ling.
Finally everyone realized the extraordinary nature of Ding Ling.
Knew solo fighting was impossible against Ding Ling.
Cooperation against the enemy.
Perhaps offering a glimmer of hope!
Though they ultimately overestimated themselves.
Ding Ling merely slightly flipped his palm.
Dry Ice Palm!
The Shattering Level Palm Technique released, combined with Grandmaster Level power, upon execution, heaven and earth shook, dramatic changes unfolded!
Countless frost and snow converged, transforming into a giant ice hand out of nowhere, as Ding Ling used a little force, it pressed down on the dozen.
"How is it possible?!"
"It’s a Grandmaster!"
Li Dazui, Xuanyuan Sanguang and others saw through the situation, faces terrified, loudly shouting:
"Not an opponent! Retreat!"
"Trying to escape?"
Ding Ling glanced at these people, hearing Hebi Elder, he knew who they were.
This group was none other.
Precisely Jing Wuming among the Ten Great Evildoers, and characters from "Romantic Swordsman" such as Jing Wuming!
Ding Ling hadn’t expected an encounter and conflict with such a crowd.
But since their intentions were bad towards him and Nie Feng.
Ding Ling naturally couldn’t spare them.
Murderous intent surfaced.
How could it be restrained?
With Ding Ling exerting force, accompanied by sounds of thud thud thud, a dozen fell.

sentences.text: Could it be that the Profound Nether Two Elders acquired their fortune with the help of the players?
Or were they aided by other Ascenders to complete their destined transformation.
The original trajectory of the Profound Nether Two Elders was undeniably certain death.
Yet now, they’re alive, having ascended to the Wind and Cloud World, their cultivation transcending the norm, truly extraordinary.
Nie Feng was much younger than the two.

Additionally, the time he had spent cultivating the Black Tortoise True Skill and Breathing Technique was limited; his cultivation of Profound Skill and Breathing Technique had just barely reached Entry Level, with Minor Achievement still some distance away.
Adding to that, his cultivation was inferior to the Profound Nether Two Elders.
Now it was two against one.
Over time, the situation gradually turned against him.

Feeling things were worsening, Nie Feng immediately switched to Wind God Leg, drawing his sword, executing the Proud Cold Six Formulas and No-Two Blade Technique one after another, which were resisted by the joint forces of the Profound Nether Two Elders, generating a crushing momentum against Nie Feng.
Until Nie Feng inadvertently activated the Black Tortoise True Skill’s Ten Directions Invincible.
Boom!
A move ’Draw Sword and Cut Water’ cleaved down, unexpectedly sending Lul Zhangke flying in an instant.
Only then did the dozen or so people watching the spectacle show great movement and shock:
"What a powerful sword technique.
What a strong explosive force.
Who are you?!"
"Nie Feng!"
The words Nie Feng spat out agitated the crowd a bit.

Immediately, a man stepped forth, with three sword scars on his face, tall stature, a wide-brimmed hat on his back, dressed in golden garments, his fingers long and slender, gripping a sword in his left hand.
He looked at Nie Feng, eyes lifeless grey, devoid of emotion, like a robot viewing a corpse:
"So it turns out to be Nie Feng, Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall from the World Association!
No wonder you have such skill.
Our Heroes Gathering has long resolved to strike at the World Association.
Since Nie Feng you are here now, let’s settle this today."
As his voice fell.
He suddenly joined forces with the Profound Nether Two Elders to assault Nie Feng.
His sword was extremely fast.

So fast that it was eerie and strange, no one could predict where his sword would land, which direction it pointed, clearly slanted, yet giving a terrifying sense that it might at any moment target the opponent’s vital point.
In coordination with the Palm Force of the Profound Nether Two Elders.
The three joined forces.
Again forcing Nie Feng into a difficult position, he struggled to hold on.
His Ten Strong Martial Dao had only just crossed the Entry Level stage, Ten Directions Invincible was merely learned, still far from crossing Entry Level.
Thus, it was hard for his Ten Directions Invincible to always remain activated like Ding Ling!
Without the boost from Ten Directions Invincible.

Merely occasionally reinforced by Breathing Technique, he found it hard to contend with the three, and soon Nie Feng was struck in the chest by Lul Zhangke’s palm, spewing a mouthful of blood, flying several zhang away, landing not far from Ding Ling’s side.
He looked ashamed, not daring to face Ding Ling directly.
"Haha...
The Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall, no more than this.
It seems that the World Association has no one left.
Our Heroes Gathering’s domination of the world is just around the corner!"
Lul Zhangke laughed arrogantly:
"Bu Jingyun from the World Association has defected.
Nie Feng has been defeated by us, only leaving a mere Qin Shuang, World Association will soon be out of action.
Xiong Ba shall step down and become one of our Heroes Gathering, that is his ultimate destiny!
"Absolutely right."
The man beside Lul Zhangke was Hebi Elder, one of the Profound Nether Two Elders, speaking excitedly:
"Let’s capture Nie Feng first."
"Indeed."
The dozen or so people behind Hebi Elder also approached, laughing:
"Rumor has it that City-Overturning Love is extremely formidable.
If mastered, it could even easily destroy a huge city, whether true or false we don’t know.
But no matter what, Nie Feng, if you don’t want to die, just comply, tell us where the Bamboo Forest Residence’s owner has hidden the City-Overturning Love?!"
Nie Feng did not answer, merely stood and walked to Ding Ling’s side.
Ding Ling placed his hand on Nie Feng, slightly circulating the Longevity Venerable Qi.
Whish Whish!
Venerable Qi flowed into Nie Feng’s wounds.
In a moment.
Nie Feng was perfectly fine once more.
He looked at Ding Ling with gratitude, amazement, and admiration.

Attack!"

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 619: Duann Lang
paragraphs: Just one palm!
Ding Ling resolved the Ten Great Evildoers, Jing Wuming, Hebi Elder, and the others.
Nie Feng watched in admiration, this is the gap!
And Jing Wuming, the Ten Great Evildoers, Hebi Elder, and the others were terrified to death!
"Who exactly are you?!"
Ding Ling did not answer.
He merely grabbed each person out of thin air, operated the Eternal Youth Technique, Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Whoosh!
Rolling inner power entered his body.
[Inner Power Value +90]
This was obtained from the refining of Li Dazui’s entire inner power.
Ding Ling picked up Hebi Elder.
Activated his skill and absorbed.
Rolling true qi entered his body.
In an instant.
[Inner Power Value +300]
Being able to have 300 inner power value.
This is quite considerable.

It can be seen that not using weapons to mutilate these people, but instead using palm power to overturn and severely injure them, preserving their bodies intact, leaving them with a breath, was necessary.
In this way.
It is beneficial for Ding Ling to absorb more true qi.
It is quite a pity that.
Their inner power heart techniques were lacking.
The absorbed true qi had numerous impurities, ultimately only one or two parts, at best two to three parts could be refined for self-use.
However, despite this.
It was possible to increase by 300 inner power value.
It shows the torrential true qi in Hebi Elder’s dantian, which indeed had reached the Peak of Innate Realm, and was just a step away from reaching Grandmaster.
And because Ding Ling did not engage in a great battle with them.
So the true qi in their dantians was hardly consumed.
[Inner Power Value +71]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Inner Power Value +121]
[Inner Power Value +62]
Sixteen people.
Hebi Elder, Lul Zhangke, and just four or five others had the highest powers.
Increased by an average of 200.
They contributed 1000 inner power value.
The other eleven people, with slightly less skill.
Some were strong, some were weak.
Each contributed about 74 points on average.
A total increase of 814 points.
Overall increased by 1814 points.
Eighteen paths of Longevity True Qi emerged in the dantian.
Then gathered into 6 drops of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 57 points]
Strength soared again.
Ding Ling sensed he was one step closer to the Realm of Shattering.
"Transformation Technique!"
Du Sha, ranked first among the Ten Great Evildoers in martial arts, looked gloomy:
"I never thought I, Du Sha, would witness the Transformation Technique from the mouths of aliens in my lifetime. Indeed impressive."
Ding Ling ignored these people.
These people were already enemies to him, and isn’t it a sin to be soft-hearted to enemies?
Yet these people still had some value.
He grabbed ice shards from thin air, then waved his hand, and the ice shards flew like snowflakes into their bodies.
Following Ding Ling’s activation of the Life and Death Talisman.
In the next moment.
These people began to scream in twisted agony, rolling into a ball.
Ding Ling pointed with his finger in mid-air.
One Yang Finger!
Finger force like thunder, quickly hitting their mute acupoints.
When they were tortured enough.
Ding Ling struck with a Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm to alleviate their pain, then executed One Yang Finger to release their mute acupoints.
Asked about their martial arts heart technique.
The defiant ones cursed Ding Ling, who directly exploded the palm power of Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm in their bodies and again hit their mute acupoints, making them suffer to death.
Others witnessing this were terrified.
Of course, some had tough bones.
Ding Ling treated them the same, grabbing them aside in mid-air and allowing them to be tortured to death in pain.
In dealing with enemies.
Ding Ling never showed mercy.
Nie Feng watched from the side, shocked again by his understanding of Ding Ling.
After half an hour.
[Profound Nether Divine Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Deer Staff Technique Full Level]
[Crane Feather Technique Full Level]
[Assassin’s Slaughter Technique Full Level]
He acquired techniques from ten people.
Amounting to fifteen types of external skills.
And eight kinds of inner power heart techniques.
Finally.
[Inner Power Value +300]
Yet at this time.
After Ding Ling advanced to the Grandmaster Perfection Realm.
Ordinary first-class inner power heart techniques have no enhancing effect on Ding Ling.
Only inner power heart techniques of Grandmaster Level or above had a boosting effect on Ding Ling.
Other inner power heart techniques below Grandmaster Level can only enhance Ding Ling’s foundation, progressing the furnace body bar of Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
Having them is better than not having them.
Three-dimensional attribute points final result:
[Strength +1]
[Agility +0.9]
[Constitution +0.9]
Some external skills did not increase three-dimensional attribute points.
Yet as strength constantly advanced.
The external skills that could be increased initially.
Now gradually were losing effect.
This is like the principle of developing resistance from consuming too many spirit pills.
At higher levels.
Low-level things do not often produce effect.
It’s like a mortal becomes an immortal; past meals, essential for survival, are now unnecessary.
And when a person becomes a martial dao supreme, those apparent martial arts, although an evident source of improvement, offer little help!
At Ding Ling’s current level.
He’s reached the stage where he becomes proficient at third-class martial arts just by looking.
Even without library assistance, he becomes proficient just by glancing!
It’s like a doctoral student looking at elementary school or kindergarten problems, even if they’ve never solved such kindergarten problems before, they still become proficient just by looking!
This is a dimension reduction strike!
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Intelligence 6, Wisdom 8.3, Strength 121.6, Agility 90, Constitution 121.4, Defense 118.2, Charisma 13. True Power Value: 58 points]
True Power Value increased by another point.
"Gotten stronger again."
Ding Ling clenched his fist, now merely the power of body refining is extremely terrifying.
The True Power Value is infinitely closing in on the Shattering Level!
Ding Ling casually executed Canhe Finger, swoosh swoosh swoosh! Finger force poured like rain, soon ending these people, allowing them to die in peace.
Having been tortured by Ding Ling to such an extent, they only wished for a quick death.
Now that Ding Ling granted them this, some even felt thankful to Ding Ling.
Of course, more felt resentment and hatred towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling did not care about this.
Too many resent him.
He’s long used to the irritation.
His ways are such that once someone offends him, prepare to be killed by him.
"Let’s keep going."
Ding Ling glanced at Nie Feng.
Nie Feng shivered, then quickly regained composure, respectfully saluted Ding Ling, and then led the way ahead.
They had walked less than a hundred meters.
Suddenly, from a side of the bamboo forest, a vigorous and outstanding young man emerged.
He called out:
"Nie Feng!"
"Duann Lang!"
Nie Feng turned upon hearing the voice, and upon seeing the young man, his eyes brightened, he joyfully stepped forward and embraced Duann Lang, saying:
"How come you’re here?"
Duann Lang’s eyes glanced around, did not answer, but turned to Ding Ling:
"I wonder who this hero is?"
"He is my Venerable Lord."
Nie Feng was extremely respectful to Ding Ling, even when introducing him to Duann Lang.
"Venerable Lord?!"
Duann Lang’s pupils shrunk, his expression somewhat unnatural.
He took two steps forward, saluted Ding Ling, and said:
"I wonder what is the surname and name of the Venerable Lord? Why has Duann Lang never seen such a strong figure as the Venerable Lord in Jianghu?"

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 620: Romantic Swordsman vs. Shangguan Jinhong
paragraphs: Duann Lang remained hidden in the Ming Family Cemetery, silently observing the events unfolding on one side of the Bamboo Forest Residence.
He saw everything from beginning to end.
From initial envy and jealousy of Nie Feng’s improved skills, to concern and bewilderment after Nie Feng was defeated, and then to shock, helplessness, and disbelief after Ding Ling made a move.
The speed of his change in mindset was astounding.
Not at all inferior to the Profound Nether Two Elders and the Ten Great Evildoers involved.
Most of the Profound Nether Two Elders and the Ten Great Evildoers died with unfulfilled wishes.
After all, they truly did not expect to encounter someone as fearsome and extraordinary as Ding Ling so casually here!
If they had known, they wouldn’t have been so arrogant, and would have scattered like frightened birds!
But unfortunately, that’s often how the world is, full of uncertainty and coincidence.
Duann Lang understood this recently, which is why he always acted very cautiously.
What he didn’t expect was that his caution paid off once again this time.
He was relieved, yet cold sweat broke out on his back, almost scaring him to death.
Because he was part of the group with the Ten Great Evildoers and the Profound Nether Two Elders!
It’s just that these people were more impulsive, arrogant, and claimed to be invincible when together.

Duann Lang was in charge of the intelligence system and understood that with more and more Ascenders and the emergence of people like Emperor Shitian, the world was becoming unpredictable, with too many experts. One must stay cautious and stable.
So compared to the Ten Great Evildoers and the Profound Nether Two Elders, he was more low-key.
And his low profile saved him again this time.

At this moment, Duann Lang was bowing to Ding Ling, feeling immense pressure seeing Ding Ling easily overpower the Ten Great Evildoers and others with a casual palm strike. He lowered his already slightly straightened waist even more, showing even more respect and reverence than Nie Feng.
"You can call me Ding Ling."
Ding Ling said a sentence.
Duann Lang’s pupils dilated, and he raised his lowered head, saying in disbelief:
"You are Ding Ling? The one who defeated Emperor Shitian?!"
"That’s right."
Nie Feng spoke with a hint of pride:
"The Venerable Lord made Emperor Shitian flee in disarray not long ago!"
"Hiss."
Duann Lang took a sharp breath, his legs weakened, almost kneeling on the ground.
The one in front of him was Ding Ling!
The terrifying individual who made the thousand-year-old Master of the Celestial Gate, Emperor Shitian, flee for his life!
Offending him.
It would be instant doom.
Thinking of this.
An idea crossed Duann Lang’s mind. He decisively said:

"Reporting to the Venerable Lord. Honestly, I am now the Intelligence Commander of the Heroes Gathering. I collaborate with the Ten Great Evildoers, Profound Nether Two Elders, Jing Wuming, and others.
This time, I voluntarily led them here to search for the Technique of City-Overturning Love."
"Duann Lang, you..."
Nie Feng was about to say something.
Duann Lang, however, directly knelt down, shouting:
"Now I, Duann Lang, want to defect to the Venerable Lord, hoping the Venerable Lord will not disdain me. I will work myself to the bone till death!"
He paused, glanced at Ding Ling, seeing Ding Ling’s expressionless face, his heart skipped a beat. He hurriedly vowed:
"For the Venerable Lord, I will brave fire and water, smear my head and brain, sparing no effort! If I break this oath, let me, Duann Lang, be pierced by ten thousand arrows, dying miserably!"
Nie Feng felt a toothache hearing this.
Yet he was also touched. It seemed Duann Lang had never treated someone so earnestly before!
What he didn’t know was.
As the intelligence leader, Duann Lang understood Ding Ling quite well. This understanding came from Aliens and insights from various sources.
The more he learned.
The more Duann Lang admired, respected, and feared Ding Ling. It was hard to believe such a person could exist in the world, it was simply unfathomable!
What Nie Feng, Bu Jingyun? In front of Ding Ling, they were nothing!
Moreover.
He understood Nie Feng extremely well.
He knew Nie Feng was impartial, unwavering by power, treating Ding Ling as a Venerable Lord, clearly indicating Ding Ling’s character was recognized by Nie Feng!
Someone recognized by Nie Feng must be a person who treats his subordinates generously.
Having thought through this, Duann Lang knelt so decisively!
Following Ding Ling offered far more prospects than following Shangguan Jinhong! Duann Lang was also a decisive person, immediately abandoning Shangguan Jinhong to choose Ding Ling.
"Alright, stand up."
With his Full-Level Observing People Skill, Ding Ling could see at a glance that Duann Lang truly admired him from the bottom of his heart.
Furthermore...
[You obtained an E-level Achievement Medal: You won Duann Lang’s profound admiration and fear!]

[Note: Duann Lang conducted all-round inquiries about you. His understanding of you is exceptionally high. In the whole world, Duann Lang has never been as impressed, fearful, respectful, and awed by a person as he is by you. You are the only one.]

"Thank you, Venerable Lord!"
Duann Lang breathed a sigh of relief. Observing his expression, he realized Ding Ling had initially acknowledged him, and he couldn’t help but feel overjoyed.

It turned out that Heroes Gathering was a major force formed by Shangguan Jinhong from "Romantic Swordsman" and Chengkun from "Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber."
This force occupied Unrivaled City and developed rapidly.
It gathered countless experts!
There were not only Ascenders but also natives from this world.
Duann Lang was a representative figure of the local natives.
The Heroes Gathering was making impressive progress, with ambitions of ruling the entire world.

With Duann Lang controlling the intelligence system, he provided timely feedback to Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun, who halted their relentless advancement, deciding to focus on improving their strength instead.
As long as their strength increased.
Then all problems would no longer be problems.
However, the information on outside forces was only fully understood by Shangguan Jinhong, Chengkun, and Duann Lang.

The Ten Great Evildoers, Profound Nether Two Elders, and others received only partial information from the Aliens, not forming a system, moreover, under the intentional control by Shangguan Jinhong and others.
The news they received became even more fragmented!
They knew only bitter cultivation day by day, acting purely as thugs.
This time coming to the Ming Family Ancient Tomb.
Was just a simple attempt to see if they could uncover the secret of City-Overturning Love to elevate the absolute strength and foundation of the Heroes Gathering.
They didn’t expect to blow up the ancient tomb and blast apart the Bamboo Forest Residence.
Duann Lang quickly said:
"Venerable Lord, I have no feelings for the Heroes Gathering, we merely used each other. Naturally, it cannot be considered a betrayal. I hope the Venerable Lord will understand."
"I hope you will not betray me in the future."
Ding Ling said calmly.
"I dare not."
Duann Lang said fearfully.
Nie Feng also spoke on behalf of Duann Lang.
Ding Ling showed no comment. With his Full-Level Observing People Skill, if Duann Lang had any treacherous thoughts, he naturally would be able to detect it immediately.
Fortunately, Duann Lang hadn’t come into contact with the Fire Qilin Sword and was still in a stage that could be reformed.
Currently, he was still a sincere, brave, and passionate youth.
Although he was quite cunning, but that was a good thing.
As a superior, if he weren’t cunning, wouldn’t he be played like a fiddle by his subordinates?
Not everyone can have a Full-Level Observing People Skill like Ding Ling, directly pushing forward.
"Let’s go and meet Shangguan Jinhong."
"Yes."
After a period of time.
Ding Ling and the two others set foot in Unrivaled City.
At a glance.
This Unrivaled City was full of ragged poor people, in stark contrast to the wealthy families with decaying meat and wine behind vermilion gates.
This showed the corruption of Unrivaled City.
With Duann Lang leading the way.
No one dared to stop the three of them.
Soon.
Duann Lang led Ding Ling and Nie Feng directly into the City Lord’s Mansion. After asking Ding Ling and Nie Feng to wait, he went to invite someone.
Ding Ling had just taken a couple of sips of tea.
As the sound of hurried footsteps echoed.
Ding Ling saw two people rushing over.
One was tall and robust, with an overbearing aura, exuding the demeanor of a dominant figure;

The other was dressed like a monk, with a bald head, wearing a kasaya, seeming gentle and kind, but the dark glint in his narrow eyes occasionally proved this person was difficult to deal with, being duplicitous and treacherous.
"Shangguan Jinhong (Chengkun) pays respect to Hero Ding!"
The robust man and the monk, both courteously bowed to Ding Ling.

He saw everything from beginning to end.
From initial envy and jealousy of Nie Feng’s improved skills, to concern and bewilderment after Nie Feng was defeated, and then to shock, helplessness, and disbelief after Ding Ling made a move.
The speed of his change in mindset was astounding.
Not at all inferior to the Profound Nether Two Elders and the Ten Great Evildoers involved.
Most of the Profound Nether Two Elders and the Ten Great Evildoers died with unfulfilled wishes.
After all, they truly did not expect to encounter someone as fearsome and extraordinary as Ding Ling so casually here!
If they had known, they wouldn’t have been so arrogant, and would have scattered like frightened birds!
But unfortunately, that’s often how the world is, full of uncertainty and coincidence.
Duann Lang understood this recently, which is why he always acted very cautiously.
What he didn’t expect was that his caution paid off once again this time.
He was relieved, yet cold sweat broke out on his back, almost scaring him to death.
Because he was part of the group with the Ten Great Evildoers and the Profound Nether Two Elders!
It’s just that these people were more impulsive, arrogant, and claimed to be invincible when together.

Duann Lang was in charge of the intelligence system and understood that with more and more Ascenders and the emergence of people like Emperor Shitian, the world was becoming unpredictable, with too many experts.
One must stay cautious and stable.
So compared to the Ten Great Evildoers and the Profound Nether Two Elders, he was more low-key.
And his low profile saved him again this time.
At this moment, Duann Lang was bowing to Ding Ling, feeling immense pressure seeing Ding Ling easily overpower the Ten Great Evildoers and others with a casual palm strike.
He lowered his already slightly straightened waist even more, showing even more respect and reverence than Nie Feng.
"You can call me Ding Ling."
Ding Ling said a sentence.
Duann Lang’s pupils dilated, and he raised his lowered head, saying in disbelief:
"You are Ding Ling?
The one who defeated Emperor Shitian?!"
"That’s right."
Nie Feng spoke with a hint of pride:
"The Venerable Lord made Emperor Shitian flee in disarray not long ago!"
"Hiss."
Duann Lang took a sharp breath, his legs weakened, almost kneeling on the ground.
The one in front of him was Ding Ling!
The terrifying individual who made the thousand-year-old Master of the Celestial Gate, Emperor Shitian, flee for his life!
Offending him.
It would be instant doom.
Thinking of this.
An idea crossed Duann Lang’s mind.
He decisively said:
"Reporting to the Venerable Lord.
Honestly, I am now the Intelligence Commander of the Heroes Gathering.
I collaborate with the Ten Great Evildoers, Profound Nether Two Elders, Jing Wuming, and others.
This time, I voluntarily led them here to search for the Technique of City-Overturning Love."
"Duann Lang, you..."
Nie Feng was about to say something.
Duann Lang, however, directly knelt down, shouting:
"Now I, Duann Lang, want to defect to the Venerable Lord, hoping the Venerable Lord will not disdain me.
I will work myself to the bone till death!"
He paused, glanced at Ding Ling, seeing Ding Ling’s expressionless face, his heart skipped a beat.
He hurriedly vowed:
"For the Venerable Lord, I will brave fire and water, smear my head and brain, sparing no effort!
If I break this oath, let me, Duann Lang, be pierced by ten thousand arrows, dying miserably!"
Nie Feng felt a toothache hearing this.
Yet he was also touched.
It seemed Duann Lang had never treated someone so earnestly before!
What he didn’t know was.
As the intelligence leader, Duann Lang understood Ding Ling quite well.
This understanding came from Aliens and insights from various sources.
The more he learned.
The more Duann Lang admired, respected, and feared Ding Ling.
It was hard to believe such a person could exist in the world, it was simply unfathomable!
What Nie Feng, Bu Jingyun?
In front of Ding Ling, they were nothing!
Moreover.
He understood Nie Feng extremely well.
He knew Nie Feng was impartial, unwavering by power, treating Ding Ling as a Venerable Lord, clearly indicating Ding Ling’s character was recognized by Nie Feng!
Someone recognized by Nie Feng must be a person who treats his subordinates generously.
Having thought through this, Duann Lang knelt so decisively!
Following Ding Ling offered far more prospects than following Shangguan Jinhong!
Duann Lang was also a decisive person, immediately abandoning Shangguan Jinhong to choose Ding Ling.
"Alright, stand up."

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 621: City Lord Candidate
paragraphs: "Have a seat."
Ding Ling sat at the head of the table, turning from guest to host, his expression and words extremely indifferent.

Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun felt a jolt in their hearts, glanced at Duann Lang, seeing that he looked down, focused inwardly, and leisurely sat on the seat on the right, with a demeanor of being entirely undistracted, they couldn’t help but feel hatred gnaw at them.
The two had reached this point.
How could they not understand?
Duann Lang had abandoned them, defecting to Ding Ling.
They wanted to vent their anger, but thinking of Ding Ling’s great divine techniques, they could only suppress their unrest and anger, and quietly walked aside to sit down.
"We were unaware of Hero Ding’s arrival and neglected to greet you, please forgive us!"
Shangguan Jinhong took the initiative to speak:
"If there has been any inadequacy in our hospitality, Hero Ding can certainly criticize us, and I will definitely correct it."
Chengkun hurriedly echoed with similar words.
Both felt stifled inside.
What kind of situation is this?
It’s the typical case of sitting at home and disaster striking from the sky!

If they had known that sending the Ten Great Evildoers and the Profound Nether Two Elders to search for the Secret Manual of City’s Love would have caused such a bizarre situation, they would never have done it!
"I’d rather not waste time with idle talk."
Ding Ling did not drink tea either, setting down the cup in his hand, glancing at Chengkun and Shangguan Jinhong, and said calmly:
"I want Duann Lang to become the City Lord of Unrivaled City. What do you think?"
Duann Lang was taken aback, then overjoyed, unable to contain the excitement and joy in his heart, to the extent that his previously calm face became slightly distorted.
Recently, he had been very discreet, being clever and calculating, thus generally keeping a low profile in public.
Having been struck down so many times, he had become much more mature, knowing when to say what, and do what, displaying wisdom.
But now, with Ding Ling’s sudden announcement, he was caught off guard, and it was instantly overwhelming, he couldn’t keep himself together.
If Ding Ling weren’t right in front of him, he might have stood up, put his hands on his hips, and laughed out loud toward the sky three times.

Nie Feng saw this and truly felt happy for Duann Lang from the bottom of his heart, his eyes sparkling as he looked at Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun, clearly preparing to see how they would choose, and what they would do.
As for why Ding Ling chose Duann Lang to be the City Lord, it was because Nie Feng was too honest and upright, and facing schemers like Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun, he would easily suffer losses.
Duann Lang would fare much better.
Additionally, Ding Ling needed someone like Duann Lang to manage affairs and collect the Secret Manuals.

Compared to Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun, Ding Ling definitely trusted Duann Lang more! After all, Duann Lang had already learned about his father’s situation from Nie Feng, further heightening his trust, gratitude, and respect towards Ding Ling!
He could be counted as one of Ding Ling’s own people.
"This..."
Shangguan Jinhong was stunned, then forcibly suppressed his depression and displeasure, pretending to be composed as he said:
"Since Hero Ding has spoken, how can I have any reason to disagree?"
Chengkun hurriedly echoed in agreement, throughout he seemed to adopt a Buddhist attitude, merely acting as Shangguan Jinhong’s echo.
But Ding Ling, having read novels and watched TV dramas, naturally knew about Chengkun’s treachery and nastiness.
He glanced at the two, saying:
"Since you have no objections, let’s settle it. Duann Lang, from this moment forward, you are the City Lord of Unrivaled City, and Unrivaled City is yours to govern."
"Yes, Venerable Lord!"
Duann Lang, full of rosy energy and vigor, seemed alive again, with boundless enthusiasm, striding to the center hall, proclaiming loudly:
"I will certainly not disappoint the Venerable Lord’s great expectations, and will work diligently and tirelessly, bringing the brightest future to Unrivaled City’s development!"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, speaking affirmatively:

"I hope you can find some talented individuals with governance abilities. Unrivaled City is too impoverished, and there are many poor people around. I hope in the future, Unrivaled City will become prosperous, and everyone will have clothes to wear and food to eat. Do you have the confidence?"
For the first time, Duann Lang was trusted and valued this much, his heart brimming with excitement and joy, upon hearing Ding Ling’s question, he immediately patted his chest and vowed:
"Yes! If I fail, I will present my head to the Venerable Lord!"
"No need to present your head, just do your best and remain true to your mission."
Ding Ling advised Duann Lang with a few words.
Urging him to prioritize talent acquisition and retention.
As for some who are brutally wicked, delighting in oppressing the innocent and kind citizens, there’s no need to keep such evildoers in Unrivaled City.
Such villains should either be killed or driven away.
Unrivaled City’s territory does not need such people.
Duann Lang listened attentively, nodding solemnly from time to time.
Ding Ling was infinitely stronger than Xiong Ba.
He was even the Emperor of the Lower Realm, too esteemed in position, and greatly revered by Duann Lang’s father as an elite!
Such a figure actually values him, Duann Lang, so highly!
Could he, Duann Lang, possibly have a reason not to swear allegiance?

Duann Lang initially harbored numerous other thoughts regarding Ding Ling, but upon Nie Feng’s introduction of Ding Ling, and learning his father was alive, Duann Lang was extremely excited and delighted, had it not been for the pressing affairs before him, he would have immediately sought to meet his father.
After Ding Ling finished advising Duann Lang.
Ding Ling waved his hand.
Urging Duann Lang to immediately prepare.
Duann Lang cheerfully left the room.
Following him out was Chengkun.
Chengkun left, naturally to announce that the Heroes Gathering had changed leadership!
Shangguan Jinhong, however, stood firm, staring intently at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling rose, ignoring him, intending to leave.
Yet, he stopped Ding Ling, very seriously saying:
"I have long heard how remarkable Hero Ding is. I consider myself to have some skills and wish to ask Hero Ding for guidance."
"You wish to spar with me?"
Ding Ling halted, glanced sideways and asked.
"I wouldn’t dare."
Shangguan Jinhong’s expression tightened, somewhat nervously he replied, "I know I’m absolutely no match for Hero Ding, merely seek your advice on my martial arts."
"Hehe."

Ding Ling chuckled lightly, knowing Shangguan Jinhong’s scheming mind, Ding Ling was proficient in Observing People Skills, seeing through it easily, it was obvious he wanted to use the pretext of seeking guidance to test Ding Ling’s competence.
If Ding Ling’s competence were indeed as the legends say, he would certainly avoid confrontation now and plan for another day.
If Ding Ling were lacking in competence, there’s a chance he’d immediately turn hostile.
Ding Ling had no inclination to indulge him, straightforwardly said:
"You want advice? What will you do if you lose?"
Shangguan Jinhong hesitated:
"If I lose, I lose. What else can be done?"
"Then why should I instruct you?"
Ding Ling questioned.
Shangguan Jinhong was speechless for a while, then said:
"I am willing to offer all the martial arts and wealth I have gathered."
"Unrivaled City is already mine. The martial arts and wealth you’ve gathered, are they not also mine?"
"Hero Ding, you, you, you..."
Shangguan Jinhong took a breath and said:
"Then consider my martial arts as the stake."
"Make your move."
"In that case, Hero Ding, I apologize!"

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 622: Dragon and Phoenix Ring
paragraphs: Shangguan Jinhong’s expression turned serious as he retreated three zhangs and suddenly waved his hand. A pair of Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings appeared in his hand out of thin air!

Nie Feng did not see how these rings ended up in Shangguan Jinhong’s hand and couldn’t help but feel a tightening in his heart. He secretly admired it, thinking that, as expected of the leader of the Heroes Gathering, his skills were indeed remarkable.
Clang, clang, clang!
Shangguan Jinhong suddenly threw the Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings toward Ding Ling’s direction.

As soon as these rings were released, they vanished into the void like lightning and light, becoming invisible and mysterious to the extreme. By the time they reappeared, they were already directly in front of Ding Ling.
Nie Feng gasped in awe.

Yet, these powerful martial skills and magical Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings were effortlessly caught by Ding Ling, who formed his palm into a claw and held them lightly, rendering them motionless.
Buzz, buzz!
The rings vibrated in his hand, and with a casual wave, Ding Ling returned the rings at twice the speed they came with, striking Shangguan Jinhong with a loud crash.
He spat blood, flying back several dozen zhangs, crashing into a small tree in the courtyard before barely coming to a stop.
"Such formidable skills!"
"Such a brilliant Dragon Claw Hand!"
Waves of turmoil filled Shangguan Jinhong’s heart lake, making it difficult to calm down. He forcibly endured his chest discomfort and stood up, clasping his hands toward Ding Ling.
"Thank you, Hero Ding, for sparing me. I admit my defeat. Later, I will write down everything I’ve learned and present it to you."
Ding Ling replied simply, "If there’s nothing else, why not lead me to the library in Unrivaled City for a look?"
"That is only right."
Now greatly in awe of Ding Ling, Shangguan Jinhong immediately led the way.
Ding Ling followed behind him.

Nie Feng also approached, deeply impressed in his heart. Shangguan Jinhong’s Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings had reached the realm of ’rings absent in the hand, yet present in the heart,’ a supreme state of martial arts. Once released, these rings were omnipresent and omnipotent.
If he were in that situation, he definitely wouldn’t have been able to catch that move.
Yet Ding Ling caught it with ease and countered effortlessly, injuring the opponent. Such power and technique were truly extraordinary.
Considering that even Emperor Shitian was defeated by Ding Ling.
Nie Feng found peace, yet secretly encouraged himself to train harder to not be left too far behind by his own Venerable Lord.
Some time later.
Ding Ling reached the library established by the Heroes Gathering.
He proceeded directly inside to read.
Nie Feng, meanwhile, stayed nearby to train.
Shangguan Jinhong took pen, ink, paper, and inkstone to transcribe all he had learned of heart techniques and moves.
He felt a deep sense of defeat in his heart.

Despite obtaining countless fortunes, his strength had far surpassed his past self numerous times. Yet his current peak move was so easily dismantled, a defeat as ultimate as this was a crushing blow for him.
"Such a talent, even a hundred of me wouldn’t win! If that’s the case, what am I striving for?"
In the face of Ding Ling, such a master.
No matter how many men, no matter how powerful a force, it was all in vain.
At this moment.
Shangguan Jinhong seemed to reach a significant enlightenment!
As he momentarily escaped the vortex of power, it was like finding redemption, and his entire soul seemed to transcend.
That move from Ding Ling struck both his heart and soul, enlightening and deeply affecting him!
"The massive force of the Heroes Gathering is crushed by a single human, Ding Ling! This is what it truly means to be strong!"
Shangguan Jinhong’s heart burned.
"Just be strong enough! Then anything can be obtained, otherwise, all becomes fleeting, insubstantial to further strikes!"
Recalling the intelligence reports on Ding Ling’s exceptional abilities.
And the recent sparring.

Shangguan Jinhong realized that no number of people could drown Ding Ling, rendering any force ineffective against him. Even if one conquered the entire Jiuzhou, Ding Ling alone could easily demolish them!
"I just don’t know if Ding Ling is really generous to his own people?"
A thought struck Shangguan Jinhong as he considered the intelligence reports on Ding Ling’s character.
Generous to his own.
Ruthless and merciless to his enemies.
Realizing the terrifying power of Ding Ling, Shangguan Jinhong naturally no longer wanted to oppose him. After all, he did not want to die, and he also wanted to taste the allure of the martial peak.
Once he stood at the pinnacle of martial arts in this world, could he not become the deity who overlooks Jiuzhou, speaking with authority, revered by millions?
He longed for it, anticipated it, dreamt of it.
Ding Ling did not know what Shangguan Jinhong was thinking, and even if he knew, he would not care.
He cared about how much the library before him could help his own improvement.
His reading was as swift as turning pages.
Reading tens of lines at a glance.
It must be said.
The volumes collected by the Heroes Gathering were indeed impressive in quantity.
Third-rate, second-rate, and unranked martial arts manuals were as numerous as the ocean, casually numbering tens of thousands.
Such manuals.
Upon reading, were instantly full level, yet had no effect on the Attribute Points.
They purely enhanced the foundation.
Upon finishing these tens of thousands of martial arts manuals.
Ding Ling’s foundation grew as solid as a mountain, as vast as the sea.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 67%]
Previously it was 64%.
An increase of 3 percentage points.
Comparing the progress from high-quality manuals.
These low-quality manuals indeed relied on quantity to win.
Ding Ling did not mind.
Since these manuals were read extremely quickly, practically a glance, and they reach full level.
Even the first-class manuals were no different.
After reading all the manuals here.
The final Furnace Body progress was 68%
This was because the vast majority of the library consisted of ordinary manuals.
Even the ordinary first-class manuals were scarcely over a hundred volumes.
And such manuals provided zero increase to Ding Ling’s Attribute Points.
"Hero Ding, here you go."

Shangguan Jinhong had been waiting by the side for several hours. As soon as Ding Ling finished reading everything, he proactively stepped forward and presented the transcribed manuals, which Ding Ling casually accepted and glanced at.
Flipped through.
[Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Instant full level.

Now, regarding how to use an exotic weapon like the Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings, Ding Ling understood it thoroughly. Though his proficiency might not match Shangguan Jinhong, in terms of understanding the rings’ heart techniques and moves, he was definitely not inferior.
Shangguan Jinhong watched in amazement.
Previously, Ding Ling’s reading was as quick as flipping pages.
After a few hours, he had read the entire library, and Shangguan Jinhong had surmised something.
Now, witnessing with his own eyes a series of strange ring-shaped lights emerging from Ding Ling in an instant, with Spiritual Vitality rushing toward him.
In a flash, he realized.
Ding Ling had indeed mastered the Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings!
"How did Hero Ding do it?!"
When he saw Ding Ling absorb a vast amount of Spiritual Vitality in an instant, despite his shock, Shangguan Jinhong couldn’t help but ask.

A pair of Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings appeared in his hand out of thin air!

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 623: Yitian and Dragon Slayer—Chengkun
paragraphs: "Just a glance, naturally it’s done."
Shangguan Jinhong felt as if struck by lightning.
Seeing Ding Ling’s carefree and natural demeanor, he felt as if his spirit had suffered ten thousand points of damage, starting to question his own existence.
Could it be that Shangguan Jinhong was truly just a mediocre talent?!
No, no, no!
Thinking back on his journey, apart from a few whose talents slightly surpassed his, most others were overwhelmed by him.
Shangguan Jinhong calmed down.
It’s not that I’m inadequate.
It’s Ding Ling who defies heaven and is extraordinarily gifted, completely beyond logic!
Who has ever learned and achieved Great Perfection in top martial arts just by a glance?!
This is too outrageous!
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling left directly.

However, the more he appeared so nonchalant as if nothing was surprising, the more Shangguan Jinhong felt awe and reverence, as if gazing at a high mountain, watching a myth, towering in his presence, unable to compare!

Nie Feng watched from the side, clearly seeing through it, smiled slightly, thinking that it’s normal for the Venerable Lord who learns Supreme martial arts like Black Tortoise True Skill and Ten Strong Martial Dao in an instant to not be concerned by the Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings, though they are extraordinary, can they compare to the Black Tortoise True Skill?
Ding Ling is not unconcerned; he has skin thick as a city wall, reaching a state of unperturbed equanimity in the face of others’ doubts and praise, remaining unmoved like a mountain!
This comes from many experiences.
Evolved!
Ding Ling then went to Unrivaled City’s second library and read books for two days.

The books here are mostly geographical, Confucianism, Legalist School, Mo Family School, agricultural studies, Buddhist Scripture, Dao Scripture, and other Secret Manuals collected by Heroes Gathering members from all directions.

Shangguan Jinhong is an ambitious and exceptionally wise person; he collected these books not only to improve his cultivation for a better understanding of this world but also wants to establish a vast library to attract native talents from everywhere for his use.
However, Unrivaled City now belongs to Ding.
The City Lord has changed to Duann Lang.
He naturally has no reason to keep these things hidden.
Under his proactive guidance, Ding Ling entered Unrivaled City’s largest second library.
Two days later.
[Wisdom +0.3]
[Buddha Qi +2 Dao]
[Vast Righteous Qi +1 Dao]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body progress 74%]
Previously, it was 68%.
Jumped 6 points.
One can imagine the vast amounts of books this second library possesses.
Despite Ding Ling’s cultivation reaching Full Level Grandmaster, reading rows and rows of books still required two days and nights.
The number of books here is unimaginable!
Abundant in richness!
Numbering in the tens of thousands!
Even causing a surge in Vast Righteous Qi, increasing by one more Dao.
This additional Dao concealed into his heart, guarding his soul, strengthening Ding Ling’s mental defenses by one degree, feeling increasingly solid and stable.
Without Vast Righteous Qi protection.
With Ding Ling’s root and physique easily invaded by Evil Qi, resisting the corrosion of Mad Blood or the invasion of Demon Qi would be challenging.
Fortunately, the Demon Scripture is now Full Level;
Also having Vast Righteous Qi and Buddha Qi protecting him, Ding Ling’s anxiety towards Demon Qi and Evil Qi is significantly reduced.
In Unrivaled City, Ding Ling unexpectedly did not see the Sword Saint.

According to Duann Lang’s words, "After Sword Saint comprehended the true Dugu Yifang being frozen, and later the false Dugu Yifang being killed by Nie Feng, the Unrivaled Yin Sword taken by Nie Feng and sent to World Association, the Young City Lord was seemingly killed by someone else. Knowing his days are numbered, he wished to resolve this grievance, so half a month ago, he proactively sent a challenge to Xiong Ba! Whether the fight is over is unknown now."
Ding Ling listened and frowned internally.
If the Sword Saint is dead.
The Twenty-Third Sword would then be completely out of reach.
He instructed Duann Lang to ascertain the truth.
After some time.
Duann Lang reported that Sword Saint went to World Association but didn’t find Xiong Ba, therefore the Sword Saint is now waiting near World Association for Xiong Ba’s return.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling wondered.
"Xiong Ba must be afraid."
Duann Lang said somewhat disdainfully:

"That old geezer is depraved and cunning. The Alien claimed Sword Saint’s Twenty-Third Sword is so remarkable. I know this, Xiong Ba surely knows too, he would choose to avoid out of fear naturally. Compared to the great force of World Association, how could anything be more important than his own life?"
Ding Ling wasn’t convinced.
As of now, he realized that this world is a combination of comics, movies, and TV dramas in the Wind and Cloud World.
Some parts of the plot resemble TV dramas.
Some are similar to comics and movies.
Add in players randomly entering.
Hence, the storyline falls apart, differing outcomes for many people are normal.
"Take care of Unrivaled City."
Ding Ling stood up, saying:
"I now need to make a trip to World Association."
"Rest assured, Venerable Lord."
Duann Lang assured:
"With me here, I will certainly ensure Unrivaled City thrives and becomes increasingly better."
Ding Ling smiled and said no more. He simply cast a deep glance at the corner where Chengkun was standing.
Chengkun was extremely low-key, and since he proactively relinquished his position, cooperating well with Duann Lang, Ding Ling couldn’t possibly kill him for no reason.

Thus, he glanced once at Chengkun and walked out of the Main Hall, swish! He executed the Wind God Leg, stepping on the whirlwind and rising over ten meters into the air, swishing into the distance swiftly.
Nie Feng closely followed.
The two sped along, rapidly disappearing from sight.

Chengkun’s back was already soaked with a fine sweat, not until Ding Ling left did he exhale deeply, having a premonition that if he dared act rashly, Ding Ling would definitely kill him with overwhelming force!

It’s precisely this impending sense of crisis, continuously urging him to madly cooperate with Duann Lang, not only that but diligently and meticulously accomplishing numerous tasks, perfectly executing them to a faultless degree!
Now that Ding Ling had left.
He began to consider escaping.
Staying in Unrivaled City was a mountainous pressure.
Ding Ling’s absence was alright; Ding Ling’s presence felt as if a Death God constantly watched over him, frightening him immensely!
"Chengkun."
Shangguan Jinhong and Chengkun had collaborated for some time, and after learning from the Alien what Chengkun actually did, he was quite familiar with him, he approached and stared, saying:
"Unrivaled City needs rebuilding, and requires you and me to work together; if you don’t want the Venerable Lord to target you, do your job well!"
"Hehe."
Chengkun nodded with a fake smile:
"It’s necessary, necessary!"
With a gesture towards Ding Ling’s direction:
"Venerable Lord is the Divine Being in my heart; I admire and respect him immensely! It’s an honor to serve him, who would refuse such an opportunity?"
"Excellent that you think so."
Shangguan Jinhong had received several pointers from Ding Ling, gaining some power.
His acknowledgment of Ding Ling increased substantially.
Moreover, he knew that to reach Supreme Martial Dao, one must find a backer; otherwise, reaching the top is challenging.
With Ding Ling’s exceptional talent, he is his chosen patron!

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 624: The Fall of the World Association
paragraphs: Shangguan Jinhong still didn’t believe it.
How could a person as gifted as Ding Ling not succeed!
As long as he holds onto the big leg tightly, he will leap through the Dragon Gate in the future, without a doubt.
Nie Feng was very familiar with the road to the World Association.
He led the way.
The two stopped several times along the way, witnessing a Jianghu more chaotic and bloodied than before.
Many masters that Ding Ling had never heard of emerged one after another, coupled with ’Ascenders’ who arrived in this world every day after ’shattering the void’.
This made the Jianghu increasingly unpredictable, impossible to see through.
On this day.
Ding Ling and Nie Feng arrived at the entrance of the main hall of the World Association.
Looking around.
A scene of desolation and ruin.
Quite different from the bustling and lively scene Ding Ling imagined.
"How did the World Association, once at its peak, suddenly become like this?!"
Nie Feng’s expression changed drastically, he activated his Wind God Leg to rush forward, observing carefully.

He saw corpses and fragments of bodies scattered everywhere at some critical spots of the World Association, the pungent smell of blood and scorched stench assaulted him, and Nie Feng’s breath halted, his complexion slightly pale:
"This, this, this..."
"It seems they were killed by someone."
Ding Ling was floating on a wind cluster, like the Wind God stepping on the void three feet above the ground, he scanned the surroundings expressionlessly, and said:

"It is a strong adversary, his Palm Power is earth-shattering, one palm can shatter the earth, making a massacre like this effortless, and his strength also possesses Thunderfire Power, which is why so many of these corpses seem charred."
Ding Ling saw clearly.
In the Martial Arts Arena ahead in the Earth Realm.
A massive handprint was embedded into the ground three feet deep!
In the center of the handprint, several fragments of bodies lay!
Clearly, these people tried to resist the intruder, only to be smashed by the intruder’s palm.
"Who the hell could it be?!"
Nie Feng walked onto the Martial Arts Arena, seeing one of the fragmented bodies, his body couldn’t help but tremble violently, his vision darkened, almost uncontrollably falling to his knees:
"Senior Brother Shuang!"
His eyes reddened, voice hoarse.
As if encountering a life-changing event, his entire being plunged into deep sorrow and anger at this moment.

Ding Ling initially didn’t recognize the identity of the fragmented protagonist until he heard Nie Feng’s words, he inspected more closely and finally recognized one of the fragmented bodies was Qin Shuang.
He was somewhat in disbelief as well.
The generous, kind, steady, and wise senior brother of the World Association met his end here?!
His interaction with Qin Shuang seemed just like yesterday.
Today upon seeing him again.
Qin Shuang had already departed to the Underworld.
Ding Ling sighed, Soaring in the Void, floated higher and higher, ascending hundreds of feet, looking down at the Lower Realm.
He saw clearly.
The World Association occupied a vast area, its palaces stretching far, resembling the grandeur and magnificence of the Imperial Palace, yet now this golden splendor was tainted with layers of blood.
Everywhere lay corpses and severed limbs.
Even the birds and beasts were killed in groups in the back courtyard and dense woods.
"Who on earth committed this massacre?"
Ding Ling descended to the Earth Realm, his feet touching the ground, employing Geomancy Skill, Stargazing Skill, Tracking and Tracing Technique, carefully observing.
Finally reaching a conclusion:
"The murderer acted the night before last."
"The night before last?"
Nie Feng seemed to regain his composure at this moment, his handsome face etched with rage:
"Venerable Lord, I must avenge Senior Brother Shuang."
He knelt on the ground:
"Please, Venerable Lord, lend me a hand."
He knew his ability was limited.
Absolutely incapable of defeating the one who easily killed Qin Shuang.
Ding Ling nodded and said:

"Rest assured. This person is so brutal. Inevitably, they are my mortal enemy. There will surely be combat. Go down the mountain to hire some people to come and clean up the World Association. From today onwards, the World Association is our territory."
Ding Ling came here to seize the World Association and meet the Sword Saint, hoping to learn the Twenty-Third Sword.
Unfortunately.
Upon his arrival here.
What he witnessed was the bloodied World Association.
The Sword Saint was also nowhere to be found.
"Yes. Venerable Lord."
Nie Feng went down the mountain.
Ding Ling then turned and entered the luxurious towers and jade pavilions of the World Association.
The towers here were built magnificently and grandly, showcasing the owner’s overbearing aura that could engulf mountains and rivers.
It was evident that Xiong Ba had indeed exerted a lot of effort in establishing the World Association.
Ding Ling walked along.
He saw not a living soul.
Fragments and pieces of corpses were seen not less than thousands.
The intruder’s action was swift, the method cruel, evident in every detail.
Thunk! Thunk!
Ding Ling arrived at the Library in the back courtyard.
Here stood a library.
When Ding Ling was looking down at the Lower Realm from high above, he saw clearly; now that there’s nothing to occupy his time, Ding Ling decided to take a look at the books here.
As for the murderous intruder who overturned the World Association?
Besides knowing they’re an unparalleled master, he had no other clues.
He could only take it step by step.
But one thing he was certain of.
That is to enhance strength.
As long as one’s strength is substantial.
Any bull, ghost, snake, god, Zhang San or Li Si, is just a slap away!
Crunch! Crunch!
Ding Ling pushed the door of the library, making a crunching sound, yet he couldn’t push it open.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling, skilled in Architecture Skill, Construction Skill, and Mechanical Skill, just a slight perception revealed that the library’s door was locked from the inside.
"Could someone be hiding in the library?"
Ding Ling wondered.
"Did the merciless killer, knowing the library was locked, not break in to kill those inside?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But this didn’t hinder him from opening the door.

A slight Vigorous Qi spurted from his palm, Bang! The door instantly flew several feet, to avoid damaging the books in the library, Ding Ling used Dragon Capturing Skill to catch the door in mid-air, casually toss it into the courtyard behind.
Almost at the same time he did this, two streaks of light suddenly shot from one side.
Ding Ling activated the protective shield.
Bang! Bang!
The streaks of light hit the shield, unable to break the defense, clattering to the ground, revealing their true forms, two exquisite sharp knives.
Following the direction of the light, Ding Ling looked and saw behind a bookshelf ten feet away, stood gracefully a maiden.

She had slender brows and apricot eyes, an elegant nose and small mouth, a hibiscus jade face now filled with panic, anger, resentment, and hatred, although her complexion was pale and bleak, it could not hide her peerless beauty and stunning appearance.
Ding Ling had seen many beauties.
The temperament and appearance of such a beautiful maiden could rival Xiao Qiao.
Indeed a rare beauty under the heavens.

But Ding Ling, having gone through much now, for a unfamiliar maiden daring to confront him, he had no intention of showing mercy, he suddenly grasped in mid-air, the prowess of Dragon Capturing Skill transformed into Dragon Claw Hand, forcefully pulling the beautiful maiden from ten feet away to his side.

How could a person as gifted as Ding Ling not succeed!
As long as he holds onto the big leg tightly, he will leap through the Dragon Gate in the future, without a doubt.
Nie Feng was very familiar with the road to the World Association.
He led the way.
The two stopped several times along the way, witnessing a Jianghu more chaotic and bloodied than before.
Many masters that Ding Ling had never heard of emerged one after another, coupled with ’Ascenders’ who arrived in this world every day after ’shattering the void’.
This made the Jianghu increasingly unpredictable, impossible to see through.

Nie Feng’s expression changed drastically, he activated his Wind God Leg to rush forward, observing carefully.

"This, this, this..."
"It seems they were killed by someone."

Ding Ling saw clearly.
In the Martial Arts Arena ahead in the Earth Realm.
A massive handprint was embedded into the ground three feet deep!

Clearly, these people tried to resist the intruder, only to be smashed by the intruder’s palm.

As if encountering a life-changing event, his entire being plunged into deep sorrow and anger at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 625: Youruo
paragraphs: The young girl screamed, wanting to struggle, but found herself tightly bound by an invisible force, unable to move an inch.
She thought about the scene just now where the flying knife was easily bounced away by the opponent’s protective gang qi.
Her heart like dead ashes, the young girl’s pretty face instantly dimmed, and she slightly closed her eyes, ready to face death.
Unexpectedly, the person didn’t kill her, but asked indifferently:
"Who are you?"
’Hmph!’
Clearly a resilient and somewhat proud girl, upon seeing Ding Ling not kill her, she opened her clear almond eyes, glanced at Ding Ling, and slightly raised her swan neck:
"I am your aunt, the biological daughter of Xiong Ba, Youruo!"
"Youruo."
Ding Ling suddenly realized, understanding it was Youruo made sense, no wonder she looked so beautiful. Ding Ling let go of her hand and walked to the side with his hands behind his back.
Youruo was filled with suspicion:
"You’re not going to kill me?!"
"Why should I kill you?"
Youruo paused, then said angrily:
"You killed so many people from the World Association. Killing one more like me should be easy for you, shouldn’t it?!"
"Which eye of yours saw me kill anyone from the World Association?"
Youruo paused again, blinked, and suspiciously asked:
"You didn’t kill them?"
Ding Ling didn’t answer her directly but responded with an unrelated statement:
"I am Nie Feng’s friend."
As soon as he said this, Youruo’s eyes lit up:
"Nie Feng’s friend? Really?"
"Do I have a reason to lie to you?"
Realizing this, Youruo hastily asked:
"Then where is Nie Feng? Where is he?"
"He went down the mountain to get people. After a while, he’ll come up to clear the remnants and bodies of the World Association."
Ding Ling casually replied and then picked up a book to start reading.
The library here also had a vast collection, roughly glancing at it, there seemed to be over a hundred thousand volumes.
By reading these books.
The progress of Ding Ling’s Martial Arts Melting Furnace would undoubtedly further advance.
"Really?"

Youruo, thinking she was about to see Nie Feng, couldn’t help but feel her heart fluttering rapidly, but soon she recalled those scenes of sparring with Ding Ling, couldn’t help but glance sideways and ask:
"Looking at your young age, how are you so powerful? Who are you?"
"My name is Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!
Youruo froze, and at this moment, she recalled various legends about Ding Ling and also a day she accidentally overheard a conversation between her father and the Child Emperor.
Her father intended to match her with someone, and that person was a young hero named Ding Ling.
Thinking of this, Youruo’s pretty face involuntarily turned unnatural.
"Right."
Ding Ling remembered something and asked:
"Besides this library, is there another library here?"
"Yes."
"Does Nie Feng know?"
"Yes."
With this, Ding Ling asked no more questions.

Although he was curious how Youruo managed to evade the pursuers, it was clear that Youruo knew nothing about how the intruder killed the people of the World Association, and she even mistakenly thought Ding Ling was the culprit.
It’s evident she probably discovered the tragic scene here later on.
By then, the murderer likely had already left.
And Youruo, in her fear, locked herself inside the library, which was understandable.
After all, it was the dead of night, with dead bodies and dismembered corpses everywhere, indeed, very horrifying.
Rustle!
Ding Ling read the books swiftly as if flipping through them.
He read through them for a day and a night.
He didn’t even know when Youruo left midway, nor did he care.

It was only on the second day at noon when Nie Feng brought Youruo to visit him. They said they had called in reinforcements and spent a day organizing the World Association properly. They asked what to do next.
Youruo followed Nie Feng closely, like an attachment.
For the tragic state of the World Association, she was genuinely angry and sad from the bottom of her heart, but seeing Nie Feng diluted much of these sorrows and sentiments.
Ding Ling glanced and instantly understood their state of mind at that moment.
Nie Feng was still engulfed by immense pain and anger and hadn’t moved past it. Ding Ling understood, pondered for a moment, and said:

"Announce it to the world, starting today. The World Association and Unrivaled City will merge into one. The Martial Arts of Jiuzhou must obey ’Great Ming’! Also, post notices to widely recruit talented people, be they scholarly talents or extraordinary martial artists."
"But the Jiuzhou Emperor still exists. Publicly governing the Jiuzhou land like this, won’t it..."
Nie Feng hesitated.
Ding Ling said:
"As for the emperor, I will make time to visit him. Whether he agrees or not, from today, all of Jiuzhou will belong to the Great Ming Dynasty."
Ding Ling’s goal was to unify Jiuzhou.
To consolidate the resources of Jiuzhou, gather Great Medicine, Secret Manuals, etc.
At the same time, laying a solid foundation for the future generation.

If his friends or family were to ascend to this world first, as long as Jiuzhou was under his control and leadership, his friends and family could naturally receive special attention, thereby experiencing rapid strength growth.
Moreover, Ding Ling would return to this world in the future.
He naturally wished for this world to get better and better.
Therefore.
The unification of Jiuzhou was imperative.
"Yes."
Nie Feng and Youruo took the orders and left.
Soon after.
With one carrier pigeon after another flying out from the World Association’s headquarters.
The news of Ding Ling wanting to control Jiuzhou spread at lightning speed throughout the Ten Directions Realm.
The Unrivaled City faction led by Duan Lang was the first to respond, indicating it was true!
This stirred up a sensation in Jianghu.
The court was shaken.
The emperor was furious and called upon heroes to capture Ding Ling, offering great rewards.

However, the major sects that understood Ding Ling’s combat prowess all kept a low profile, not only refusing to cooperate with the emperor but instead, when the forces of Unrivaled City and the World Association went up the mountain, they actively responded to Ding Ling’s call, successively joining Unrivaled City and the World Association.
With Duan Lang at the forefront in Unrivaled City, assisted by Shangguan Jinhong and others, they swept through without encountering much resistance.
The World Association, led by Nie Feng and supported by others like Youruo, similarly faced little resistance.
The great enterprise of unifying Jiuzhou.
Went exceedingly smoothly.
Time rewound.
After Nie Feng and Youruo had left.
Ding Ling continued to read.
He spent over two days in the first library.
Finally finished reading.
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Buddha Qi +3 Dao]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress 82%]
Previously, it was 74%.
It jumped 8 points.
It goes to show how rich the library’s collection was, even surpassing Unrivaled City in excellence.
The Buddha Qi also increased by a full 3 Dao.
The growth rate of wisdom, however, had diminished considerably.
This was expected, as wisdom was increasingly challenging to enhance. Ding Ling was well aware of this.
But the 0.2 increase.
Also enhanced his memory significantly, while his consciousness body became increasingly stable.
The power of the skill formed by the Godslaying Tribulation also strengthened a bit, naturally boosting the protective force on the sea of consciousness as well.
After finishing this library.
Ding Ling prepared to explore the next library.
Youruo had already given Ding Ling the map of this library.
