chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 626: Lü Bu of the Three Kingdoms
paragraphs: And Ding Ling, being the master of this World Association.
Whatever he wants to do, who dares to stop him?
The second library is hidden quite deeply.
It’s actually in a basement.
There aren’t many books inside.
But they’re all quite exquisite.
Whether it’s a Martial Arts Secret Manual or various military strategy theories, they’re all first-class.
Ding Ling spent two hours reading them all.
[Wisdom +0.1]
Though it’s a small amount, the wisdom increase equivalent to half of the previous collection.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress 85%]
It was 82% before.
Jumped by 3 points.
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
Three-dimensional Attribute Points growth is quite balanced.
Although the Martial Arts Secret Manual here are all above first-class.
But now, the ordinary first-class Secret Manual has no effect on Ding Ling’s attribute growth.
It can only enhance his foundation.
After reading the library.
Ding Ling went out, just walked to the main hall, someone reported that Lü Bu came to visit.
"Lü Bu?"
Ding Ling was surprised, he did not expect to meet Lü Bu in this world, but what is Lü Bu coming to him for?
"Let him come over."
"Yes, Venerable Lord."
The person said respectfully and quickly turned and left, obviously to call Lü Bu.
This person is a new disciple of the World Association.

Nie Feng and Youruo have selected eight hundred people from various branches of the World Association, as well as from Ascenders and scattered individuals who tried to ally with the World Association, filling important positions in the World Association headquarters to prevent it from looking empty and unseemly.
Nie Feng was previously the Hall Master of Divine Wind Hall, easily managing a gang.

And Youruo, gifted and perceptive, initially might be unfamiliar with these affairs, but under Nie Feng’s guidance, she has managed to handle them adeptly, making her more than capable as Nie Feng’s assistant.
Shortly thereafter.
Da-da!
In a burst of urgent footsteps.
The new disciple brought a man in.
This man is tall and broad, with a waist measuring ten spans!
Yet he is handsome, with a commanding presence.
No one else.
It is exactly Lü Bu.
"Lü Bu pays respects to the Prince!"
Lü Bu saw Ding Ling, his eyes brightened slightly, then his expression was slightly unusual, but he still unhesitatingly bowed deeply.
Calling Ding Ling Prince.
Naturally, because Ding Ling is the First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom in the Three Kingdoms World, an indisputable Supreme ruler. Behind-the-scenes Supreme Emperor!
Lü Bu, being a General of the Great Wei Kingdom, naturally has to obey Ding Ling.
"Have a seat."

Ding Ling gestured for Lü Bu to sit, and he himself took the main seat, surveying Lü Bu, noticing the restrained brilliance in his eyes, and his surging aura, clearly indicating signs of achieved Inner Power, he couldn’t help but say:
"Years have passed. Tell me about the Great Wei Kingdom."
Lü Bu knew what Ding Ling wanted to hear.
Immediately recounted the affairs of the Prince’s Mansion truthfully.
Along with a simple summary of his journey.
Only then did Ding Ling learn.
Shortly after his own ascension, Lü Bu couldn’t wait to ascend as well.
Regarding many matters of the Prince’s Mansion, he heard from other Ascenders who ascended from the Three Kingdoms World.
As for where Lü Bu went after ascending?
He went to Green Blood Sword World, Romantic Swordsman, and The Generation’s Twin Heroes, these three worlds successively.
Avoiding perfectly all the worlds Ding Ling ascended to.
Until this ascension.
He ascended to the same world as Ding Ling.

His talent is extraordinary, his potential remarkable, his opportunities not trivial, thus his cultivation is now considerable, initially descending into this world, he was full of confidence, but after personally witnessing a shocking battle, his heart turned cold, and he came to seek refuge with Ding Ling without hesitation, looking for support.
After speaking.
Lü Bu said sincerely and earnestly:
"I hope the Prince can take me in! I will do my utmost to fulfill any task assigned by the Prince!"
"You can stay."
Lü Bu was overjoyed.
"But if I find you have ulterior motives, watch your dog life!"
This was said very indifferently and calmly.

Lü Bu felt his heart skip a beat, quickly swore assurance, finally saying that as a General in the Three Kingdoms World, he served different masters and couldn’t help himself, hoping Ding Ling would forgive him and such.
Ding Ling just chuckled lightly, waved his hand to signal the matter to be put aside.
Lü Bu coming to serve him, this World Association indeed needs some experts to keep things stable, Ding Ling had no reason to refuse.
Besides.
His grievances with Lü Bu are long past, Lü Bu serving as a General under his command, to risk his life for him, if he didn’t accept, what would others think of him as the King?
Thus.
Ding Ling shifted the topic, asking Lü Bu about the battle he witnessed.
Lü Bu’s expression was serious, with fear in his eyes:

"I saw someone suddenly descend from the celestial sphere, casually struck a palm, and shattered an island. I happened to ascend nearby another island adjacent to it and was petrified. I dared not move or flee, then I saw a large hand stretch out from another dimension, striking towards that palm..."
Lü Bu’s description was very detailed.
Ding Ling grew more confused as he listened.
Just because Lü Bu’s description was too exaggerated.
This casual island-splitting palm.
A celestial palm falling, causing the sky to quake, tearing open fissures!
Are these really humans?
He asked Lü Bu if he saw clearly who those two were?
Lü Bu shook his head:

"I only saw the two giant hands manifesting from their divine techniques! Although they weren’t far from me, they also weren’t near, and their surroundings were shrouded in mist, seemingly like deities, I couldn’t see through the clouds to discern their true faces."
Ding Ling pondered for a while, then said:
"Alright. I understand. From now on, stay in this World Association, as a Hall Master. Go on expeditions with Nie Feng and Youruo, to expand territories."
"Yes, Prince."
Lü Bu instinctively accepted the command, but soon hesitated to ask:
"Prince, how do you compare to these two people?"
He could often hear about Ding Ling’s terrifying prowess and reputation from outsiders even in other worlds.
In this world, Ding Ling’s achievements and legends are even more frequently heard.
Recalling Ding Ling’s invincible deity image in the Three Kingdoms World.
Lü Bu’s confidence in Ding Ling soared, eager to curry favor, is clear evidence!
"Is this something you should be concerned about?"
Ding Ling glanced expressionlessly at Lü Bu, saying:
"If you don’t want to do it, just say so. I won’t force you."
"No, no, no."
Lü Bu quickly said:
"I was reckless and crashed into the Prince. I’ll go report to Nie Feng and Youruo now."
"Hmm. Go ahead."
Lü Bu respectfully saluted Ding Ling before leaving.
Ding Ling was contemplating, who exactly are these two super-powerful beings Lü Bu mentioned?
Could they be related to the people who massacred the World Association elites?

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 627: God of Capture
paragraphs: How exactly?
Difficult to analyze.

Ding Ling didn’t think much, just felt it was necessary to speed up the unification of Jiuzhou. After all, the world is full of emerging experts; it’s better to improve oneself sooner rather than later to avoid long nights full of dreams.
Ding Ling stood up.
He prepared to take a trip to the Imperial City.
As for the Ascenders who kept coming in to seek refuge, Ding Ling had someone pass a message to Nie Feng and Youruo, letting them handle it as they saw fit.
Those who were reliable and highly skilled could be accepted.
Ding Ling arrived at the Imperial City.

This Imperial City was very luxurious, even more overbearing and majestic than Xiong Ba’s World Association by several times. Walking through it, there was a feeling of being in a Jade Light Treasure Land.
Thinking of the description of the current emperor in the original novel, Ding Ling was at ease.
The novel repeatedly mentioned either directly or indirectly the decadence of the current era, saying the emperor neglected state affairs and lived recklessly.
With such an emperor.
The grandeur of the Imperial Palace becomes understandable.
It’s just...
"Is this Imperial City always so silent?"
Ding Ling walked through the corridors of the pavilions and towers, the sound of his footsteps echoing all around. Besides that, it was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
"Could something have happened?"
Ding Ling’s eyebrows twitched.
He performed the Free-Will Ascension Step, Shrinking Inches, his figure swiftly moving, reaching a hundred yards away in no time. This time, delving deeper into the Imperial City, he saw clearly.
Indeed, many people had died.
There were also those who were barely clinging to life.
It seemed the culprit shouldn’t have gotten far?
Or maybe they were nearby.

Ding Ling merely glanced at the wounds of these victims and knew their causes of death were completely different from those of the World Association. The people of the World Association died terribly, and Qin Shuang was even crushed with a single slap.
It’s important to know that Qin Shuang wasn’t an ordinary person.
To easily shatter Qin Shuang’s body with a slap, collapsing the ground by nearly three feet, was reaching an incredible level of power.
This expert was inclined towards killing with brute force, charging recklessly.
Whereas the dead in the Imperial City died quietly, mostly with slit throats or poisoned.
It showed that the perpetrator was an assassin-type character.
Ding Ling walked to the Imperial Palace Main Hall and saw the emperor dead on the Emperor’s Seat, along with court officials lying in a pool of blood.
The pungent smell of blood assailed his nostrils.
Ding Ling’s expression changed slightly:
"All dead."
He looked at the emperor on the throne, thinking of players invading, Ascenders endlessly entering this court and Jianghu, wondering if the emperor of this world was still Wuchang?
Or was it Wenlong?
Judging by the timeline.
At this point, Wenlong shouldn’t have met Wu Wudi yet? And hadn’t been taught the Black Tortoise True Skill?
But with the plot breaking down, who knows if Wenlong might have another adventure?
Ding Ling only saw the emperor’s corpse but did not see the body of someone who looked exactly like him.
It seemed Wuchang and Wenlong could both be alive, or perhaps only one had died. After all, who could definitively say the current emperor wasn’t an imposter?
Ding Ling shook his head and turned to leave.
He hadn’t come to the Imperial City with the intent to kill; he had come to quickly subdue the current emperor and complete the unification endeavor.
Only then could he concentrate on improving himself, facing the calamities he might encounter next.
The person who could easily wipe out everyone in the World Association, silently ’frighten away’, ’abduct’, or defeat the Sword Saint, was no simple character.
This person would certainly not watch him, Ding Ling, rise smoothly and unify Jiuzhou.
He might just suddenly appear one day, dealing a thunderous blow.
Ding Ling was mentally prepared for this.
He even specifically instructed Nie Feng to send a Pigeon Post to Duann Lang, to be extra cautious and wary of strangers during this time, lest they be taken advantage of and lose their lives.
Da da!
Just as Ding Ling stepped out of the Imperial Palace Main Hall, a rush of footsteps suddenly came from afar.
Sounds that were a hundred meters away one second were right next to him the next.
Ding Ling focused his gaze.

He saw the newcomer dressed in black, wearing a mask that only revealed a pair of eyes that flickered with a sharp gleam. Surveying the scene behind Ding Ling in the Main Hall, the figure quivered upon seeing everything, looking at Ding Ling with disbelief:
"Did you kill the emperor and the court officials?"
"No."
Ding Ling didn’t know who this person was, but he assumed they probably weren’t a villain, hence his rather amicable disposition.
"If not you, then who else?!"
The man in black roared with fury:
"Who exactly are you? Why such ruthlessness? Not even the three-year-old children in the Imperial City were spared!
Along the way.
Ding Ling saw countless corpses.
There were the elderly, the weak, and even women and children.
He even witnessed a lovely two- or three-year-old child fall dead at their home’s entrance, eyes unclosed in death, which deeply moved him. Understanding the man’s unbridled fury, he calmly said:
"My name is Ding Ling. If I wanted to kill such defenseless people, I would do it openly. Young children, innocent and powerless, I would not stoop to harm them."
"You are Ding Ling!"
The man in black seemed to have heard of Ding Ling’s reputation and unconsciously stepped back, but quickly stepped forward again:
"I know you. Rumor has it you want to unify Jiuzhou. The emperor ordered your capture, so did you kill the entire Royal Family because of that?"
Ding Ling looked deeply at the man in black, patiently responding once more:
"For the last time, I didn’t kill anyone in this Imperial City. Although I’m not a righteous man, I own up to my deeds. If I killed, I killed; if I didn’t, I didn’t!"
With those words,
Ding Ling performed the Free-Will Ascension Step, Shrinking Inches, in one leap, bypassing the man in black. In the next instant, he was already a hundred yards away, nearly disappearing from sight.
Suddenly, a man leapt out from the side, stabbing a sword towards Ding Ling:
"Stop!"
Ding Ling didn’t dodge. The Vigorous Qi of Star Shifting enveloped him, and as the other’s sword thrust at him, it was spun and redirected with a strange gesture towards the attacker’s own heart.
The attacker was shocked, hurriedly releasing the sword, yet he was still pierced in the shoulder by a Sword Qi, letting out a muffled groan as he was sent flying several yards away:
"How brilliant a technique of leveraging force! Who are you?"
"His name is Ding Ling."
The man in black flew forward, shouting loudly:
"God of Capture, stop him, don’t let him go. He killed the emperor and the full court of civil and military officials."
"What?"
The one called God of Capture was none other than Xiong Ba’s son, Long Teng.
Half his face was covered with an iron mask, the other half a picture of resilience.
He was tall, with a remarkable presence.
The image he presented was clearly that of an iron-faced, unbending God of Capture.
These two words, ’God of Capture’, were a fitting reflection of his character.
At this moment, hearing the man in black’s words, shock crossed his face. Quickly, his eyes filled with rage and sorrow as he yelled at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, why did you commit such a dastardly act?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 628: Yitian Dragon Slayer - Little Zhao
paragraphs: Ding Ling sighed softly.
How many times had he explained already?
If it weren’t for the fact that these two were considered righteous people, he would have ended them with a slap.
He wanted to leave directly but suddenly thought of the few people he had seen on the long street before, barely hanging on to life.
So he moved his form.
He executed the Free-Will Ascension Step and disappeared in an instant.
His Lightweight Body Technique had reached the pinnacle of perfection.
In the blink of an eye, he vanished like a wisp of smoke before the two of them.
The God of Capture and the man in black couldn’t see how exactly Ding Ling disappeared. They only saw a flash of illusion in the void, and then, Ding Ling’s trace was completely gone.
"Ghost Tiger. Did you see where he went?"
The God of Capture looked shocked.
He had long heard of Ding Ling’s legend and strength.
Today he saw it.
Only then did he understand the saying that his reputation was well-deserved.
"No."

The man in black was none other than Ghost Tiger, one of Wuming’s three servants. His Lightweight Skill was superb, his Cultivation was impressive, and he had had many fortuitous encounters recently, causing his abilities to rise significantly, far surpassing the past. Yet even so, facing Ding Ling, he still felt a smallness and powerlessness akin to facing a towering mountain or looking at the ocean:
"Even my master has never given me such pressure! The oppressive feeling! Truly worthy of being a Mythical Level figure who can defeat Emperor Shitian!"
Ghost Tiger’s eyes were also filled with awe:

"Looking at his age, he is no more than a youth. Even if it is as the Aliens say, that Ding Ling’s Cultivation has reversed his age, making him young again, his actual age is still not great! At such an age, to have such astonishing Cultivation and Body Technique, it truly leaves others in the dust."
"Indeed."
The God of Capture looked into the distance:

’We are no match for Ding Ling, Elder Wuming should be arriving soon. When he arrives, we will have him accompany us to the World Association. I believe, with Elder Wuming’s intervention, Ding Ling will surely give us an explanation.’
Ghost Tiger let out a sigh.
The people were dead.
What good is an explanation?
Dead people cannot come back to life, after all.
As the two were conversing.
Whoosh whoosh!
A sound of breaking through the air suddenly came.
The two looked towards the direction of the sound, only to see an outstanding and composed middle-aged man, with a touch of transcendence in his demeanor, treading through the air.
Though he was taking one step at a time, seemingly slowly, he was moving like lightning, and in no time, arrived before Ghost Tiger and the God of Capture.
Behind this middle-aged man.
Were also a man and a woman, both with extraordinary appearances.
These three were none other than Wuming and his other two servants, Dragon King and Phoenix Dance.
The trio came together.
Wuming’s aura enveloped their forms, causing their speed to be as fast and swift as the wind, reaching the maximum.
"Greetings, Master (Salutations, Elder)!"
Ghost Tiger and the God of Capture hurriedly saluted Wuming.
Wuming nodded, looked behind the two of them, and upon seeing the situation in the Imperial Palace Main Hall, couldn’t help but tremble and show a sad expression, sighing:
"Alas. After all, I came a step too late!"
Seeing the expressions of the God of Capture and Ghost Tiger as if they had something to say, he said:
"Do you perhaps have some findings?"
The two then recounted the previous events.
Wuming listened, frowned, pondered for a while, and said:
"I know a little about Ding Ling’s matters. If he says he didn’t kill, then there is a certain possibility. At his level and strength, he should have no need to lie to deal with you."
"But the wounds on the people here are fresh, indicating they died not long ago. And Ding Ling happened to be here."
Ghost Tiger was puzzled.
"If he truly is a cold-blooded killer, do you think you and the God of Capture could safely stand here?"

Wuming’s words made the God of Capture and Ghost Tiger tremble, as if struck by lightning. They were suddenly enlightened, yet a sense of guilt arose in them, though they still had many unresolved questions in their hearts:
"If he didn’t kill them, why did he run?"
"Isn’t it because you two were shouting to attack and capture him?"
Wuming stood with his hands behind his back, looking into the distance:
"Just now, I seemed to sense an extremely special Sword Intent. This Sword Intent contained multiple layers of extremely complex Sword Intents. Who is it?"
He was moved:
"To be able to cultivate so many Sword Intents at once and melt them together perfectly, it’s extraordinary. Could it be he who killed them?!"
He moved like the wind, hurrying toward the sensed direction.
Soon after.
He arrived.
And saw a young man, with a towering stature, majestic demeanor, and handsome appearance, healing a dying girl of about sixteen or seventeen.

His keen vision could naturally see that this dying girl, under the treatment of the young man, was rapidly improving. The girl, who was about to die, with her feet almost stepping into the Ghost Gate.
Now, she was recovering at an astonishing speed.
Her face, which was as white as paper, began to turn rosy with blood color, and she looked like a sleeping beauty with exceptional beauty.
"Master."
Ghost Tiger and the others followed and arrived, seeing the young man, Ghost Tiger’s pupils constricted:
"Ding Ling!"
"Is he Ding Ling?"
Wuming was surprised, then relieved:
"I was wondering who could possess such complex and ultimate Sword Intent in their body, it turns out to be the Mythical Level powerhouse Ding Ling who can defeat Emperor Shitian."
The term "Mythical Level powerhouse" came from the Aliens.
Spread by many, widely recognized.
Naturally, Wuming also adopted such a way to refer to Ding Ling now.
"Master, do you want to..."
"Wait."
Wuming raised his hand to stop Ghost Tiger and the others, saying:
"Watch."
As they awaited.
A quarter of an hour later.
The girl whimpered softly and woke up.
She touched her neck in disbelief at first, then carefully sensed her own condition, and after confirming that she was well, she was a little dazed:
"I clearly, clearly remember I..."
The girl was dazed for just a moment, then noticed the warm hands on her back, turned her head, and met Ding Ling’s eyes.
In that instant.
The girl understood what had happened:
"You saved me."
"Yes."
This was a fact; Ding Ling had no reason to hide it.
"Thank you, thank you!"
The girl looked grateful, moved:
"My name is Little Zhao. May I know the benefactor’s name?"
"Little Zhao?"

Ding Ling had long noticed Wuming and his group approaching. If they didn’t attack, so be it. But if they did, Ding Ling certainly wouldn’t hold back anymore. Anyone could see he was saving people; how could Wuming not see? If so, how could Ding Ling show mercy then?
But evidently, Wuming was someone with an extraordinary bearing, far more composed than Ghost Tiger, and did not make a move but instead waited by the side.
In this point.
Ding Ling was quite appreciative.
After healing the girl, he intended to leave, but unexpectedly heard a familiar name, which caught him off guard.

sentences.text: Ding Ling sighed softly.
How many times had he explained already?
If it weren’t for the fact that these two were considered righteous people, he would have ended them with a slap.
He wanted to leave directly but suddenly thought of the few people he had seen on the long street before, barely hanging on to life.
So he moved his form.
He executed the Free-Will Ascension Step and disappeared in an instant.
His Lightweight Body Technique had reached the pinnacle of perfection.
In the blink of an eye, he vanished like a wisp of smoke before the two of them.
The God of Capture and the man in black couldn’t see how exactly Ding Ling disappeared.
They only saw a flash of illusion in the void, and then, Ding Ling’s trace was completely gone.
"Ghost Tiger.
Did you see where he went?"
The God of Capture looked shocked.
He had long heard of Ding Ling’s legend and strength.
Today he saw it.
Only then did he understand the saying that his reputation was well-deserved.
"No."
The man in black was none other than Ghost Tiger, one of Wuming’s three servants.
His Lightweight Skill was superb, his Cultivation was impressive, and he had had many fortuitous encounters recently, causing his abilities to rise significantly, far surpassing the past.
Yet even so, facing Ding Ling, he still felt a smallness and powerlessness akin to facing a towering mountain or looking at the ocean:
"Even my master has never given me such pressure!
The oppressive feeling!
Truly worthy of being a Mythical Level figure who can defeat Emperor Shitian!"
Ghost Tiger’s eyes were also filled with awe:
"Looking at his age, he is no more than a youth.
Even if it is as the Aliens say, that Ding Ling’s Cultivation has reversed his age, making him young again, his actual age is still not great!
At such an age, to have such astonishing Cultivation and Body Technique, it truly leaves others in the dust."
"Indeed."
The God of Capture looked into the distance:
’We are no match for Ding Ling, Elder Wuming should be arriving soon.
When he arrives, we will have him accompany us to the World Association.
I believe, with Elder Wuming’s intervention, Ding Ling will surely give us an explanation.’
Ghost Tiger let out a sigh.
The people were dead.
What good is an explanation?
Dead people cannot come back to life, after all.
As the two were conversing.
Whoosh whoosh!
A sound of breaking through the air suddenly came.
The two looked towards the direction of the sound, only to see an outstanding and composed middle-aged man, with a touch of transcendence in his demeanor, treading through the air.
Though he was taking one step at a time, seemingly slowly, he was moving like lightning, and in no time, arrived before Ghost Tiger and the God of Capture.
Behind this middle-aged man.
Were also a man and a woman, both with extraordinary appearances.
These three were none other than Wuming and his other two servants, Dragon King and Phoenix Dance.
The trio came together.
Wuming’s aura enveloped their forms, causing their speed to be as fast and swift as the wind, reaching the maximum.
"Greetings, Master (Salutations, Elder)!"
Ghost Tiger and the God of Capture hurriedly saluted Wuming.

"Alas.
After all, I came a step too late!"
Seeing the expressions of the God of Capture and Ghost Tiger as if they had something to say, he said:
"Do you perhaps have some findings?"
The two then recounted the previous events.
Wuming listened, frowned, pondered for a while, and said:
"I know a little about Ding Ling’s matters.
If he says he didn’t kill, then there is a certain possibility.
At his level and strength, he should have no need to lie to deal with you."
"But the wounds on the people here are fresh, indicating they died not long ago.
And Ding Ling happened to be here."
Ghost Tiger was puzzled.
"If he truly is a cold-blooded killer, do you think you and the God of Capture could safely stand here?"
Wuming’s words made the God of Capture and Ghost Tiger tremble, as if struck by lightning.
They were suddenly enlightened, yet a sense of guilt arose in them, though they still had many unresolved questions in their hearts:
"If he didn’t kill them, why did he run?"
"Isn’t it because you two were shouting to attack and capture him?"
Wuming stood with his hands behind his back, looking into the distance:
"Just now, I seemed to sense an extremely special Sword Intent.
This Sword Intent contained multiple layers of extremely complex Sword Intents.
Who is it?"
He was moved:
"To be able to cultivate so many Sword Intents at once and melt them together perfectly, it’s extraordinary.
Could it be he who killed them?!"
He moved like the wind, hurrying toward the sensed direction.
Soon after.
He arrived.
And saw a young man, with a towering stature, majestic demeanor, and handsome appearance, healing a dying girl of about sixteen or seventeen.
His keen vision could naturally see that this dying girl, under the treatment of the young man, was rapidly improving.
The girl, who was about to die, with her feet almost stepping into the Ghost Gate.
Now, she was recovering at an astonishing speed.
Her face, which was as white as paper, began to turn rosy with blood color, and she looked like a sleeping beauty with exceptional beauty.
"Master."

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 629: Wuming
paragraphs: "That’s right."
Little Zhao quickly said:

"I am an Ascender from the Lower Realm. I only ascended to this Imperial City a couple of days ago. Just as I was trying to figure out this world’s situation, someone nearly killed me. If not for my benefactor’s rescue, I would’ve died here..."
She paused upon saying this, and suddenly screamed ’Mother!’ after seemingly seeing something.
She struggled to her feet, staggered over to the bottom of a nearby beam, and fell to her knees beside a corpse, looking utterly devastated.
Little Zhao, though young, was already an exceptionally beautiful young woman.
Even in her panic, despair, and sadness, her stunning beauty and unmatched elegance were hard to conceal.
Ding Ling walked over to look at the corpse and saw that it belonged to an old woman who seemed to be seventy or eighty years old.
But upon closer inspection,
Ding Ling knew the old woman was wearing a human-skin mask.
Little Zhao was no ordinary girl; although she was gentle, considerate, innocent, charming, and generous, she had a very resilient side deep within.
After a moment of distraction, she came back to her senses and couldn’t help but ask Ding Ling:
"Benefactor, my mother, is she beyond saving?"
"She’s already lost her vitality. There’s no way to bring her back."
Ding Ling, although his medical skills were godlike, and his Longevity Venerable Qi was unbelievably restorative, and even the incomplete Holy Heart Technique had significant healing capabilities.
However, he had just exhausted both streams of Longevity Venerable Qi to save Little Zhao, who was almost completely dead, and the Vigorous Qi of the Holy Heart Technique was also entirely depleted.
At this time, he was powerless to save Little Zhao’s mother.
Unless Ding Ling obtained the complete version of the Holy Heart Technique, there might be a chance.
"The dead cannot come back to life. My condolences."
Wuming also came over to comfort Little Zhao with a few words.

Now that Little Zhao was alive again, she looked like a delicate lotus flower in the morning dew, astonishingly beautiful—a sight that even someone like Wuming couldn’t help but turn to look at her, revealing her exceptional and incomparable beauty.
Youruo was extremely beautiful, but compared to Little Zhao, she was slightly less so.
"Thank you, Senior, for your comfort."
Little Zhao, with tears streaming down her face, said:
"My mother didn’t have a good life in the Lower Realm. I didn’t expect that after just two days in the Upper Realm, she would die so tragically in this Imperial City."
She reached out and took off her mother’s human-skin mask:
"Since my mother is dead, I must dress her beautifully and let her leave gracefully."
Once the mask was removed,
a face of indescribable elegance and beauty appeared right before Ding Ling’s eyes.
Ding Ling was taken aback.

If Little Zhao was beautiful enough to evoke sympathy, then this woman’s beauty was enough to bring ruin to a nation. Even in death, her pale face brightened the room with brilliance, and her stunning appearance was unparalleled, making one lament that such a beauty had perished just like that.
Little Zhao’s mother was called Daisi.
She was buried outside the Imperial City.
Ding Ling was the one who completed the task of erecting the stone monument and engraving words upon it.
Wuming and others accompanied Ding Ling and Little Zhao throughout.
The God of Capture went to arrange for people to clear the corpses in the Imperial City.
Everyone divided their work clearly, and everything appeared quite harmonious on the surface.

"The craftsmanship of this stone monument, the dragon-and-phoenix-like calligraphy, both are at the level of Transformation Realm. An Alien once said you, Ding Ling, can do anything. I was skeptical before, but seeing this, I believe it a bit more now."
Wuming admired:
"So young, and your Martial Arts are impressive, and your calligraphy is not weaker than that of the Calligraphy Saint. Truly admirable."
He paused, then said:
’Now that Daisi has been buried and honored, Ding Ling, can we have a talk?’
"What do you want to discuss?"
Ding Ling straightened up, glanced at Wuming and his group, and asked calmly.
Little Zhao followed Ding Ling closely.
At that moment,
it seemed she had set her heart on Ding Ling, and his shadow began to appear in her eyes and mind.
In the Lower Realm,
because of the Alien’s meddling, although Little Zhao knew Zhang Wuji, she didn’t have much emotional entanglement with him, and naturally, there was no talk of love.
She and Daisi chose to ascend because the enmities and romances of the Lower Realm were too complicated. They sought to avoid them and grow stronger, so they ascended to the Upper Realm.
Unexpectedly, they encountered misfortune. Little Zhao almost died, and Daisi did not survive and passed away.

Though young, she had experienced quite a bit, but this was the first time she had encountered such a dangerous situation. Ding Ling had spent an immense amount of True Qi to forcibly pull her back from the Ghost Gate, which was unimaginably difficult.
Therefore, she felt immense gratitude towards Ding Ling, almost to an unlimited extent.
In her mind, her life was given by Ding Ling.
The rest of her life should be dedicated to serving and sacrificing for Ding Ling.
Because of this belief, she steadfastly stood behind Ding Ling.

"I rushed to the Imperial City this time to act as an intermediary, to convince the Emperor to negotiate with you. I don’t want Jiuzhou to erupt into war, causing suffering, and allowing places like Japan to take advantage.
Wuming sighed deeply:
"I just didn’t expect that I ultimately arrived a step too late."
Little Zhao had extraordinary fortune and acquired the Breathing Technique.
Her strength was profound.
Because she was standing behind Daisi at that time, she received less of the pressure. She roughly saw the appearances of the people who massacred and poisoned the city.
There were two of them.
One was tall and slender with a heroic yet slightly evil air;
the other was a man cloaked in a metallic mask, with a ghostly figure.
These two were completely different from Ding Ling, clearly making it impossible for them to be the killers.
Ghost Tiger and the God of Capture, upon learning this, apologized to Ding Ling twice for it.
"Given the situation, what’s your next move, Wuming?"
"I will investigate who killed the emperor."
Wuming’s eyes were deep, his expression solemn as he said:
"The World Association and the Imperial City suffered massacres one after another. The intentions of the assailants are significant. I must stop them before the calamity erupts."
"I wish you success."
"Thank you."
Wuming stepped forward two paces, staring at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, do you still plan to unify Jiuzhou?"
"What else?"
Ding Ling locked eyes with Wuming, his gaze steady as a still lake, revealing no emotion:
"Do you think this land, without an emperor and officials, won’t fall into chaos? If no one steps forward to unify Jiuzhou, others will take advantage, and the common folk will suffer."
Wuming paused, saying:
"You have a point."
He paused again, took a deep look at Ding Ling: "But I hope you can be a good emperor, for the country and the people, to protect the innocent from the ravages of war."
"Of course."
Ding Ling said:
"I have a proposition."
"Please say."
Seeing Ding Ling so approachable, Wuming relaxed quite a bit, his approval and fondness for Ding Ling increasing significantly.
"I want to exchange Cultivation Techniques with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 630: Mysterious Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: "Exchange cultivation techniques?"
Wuming was taken aback.
"What’s wrong?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"Wuming, you are a martial arts myth. A person of righteous spirit and noble character, indifferent to fame and fortune, with a heart for the world. You, such a person, are a grandmaster admired by thousands. Could it be that you hold to sectarian prejudices?"
"This..."
Wuming was speechless:
"I’m not as perfect as you say."

"Regardless of the truth. Wuming, you must have learned the truth of this world from various channels. Do you think, if no one stands out, by relying on yourself alone, you can withstand the impending disasters?"
Wuming’s expression tightened, and he solemnly said:
"What you say makes a lot of sense. What do you mean?"
"Exchanging martial arts. It can strengthen us both. As we become stronger, we will naturally be more capable of dealing with the forthcoming disasters."
"Alright."
Wuming hesitated for only a moment, then said:

"Many of my martial arts are self-realized and self-created. Teaching them to you shouldn’t be much of a problem. I only hope that you genuinely strive for the people of this world and the empire of Jiuzhou, and do your best."
"Since I have unified Jiuzhou and become the emperor of this region, it stands to reason that I would not neglect matters. Haven’t you heard enough about my deeds, Wuming?"
Ding Ling countered.
Wuming nodded and said:

"I have indeed heard a lot about your affairs. I also have some understanding of you. Now, meeting face to face with you, your demeanor and martial arts move me deeply. At your age, to possess such cultivation and bearing is truly remarkable."
He paused and said:
"I see you are a decisive person. In that case, let us find a place to exchange cultivation techniques."
"Alright."
Wuming and Ding Ling came to a courtyard in the eastern part of the Imperial City.
This place must have been a martial arts hall before.
The Martial Arts Arena was quite large.
Wuming and Ding Ling stood in the center of the Martial Arts Arena.
Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, Phoenix Dance, and Little Zhao watched from not far away.
The God of Capture was still busy handling various errands in the Imperial City.
"I have a set of Mysterious Swordsmanship, let me demonstrate it for you first."
Wuming was a magnanimous person, possessing the grace of a grandmaster. Having made his decision, he did not hold back and immediately began to demonstrate his Mysterious Swordsmanship to Ding Ling.
He explained the mantra while elucidating the essence and esoteric truth of the sword technique.
Simple in explanation, yet it went straight to the heart.
Ding Ling watched and listened carefully.
After one demonstration.
Wuming sheathed his sword and asked if Ding Ling had memorized it.
Ding Ling nodded and quickly ran it through his mind.
The next moment.
[Mysterious Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Physique +0.2]
This swordsmanship was of grandmaster peak-level, its greatest power residing in its mysterious sword intent.
The stronger the sword intent.
The greater the power this swordsmanship could unleash.
This was a sword that could directly shatter one’s heart!
Boom!

Upon reaching full level, streams of mysterious sword intent surged wildly from Ding Ling’s body. This sword intent was perfect and flawless, containing various mysterious powers, such as inexplicable sorrow, reaching a state of perfect satisfaction.
Wuming was dumbfounded.
Wuming’s three servants, Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, and Phoenix Dance, were also shocked and incredulous:

"This sword intent! Unbelievable! Jian Chen was already considered a genius in the way of the sword, yet he was unable to comprehend the sword intent of inexplicable sorrow. Ding Ling, however, realized all the mysterious sword intents to great perfection in an instant. His swordsmanship talent is miles ahead of Jian Chen!"
"We are far inferior indeed! He is too strong."

Initially perplexed, Little Zhao, upon understanding, was deeply moved. She had already decided to dedicate the rest of her life to Ding Ling, and now hearing others praise Ding Ling in such a manner filled her heart with pride and fervor. She couldn’t help but wonder silently:
’En Gong’s talent is so formidable, his future is boundless. How can I help him without holding him back?’
Not speaking of Little Zhao’s complex state of mind.
But speaking of Wuming.
Witnessing Ding Ling learn his Mysterious Swordsmanship instantly and then condense a complex yet perfect mysterious sword intent elevated Wuming’s admiration for Ding Ling to a peak realm.
He continuously praised him, unreservedly expressing his appreciation for Ding Ling, and said:
"Originally, I thought my talent in the way of the sword was unmatched. After meeting you, Ding Ling, I now understand what it means to be unparalleled and unrivaled!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"The Mysterious Swordsmanship is indeed a rare sword technique. Are there any stronger moves?"
"Of course, there are."
Wuming solemnly said:

"I have created a Supreme Sword Dao. This Sword Dao is not a type of swordsmanship, but a supreme realm of controlling the sword with the heart. It has four forms, divided into Invisible Dao, Heartless Dao, Nameless Dao, and No-Self Dao."
Wuming said this, looked at Ding Ling, and said:

"The mantra of this Supreme Sword Dao is extremely profound and difficult to comprehend. Even I cannot fully express its true intent and essence. Therefore, up until now, aside from myself, my servants and disciples have been unable to learn it."
He sighed deeply:

’It’s not that I don’t teach them, but I don’t know how to teach them! This Supreme Sword Dao can only be understood intuitively and is hard to convey. Except for these sparse few dozens of mantras, I have no other way. Listen carefully, the mantra of this Supreme Sword Dao is...’
Ding Ling listened attentively.
After one iteration.
Wuming looked intensely at Ding Ling:
’How is it?’

If someone like Ding Ling, a peerless sword genius who mastered the Mysterious Swordsmanship to great perfection after one look, could not comprehend the essence and true intent of this mantra, then Wuming would have no choice but to lament that his Supreme Sword Dao had no successors.
Ding Ling did not answer.
He merely ran it through his mind once.
In that instant.
[Supreme Sword Dao Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Physique +0.5]
This clearly was a technique surpassing the initial tier of shattering.
It was a pure Sword Dao!
Controlling the sword with the heart, wielding the sword with intent, wherever the heart went, sword intent burst forth, condensed into one, and struck at the enemy.
With thunderous roars!
As the wind and clouds changed, heaven and earth altered.
With the full level of Supreme Sword Dao.
Streams of sword intents frantically surged from Ding Ling’s body.
There was the mysterious sword intent of the Mysterious Swordsmanship;
The celestial destiny sword intent of the Celestial Destiny Sword Dao;
The sun-eroding sword intent of the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship;
The hero king sword intent of the Hero King Swordsmanship;
The Dugu sword intent of the Dugu Nine Swords;
The six meridian sword intent of the Six Meridian Divine Sword;
The various advanced and top-level sword intents Ding Ling learned from several worlds at this moment all merged into one with the full level of Supreme Sword Dao.
Transforming into a supreme sword intent!
This sword intent was all-encompassing and omnipresent!
It possessed the ability of all sword intents!
Mysterious, sun-eroding, shattering, penetrating, celestial destiny...
These sword intents all became the fodder of this supreme sword intent!
Accomplishing Ding Ling’s true Sword Dao!
This was similar to Wuming’s, yet distinct from Wuming’s Supreme Sword Dao!

sentences.text: "Exchange cultivation techniques?"
Wuming was taken aback.
"What’s wrong?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Wuming, you are a martial arts myth.
A person of righteous spirit and noble character, indifferent to fame and fortune, with a heart for the world.
You, such a person, are a grandmaster admired by thousands.
Could it be that you hold to sectarian prejudices?"
"This..."
Wuming was speechless:
"I’m not as perfect as you say."
"Regardless of the truth.
Wuming, you must have learned the truth of this world from various channels.
Do you think, if no one stands out, by relying on yourself alone, you can withstand the impending disasters?"
Wuming’s expression tightened, and he solemnly said:
"What you say makes a lot of sense.
What do you mean?"
"Exchanging martial arts.
It can strengthen us both.
As we become stronger, we will naturally be more capable of dealing with the forthcoming disasters."
"Alright."
Wuming hesitated for only a moment, then said:
"Many of my martial arts are self-realized and self-created.
Teaching them to you shouldn’t be much of a problem.
I only hope that you genuinely strive for the people of this world and the empire of Jiuzhou, and do your best."
"Since I have unified Jiuzhou and become the emperor of this region, it stands to reason that I would not neglect matters.
Haven’t you heard enough about my deeds, Wuming?"
Ding Ling countered.
Wuming nodded and said:
"I have indeed heard a lot about your affairs.
I also have some understanding of you.
Now, meeting face to face with you, your demeanor and martial arts move me deeply.
At your age, to possess such cultivation and bearing is truly remarkable."
He paused and said:
"I see you are a decisive person.
In that case, let us find a place to exchange cultivation techniques."
"Alright."
Wuming and Ding Ling came to a courtyard in the eastern part of the Imperial City.
This place must have been a martial arts hall before.
The Martial Arts Arena was quite large.
Wuming and Ding Ling stood in the center of the Martial Arts Arena.
Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, Phoenix Dance, and Little Zhao watched from not far away.
The God of Capture was still busy handling various errands in the Imperial City.
"I have a set of Mysterious Swordsmanship, let me demonstrate it for you first."
Wuming was a magnanimous person, possessing the grace of a grandmaster.
Having made his decision, he did not hold back and immediately began to demonstrate his Mysterious Swordsmanship to Ding Ling.
He explained the mantra while elucidating the essence and esoteric truth of the sword technique.
Simple in explanation, yet it went straight to the heart.
Ding Ling watched and listened carefully.
After one demonstration.
Wuming sheathed his sword and asked if Ding Ling had memorized it.
Ding Ling nodded and quickly ran it through his mind.
The next moment.
[Mysterious Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Physique +0.2]
This swordsmanship was of grandmaster peak-level, its greatest power residing in its mysterious sword intent.
The stronger the sword intent.
The greater the power this swordsmanship could unleash.
This was a sword that could directly shatter one’s heart!
Boom!
Upon reaching full level, streams of mysterious sword intent surged wildly from Ding Ling’s body.
This sword intent was perfect and flawless, containing various mysterious powers, such as inexplicable sorrow, reaching a state of perfect satisfaction.
Wuming was dumbfounded.
Wuming’s three servants, Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, and Phoenix Dance, were also shocked and incredulous:
"This sword intent!
Unbelievable!
Jian Chen was already considered a genius in the way of the sword, yet he was unable to comprehend the sword intent of inexplicable sorrow.
Ding Ling, however, realized all the mysterious sword intents to great perfection in an instant.
His swordsmanship talent is miles ahead of Jian Chen!"
"We are far inferior indeed!
He is too strong."
Initially perplexed, Little Zhao, upon understanding, was deeply moved.
She had already decided to dedicate the rest of her life to Ding Ling, and now hearing others praise Ding Ling in such a manner filled her heart with pride and fervor.
She couldn’t help but wonder silently:
’En Gong’s talent is so formidable, his future is boundless.
How can I help him without holding him back?’
Not speaking of Little Zhao’s complex state of mind.
But speaking of Wuming.
Witnessing Ding Ling learn his Mysterious Swordsmanship instantly and then condense a complex yet perfect mysterious sword intent elevated Wuming’s admiration for Ding Ling to a peak realm.
He continuously praised him, unreservedly expressing his appreciation for Ding Ling, and said:
"Originally, I thought my talent in the way of the sword was unmatched.
After meeting you, Ding Ling, I now understand what it means to be unparalleled and unrivaled!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"The Mysterious Swordsmanship is indeed a rare sword technique.
Are there any stronger moves?"
"Of course, there are."
Wuming solemnly said:
"I have created a Supreme Sword Dao.
This Sword Dao is not a type of swordsmanship, but a supreme realm of controlling the sword with the heart.
It has four forms, divided into Invisible Dao, Heartless Dao, Nameless Dao, and No-Self Dao."
Wuming said this, looked at Ding Ling, and said:
"The mantra of this Supreme Sword Dao is extremely profound and difficult to comprehend.
Even I cannot fully express its true intent and essence.
Therefore, up until now, aside from myself, my servants and disciples have been unable to learn it."
He sighed deeply:
’It’s not that I don’t teach them, but I don’t know how to teach them!
This Supreme Sword Dao can only be understood intuitively and is hard to convey.
Except for these sparse few dozens of mantras, I have no other way.
Listen carefully, the mantra of this Supreme Sword Dao is...’
Ding Ling listened attentively.
After one iteration.
Wuming looked intensely at Ding Ling:
’How is it?’

If someone like Ding Ling, a peerless sword genius who mastered the Mysterious Swordsmanship to great perfection after one look, could not comprehend the essence and true intent of this mantra, then Wuming would have no choice but to lament that his Supreme Sword Dao had no successors.
Ding Ling did not answer.
He merely ran it through his mind once.
In that instant.
[Supreme Sword Dao Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Physique +0.5]
This clearly was a technique surpassing the initial tier of shattering.
It was a pure Sword Dao!
Controlling the sword with the heart, wielding the sword with intent, wherever the heart went, sword intent burst forth, condensed into one, and struck at the enemy.
With thunderous roars!
As the wind and clouds changed, heaven and earth altered.
With the full level of Supreme Sword Dao.
Streams of sword intents frantically surged from Ding Ling’s body.
There was the mysterious sword intent of the Mysterious Swordsmanship;
The celestial destiny sword intent of the Celestial Destiny Sword Dao;
The sun-eroding sword intent of the Sun-Eroding Swordsmanship;
The hero king sword intent of the Hero King Swordsmanship;
The Dugu sword intent of the Dugu Nine Swords;
The six meridian sword intent of the Six Meridian Divine Sword;
The various advanced and top-level sword intents Ding Ling learned from several worlds at this moment all merged into one with the full level of Supreme Sword Dao.
Transforming into a supreme sword intent!
This sword intent was all-encompassing and omnipresent!
It possessed the ability of all sword intents!
Mysterious, sun-eroding, shattering, penetrating, celestial destiny...
These sword intents all became the fodder of this supreme sword intent!
Accomplishing Ding Ling’s true Sword Dao!
This was similar to Wuming’s, yet distinct from Wuming’s Supreme Sword Dao!

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 631: Supreme Sword Dao
paragraphs: A supreme Sword Dao that blends countless Sword Intents!
At the moment of its emergence, the universe trembles, and the winds and clouds shift unpredictably.
Boom!
An invisible giant sword bursts forth from Ding Ling’s body, shooting straight towards the sky!

Everyone present, without exception, felt a powerful and sharp Sword Intent crushing down towards them like a massive mountain, as if trying to shatter them! And like a terrifying tidal wave, it surged to engulf them, threatening to bury them deep in the sea.
They felt suffocated!
Their faces reddened with pressure.
Fortunately, the Supreme Sword Intent from Ding Ling came quickly and went equally swiftly.
It was a mere instant.
Then Ding Ling restrained it back within his body.
The world, this piece of heaven and earth, calmed down accordingly.
However, everyone present, including Wuming, had expressions of bewilderment and shock.

Especially Ghost Tiger’s three servants and Little Zhao, as their strength was relatively low and they were not very far away, facing that vast Supreme Sword Intent directly, almost felt like they were falling into a deep abyss, even though it was merely an instant, it seemed like agony lasting hundreds of years, that feeling was too unbearable.
When Ding Ling restrained the Supreme Sword Intent in an instant.
Only then did they realize, unknowingly, that they had lost control and broke into cold sweat!
"This Sword Intent?!"
Ghost Tiger stared in disbelief.
"How did he achieve this?!"
Phoenix Dance and Dragon King were stunned:

"Dozens of words from the Supreme Sword Dao Mantra, all it has been is a haze until now, utterly incomprehensible. Ding Ling actually realized this unparalleled Supreme Sword Intent from them?! This is too terrifying!"
Little Zhao’s heart thumped wildly as she listened, filled with pride and glory, for this is the person she decided to follow and dedicate her life to!

But thinking about Ding Ling’s accomplishments worried her, feeling that the gap between herself and Ding Ling was too great, and the probability of dragging him down in the future is too significant.
[Acquired D-level Achievement Medal: You won Wuming’s high praise.]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You earned Ghost Tiger’s profound admiration.]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You earned Dragon King’s profound admiration.]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You earned Phoenix Dance’s profound admiration.]
[Note: Your Sword Dao talent has thoroughly convinced them all! It made them recognize and praise you from the bottom of their hearts!]
Ding Ling heard the notification sound. He snapped back to reality.
He hadn’t realized that the Supreme Sword Dao was so powerful! No wonder Wuming, who cultivated the Supreme Sword Dao, is so terrifying; he can dominate the world even with residual blood!
The fact is that the Supreme Sword Dao differs from other sword techniques.
It’s a technique for using Sword Intent!
As long as the Sword Intent isn’t stronger than Wuming’s, it can be suppressed by him!
Wuming’s Sword Intent has already reached the Celestial Sword Level of Man and Sword Unity!
After Ding Ling reached full level in the Supreme Sword Dao, he naturally perceived this when he was near Wuming.
Before, he couldn’t sense it.
That was naturally because his Sword Dao Realm was far inferior to Wuming!
His Sword Intent is vast and powerful, quantitatively surpassing Wuming significantly!
But in terms of quality, he was losing to Wuming’s Celestial Sword Intent!
Until he learned Wuming’s Supreme Sword Dao.
He similarly obtained this Supreme Sword Intent.
Then, in an instant, he condensed all the Sword Intents he had learned into one, forming his unique ’Celestial Sword’!
His Celestial Sword differs from Wuming’s.

Wuming’s Celestial Sword is supreme, embodying achievement, embracing all things in heaven and earth, only activated in a state of calm, magnanimity, with emotions as serene as water, then Wuming’s Celestial Sword crushes everything.
Conversely, if his state of mind is broken.
His Celestial Sword can still be wielded, but its power will be greatly diminished because, at that point, his Celestial Sword is no longer supreme and embracing!
Yet Ding Ling’s Celestial Sword is different.
His Celestial Sword is a sword of myriad techniques! It’s a domineering, sharp, omnipotent sword!
As such.
The mindset for using his Celestial Sword is domineering, fiery, but it can also be embracing and generous.
With fewer usage limitations, it is more forceful and powerful than Wuming’s Celestial Sword.
Wuming evidently perceived this, causing him to be stunned, astonished, and shaken, for a good while, before coming back to his senses, inhaling deeply, and saying:
"It’s incredible. I never expected that the Supreme Sword Dao would truly be mastered by you!"
His strongest state is the Celestial Sword State.
In this state.
He can ignore the opponent’s strong defense, control the sword with his mind, instantly breaking the opponent’s mental defenses!
And now Ding Ling’s Celestial Sword State is even more perfect than his.
"The student surpasses the master! Ding Ling, from this day forward, you are the new milestone on the path of Sword Dao! Future generations will look up to you and your monumental Sword Dao!"
Wuming praised Ding Ling highly:

"I expected you to have some insights, yet I never thought you’d master the Supreme Sword Dao all at once. I myself don’t know how I mastered it, let alone teach a disciple. One can only say, Ding Ling, this is your auspicious fate."
"I must thank you for passing on the technique."
Ding Ling solemnly bowed to Wuming.
Wuming dared not accept, and quickly returned the courtesy.
He dares to accept from others.
Ding Ling’s talent and aptitude are exceedingly extraordinary that Wuming felt his Martial Arts Myth title should rightfully be transferred to Ding Ling; how could he dare accept Ding Ling’s礼?
Thereafter.
Wuming also imparted other Martial Arts and his own Inner Power Heart Method to Ding Ling.
This Inner Power Heart Method was also of the Grandmaster Peak Level.
Upon reaching full level.
A rush of Spiritual Vitality surged in, and Ding Ling operated the Profound Skill to refine it.
[Inner Power Value +100]
As another strand of Longevity True Qi formed in the Dantian.
Consolidating with the two earlier strands into one.
Accomplishing a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 59 points]
Strength increased again.
Ding Ling felt a renewed sense of power.

Wuming was speechless. He initially believed Ding Ling only excelled in Sword Dao talent extraordinarily, not thinking Inner Power talent was equally gifted. Truly a prodigious genius, an unrivaled aberrant!
Ding Ling subsequently also imparted Black Tortoise True Skill and Ten Strong Martial Dao to Wuming.
Wuming’s Inner Power Heart Method compared to Black Tortoise True Skill wasn’t very strong.
Having learned the Black Tortoise True Skill.
It’s believed his future will be surely more brilliant.
Regarding Wuming’s character, Ding Ling held great admiration, being sincere, kind-hearted, sharing Martial Arts exchange without reservation.
Such a person naturally made Ding Ling wish for his longevity since with him around, Jiuzhou could remain stable for Ding Ling in the future, preventing turmoil.
Were he to ascend and leave this world, having Wuming guarding the realm, minor villains wouldn’t dare act recklessly.
Additionally.
Black Tortoise True Skill and Ten Strong Martial Dao weren’t exclusively Ding Ling’s.
According to the comic, Wu Wudi didn’t die, and later many others inherited the Black Tortoise True Skill.
Being so.
Passing it to Wuming was naturally appropriate.
After all, Fengyun and others were also adept.
As well as Wu Wudi and others.
Allowing Wuming to learn it facilitates, should Ding Ling’s relatives ascend to this world, Wuming to impart the Black Tortoise True Skill to them and support them.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 632: Three Kingdoms: Guan Yu
paragraphs: "This martial art?!"
Wuming was moved and turned his head:
"Wu Wudi’s Ten Strong Martial Dao?!"
"That’s right."
"You’re so young, yet your boldness is quite extraordinary."
Wuming grew even more amazed:
"If it were me at your age, I might not have been able to accomplish such feats."
Thereafter.
At Wuming’s gesture.
Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, and Phoenix Dance also successively presented their martial arts.
And in the time that followed, they would be taught one of the Ten Strong Martial Dao by Wuming!

The Ten Strong Martial Dao is profoundly mysterious. For ordinary people, learning just one could be enough for a lifetime, while trying to forcibly learn all ten without sufficient talent could lead to mediocrity.

It’s like the common saying that learning many things is not as good as specializing in one! Specializing in one can make one a master, while learning many leaves one as a jack of all trades, unable to bring significant benefits.
After Ding Ling learned the body techniques, techniques, and inner power of Ghost Tiger and the others.
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.6]
Their inner power heart methods are indeed extraordinary and can be cultivated to the grandmaster level.
The cultivation techniques and moves are also extremely remarkable.
Each of them possesses a body technique and a martial arts.
Each of the three top-tier body techniques and three top-tier martial arts gives an average of +0.1 each.
As for other ordinary first-class martial arts, they also possess them.
After Ding Ling mastered them at full level, it didn’t increase his attribute points.
Nevertheless, it was quite good for enhancing his foundation, and Ding Ling did not disdain them, learning them all.
Ghost Tiger and the others were stunned.
The martial arts they couldn’t achieve great perfection in after decades were mastered in an instant by Ding Ling!
Thinking that Ding Ling could even achieve great perfection of the Supreme Sword Dao in an instant, they were resigned. He’s a prodigy, a freak that defies common sense!
[True Power Value: 60 points]
Ding Ling’s true qi rose again.
The Realm of Shattering was just within reach!
He felt that his power would increase in the coming days.
As long as he obtained enough great medicine, or absorbed the inner power of a top master, he could break into the Realm of Shattering.
Reaching this level.
With a thirtyfold boost!
Even those like Emperor Shitian.
Would be no match in his hands!
Then he could directly attack the Celestial Sect, eradicate it, and absorb the martial arts secret manuals of over a thousand years from the Celestial Sect for his own use.
Ding Ling’s martial arts cultivation would surely experience a surge.
The furnace body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace may even advance to 100%.
With this thought.
Ding Ling expressed his farewell to Wuming and the others.
Wuming did not persuade him to stay, as Ding Ling is about to become the Jiuzhou Emperor and has much to accomplish.

But Wuming still suggested that if Ding Ling were to become emperor, it would be best to establish the capital in places like Luoyang or Chang’an, rather than at the World Association or Unrivaled City.
Ding Ling heeded Wuming’s advice and asked him to guard the Imperial City.
As they spoke.
Ding Ling turned to leave.
At that moment.
He suddenly sensed an astonishing sword qi from the eastern direction.
This sword qi was vast and mighty, boundless and endless, and from a great distance, Ding Ling could see a dazzling and astonishing sword light!
The sword light slashed down.
As if it could disperse the firmament.
"What is that?!"
Wuming was moved.
Ding Ling’s heart was stirred, and he performed the Free-Will Ascension Step, shrinking the ground by a hundred feet, and was about to swiftly speed away when Little Zhao hastily called out:
"Young Master, wait for me!"

Ding Ling grabbed Little Zhao in mid-air, pulling her along, activating the Breathing Technique, Vigorous Qi, and Divine Form Power, with a twentyfold boost of Free-Will Ascension Step, swiftly disappearing into thin air like a bolt of lightning, vanishing without a trace.
"So fast."

Wuming activated the Celestial Sword State, transforming into a stream of light to follow, but no matter what, he couldn’t catch up to Ding Ling, and was secretly shaken, only able to increase his speed to chase.
Ghost Tiger and the others exerted themselves to pursue, but the distance between them and Ding Ling and Wuming grew wider.

When Ding Ling arrived at the scene, he saw a man nine feet tall, with a beard two feet long, a face like a red date, lips as if painted with rouge, eyes like phoenixes, with bushy eyebrows, dignified in appearance, standing at the entrance of a long ’abyss.’
"Guan Yu?"
Ding Ling instantly recognized him.
The man, upon seeing Ding Ling, his eyes brightened, exhaled a long breath, called out ’Prince,’ and fell to his knees with a thud, evidently exhausted and unable to hold on any longer.
Had Ding Ling not come, he might have kept his facade up, but now that he was here, he couldn’t keep up the pretense any longer.
"Haha...it turns out he was at the end of his strength! Go, kill him!"
From the dense forest all around suddenly emerged over a hundred figures.
Most of these figures wore ghost masks and black clothes, resembling Ghost Forks.
Seeing Guan Yu collapse like a mountain toppling, they were overjoyed, collectively letting out a long howl, charging towards Guan Yu.
Some drew their bows and aimed arrows at Guan Yu; others wielded blades ready to charge at his vital points.
Guan Yu’s face changed dramatically as he involuntarily looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling let out a cold snort.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Invisible Dao!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Invisible sword qi immediately manifested in the void, shooting towards the Ghost Forks with a whoosh of wind.
The invisible sword qi was formless, intangible, and fast as lightning!
Under Ding Ling’s mental control, it swiftly circled in all directions.
In the next instant!
The Ghost Forks in all directions fell dead on the ground!
In that brief moment, these over a hundred powerful Ghost Forks had their hearts pierced by the invisible sword qi, meeting a violent end!
"This?!"
Guan Yu was moved.

The leader of the Ghost Forks, a rather handsome young man, was shaken to his core and turned to run, only to be struck down by a casual invisible sword qi from Ding Ling, laying helplessly on the ground.
Ding Ling did not kill him.
He wanted to find out for what purpose these Ghost Forks had come to the Central Plains.
He had noticed that their lightweight body techniques and martial arts techniques were unlike those from the Central Plains, but rather appeared to be from Japan.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling grasped the corpses of the Ghost Forks mid-air, operating the Eternal Youth Technique, Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +13]
[Inner Power Value +9]
Most of these Ghost Forks were peak-level second-class masters. A few were first-class high-tier figures!
Due to their rapid deaths, their inner power loss wasn’t significant.
But the cultivation techniques they practiced were too inferior.
The conversion efficiency was quite low.
The majority had about ninety-six to ninety-seven percent impurities in their inner power after being refined!
Even so,
their numbers were considerable.
After absorbing about 30 of them.
Three strands of Longevity True Qi formed once again in Ding Ling’s dantian.
When combined into one.
They coagulated into a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 61 points.]
Reaching 61 points,
Ding Ling felt he had broken through an invisible martial dao barrier!
The many fine meridians in his body suddenly opened as true qi rapidly circulated at that moment.

sentences.text: "This martial art?!"
Wuming was moved and turned his head:
"Wu Wudi’s Ten Strong Martial Dao?!"
"That’s right."
"You’re so young, yet your boldness is quite extraordinary."
Wuming grew even more amazed:
"If it were me at your age, I might not have been able to accomplish such feats."
Thereafter.
At Wuming’s gesture.
Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, and Phoenix Dance also successively presented their martial arts.
And in the time that followed, they would be taught one of the Ten Strong Martial Dao by Wuming!
The Ten Strong Martial Dao is profoundly mysterious.
For ordinary people, learning just one could be enough for a lifetime, while trying to forcibly learn all ten without sufficient talent could lead to mediocrity.
It’s like the common saying that learning many things is not as good as specializing in one!
Specializing in one can make one a master, while learning many leaves one as a jack of all trades, unable to bring significant benefits.
After Ding Ling learned the body techniques, techniques, and inner power of Ghost Tiger and the others.
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.6]
Their inner power heart methods are indeed extraordinary and can be cultivated to the grandmaster level.
The cultivation techniques and moves are also extremely remarkable.
Each of them possesses a body technique and a martial arts.
Each of the three top-tier body techniques and three top-tier martial arts gives an average of +0.1 each.
As for other ordinary first-class martial arts, they also possess them.
After Ding Ling mastered them at full level, it didn’t increase his attribute points.
Nevertheless, it was quite good for enhancing his foundation, and Ding Ling did not disdain them, learning them all.
Ghost Tiger and the others were stunned.
The martial arts they couldn’t achieve great perfection in after decades were mastered in an instant by Ding Ling!
Thinking that Ding Ling could even achieve great perfection of the Supreme Sword Dao in an instant, they were resigned.
He’s a prodigy, a freak that defies common sense!
[True Power Value: 60 points]
Ding Ling’s true qi rose again.
The Realm of Shattering was just within reach!
He felt that his power would increase in the coming days.
As long as he obtained enough great medicine, or absorbed the inner power of a top master, he could break into the Realm of Shattering.
Reaching this level.
With a thirtyfold boost!
Even those like Emperor Shitian.
Would be no match in his hands!
Then he could directly attack the Celestial Sect, eradicate it, and absorb the martial arts secret manuals of over a thousand years from the Celestial Sect for his own use.
Ding Ling’s martial arts cultivation would surely experience a surge.
The furnace body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace may even advance to 100%.
With this thought.
Ding Ling expressed his farewell to Wuming and the others.
Wuming did not persuade him to stay, as Ding Ling is about to become the Jiuzhou Emperor and has much to accomplish.

But Wuming still suggested that if Ding Ling were to become emperor, it would be best to establish the capital in places like Luoyang or Chang’an, rather than at the World Association or Unrivaled City.
Ding Ling heeded Wuming’s advice and asked him to guard the Imperial City.
As they spoke.
Ding Ling turned to leave.
At that moment.
He suddenly sensed an astonishing sword qi from the eastern direction.
This sword qi was vast and mighty, boundless and endless, and from a great distance, Ding Ling could see a dazzling and astonishing sword light!
The sword light slashed down.
As if it could disperse the firmament.
"What is that?!"
Wuming was moved.
Ding Ling’s heart was stirred, and he performed the Free-Will Ascension Step, shrinking the ground by a hundred feet, and was about to swiftly speed away when Little Zhao hastily called out:
"Young Master, wait for me!"

Ding Ling grabbed Little Zhao in mid-air, pulling her along, activating the Breathing Technique, Vigorous Qi, and Divine Form Power, with a twentyfold boost of Free-Will Ascension Step, swiftly disappearing into thin air like a bolt of lightning, vanishing without a trace.
"So fast."

Wuming activated the Celestial Sword State, transforming into a stream of light to follow, but no matter what, he couldn’t catch up to Ding Ling, and was secretly shaken, only able to increase his speed to chase.
Ghost Tiger and the others exerted themselves to pursue, but the distance between them and Ding Ling and Wuming grew wider.

When Ding Ling arrived at the scene, he saw a man nine feet tall, with a beard two feet long, a face like a red date, lips as if painted with rouge, eyes like phoenixes, with bushy eyebrows, dignified in appearance, standing at the entrance of a long ’abyss.’
"Guan Yu?"
Ding Ling instantly recognized him.
The man, upon seeing Ding Ling, his eyes brightened, exhaled a long breath, called out ’Prince,’ and fell to his knees with a thud, evidently exhausted and unable to hold on any longer.
Had Ding Ling not come, he might have kept his facade up, but now that he was here, he couldn’t keep up the pretense any longer.
"Haha...it turns out he was at the end of his strength!
Go, kill him!"
From the dense forest all around suddenly emerged over a hundred figures.
Most of these figures wore ghost masks and black clothes, resembling Ghost Forks.
Seeing Guan Yu collapse like a mountain toppling, they were overjoyed, collectively letting out a long howl, charging towards Guan Yu.
Some drew their bows and aimed arrows at Guan Yu; others wielded blades ready to charge at his vital points.
Guan Yu’s face changed dramatically as he involuntarily looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling let out a cold snort.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Invisible Dao!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Invisible sword qi immediately manifested in the void, shooting towards the Ghost Forks with a whoosh of wind.
The invisible sword qi was formless, intangible, and fast as lightning!
Under Ding Ling’s mental control, it swiftly circled in all directions.
In the next instant!
The Ghost Forks in all directions fell dead on the ground!
In that brief moment, these over a hundred powerful Ghost Forks had their hearts pierced by the invisible sword qi, meeting a violent end!
"This?!"
Guan Yu was moved.

The leader of the Ghost Forks, a rather handsome young man, was shaken to his core and turned to run, only to be struck down by a casual invisible sword qi from Ding Ling, laying helplessly on the ground.
Ding Ling did not kill him.
He wanted to find out for what purpose these Ghost Forks had come to the Central Plains.
He had noticed that their lightweight body techniques and martial arts techniques were unlike those from the Central Plains, but rather appeared to be from Japan.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling grasped the corpses of the Ghost Forks mid-air, operating the Eternal Youth Technique, Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!

Even so,
