chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 633: City-Overturning Love
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt that he had become much stronger now!
It was as if he had crossed a threshold and entered a new world!
The view before him was suddenly more open!
His horizons seemed to have expanded innumerably!
His strength surged to new heights, and his understanding and application of various martial arts techniques had deepened greatly. With a casual move, he could reach a miraculous level of precision!
He had truly become the legendary ’Martial Dao God’!
"This is the Shattered Realm!"
Ding Ling felt increasingly in harmony with this world. Originally, his Lightweight Skill was exceptional, covering a hundred zhang in an instant with ease.
Now, having stepped into the Realm of Shattering, moving several hundred zhang in an instant seemed as simple as having a meal or drinking water.
This was because reaching this state made every action seem to harmonize with a certain Dao, fitting perfectly with its movements.
What is this Dao?
Is it perhaps the Martial Dao of this world?
Ultimately, Ding Ling did not know.
However, he felt as though a great mountain that weighed upon him had been lifted at this moment, making him feel unprecedentedly relaxed, as if layers of shackles had been removed!

Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist, causing the very air to crackle under the pressure. If he continued to evolve like this, shattering the void and tearing apart the world might prove no challenge at all!
"So strong!"
Guan Yu’s pupils contracted as he thought:
"As expected of the Prince! Even learning ’City-Overturning Love’ seems far inferior to the Prince. I truly wonder how the Prince cultivates."
Thinking of Ding Ling’s unmatched prowess in the Three Kingdoms World.
Guan Yu felt at ease.
He realized he still couldn’t compare to Ding Ling!
The slight arrogance that had developed upon learning ’City-Overturning Love’ was suddenly tempered.
"Whoosh whoosh!"
Ding Ling continued to absorb the Ghost Forks one by one, utilizing the Eternal Youth Technique—Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +1]
What slightly disappointed Ding Ling was that as his power increased, the true water in his dantian seemed to evolve as well, becoming of an increasingly high quality!
Originally, absorbing these Ghost Forks could yield about 10 points, but now it generally only provides 1 point.
Their inner strength was too far removed from Ding Ling’s True Water Level!
The assistance they could provide Ding Ling naturally weakened significantly.
It was like becoming an immortal; the food of ordinary people offered lesser assistance, eventually nearing zero.
Ding Ling found himself in a similar situation; common First-class Techniques were ineffective.
The inner power of ordinary people was also nearing ineffectiveness!
Ultimately, there were 70 Ghost Forks.
[Inner Power Value +81]
Ding Ling then effortlessly fetched the leader of the Ghost Forks, looking at the handsome young man, he said:
"Who are you?"
"If I tell you, will you spare me?"
The handsome man looked at Ding Ling with a face full of terror.
"Are you sure you won’t speak?"
Ding Ling asked emotionlessly, and the handsome man couldn’t bear it anymore, immediately saying:
"My name is Jue Xin!"
"Jue Xin?"
Ding Ling remembered the name:
"A Japanese?"
"Yes."
Jue Xin added quickly:
"My father is Jue Wushen. The Palace Master of the Godless Palace! If you release me, my father will certainly be immensely grateful to you!"
"Ha."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, responding noncommittally:
"What is your purpose in invading the Central Plains?"
"They’ve been wantonly killing, slaughtering many of our Central Plains experts."
Jue Xin didn’t respond, but Guan Yu couldn’t help himself, interjecting:

"This time, after ascending to the Upper Realm, I witnessed their cooperation in killing many experts near Unrivaled City! If Zhang Wuji and others hadn’t happened to come at that time to deliver a message to Duann Lang, joining forces with the ascenders and Duann Lang, Jue Xin and his men might have succeeded."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s face remained largely impassive, but his eyes grew deep and cold as he looked at Jue Xin:
"So, the people of the World Association and the Imperial City were slaughtered by your hands?"
Upon these words.
Little Zhao stared unblinkingly at Jue Xin, her eyes filled with hatred. The death of her mother was an unending vendetta, one she could not let go unavenged.
"It wasn’t us."
Jue Xin immediately denied:

"Heaven and Earth as my witness. We also wanted to target the World Association, but compared to Japan, Unrivaled City was closer, and it lacked a top-tier expert like you to oversee it. Naturally, we chose to attack Unrivaled City first; how dare we target the World Association where Ding Ling resides?
Jue Xin cautiously glanced at Ding Ling, saying:
"If I’m not mistaken, Your Highness should be the master of the World Association, Hero Ding, right?"
"If it wasn’t your doing, then who was it?"
Ding Ling gave Jue Xin a deep look.
Jue Xin appeared utterly perplexed, repeatedly insisting that they absolutely wouldn’t commit such a heinous massacre of innocent civilians and the elderly.
Ding Ling paid Jue Xin no further mind, instead asking Guan Yu to recount what had occurred.
Guan Yu solemnly stated:

"Reporting to the Prince, I and my elder brother and third brother chose to ascend to the Upper Realm two years ago, but in the first world, we somehow became separated. My third brother and I were in..."
He briefly recounted his experiences.
Guan Yu and Zhang Fei had pooled all resources towards Liu Bei, who finally managed to attain the qualifications for ascension through a family heirloom, after considerable time.
The three brothers then ascended together.
At the first stop.
Guan Yu and Zhang Fei went to The Deer and the Cauldron, while Liu Bei went to Green Blood Sword.
Thereafter.
When the Celestial Ladder appeared, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei chose to ascend again to reunite with their elder brother Liu Bei, but they ended up separated once more.
Guan Yu first went to Dragon Gate Flying Armor, then Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber. Without finding Zhang Fei or Liu Bei, he continued to ascend, arriving in this Wind and Cloud World.
Upon entering this world.

Guan Yu had a mysterious sense guiding him. He found himself outside Unrivaled City’s Ming Family Ancient Tomb. In the depths of the tomb, before a ’Martial Saint’ human statue, he received an ’awareness infusion’ from the statue!
Directly obtaining the ’City-Overturning Love’ Unparalleled Divine Skill Secret Manual!
Such a method of imparting skills was a first for Guan Yu. To this day, he probably still doesn’t understand how he learned City-Overturning Love!
Because he didn’t know the mantra or method for practicing City-Overturning Love. Yet, somehow he just knew how to use it.
Hearing this, Ding Ling was left speechless.
He had also attempted to find the City-Overturning Love but to no avail.
Moreover, Nie Feng mentioned that City-Overturning Love required a pair of lovers using the Unrivaled Yin Sword and Unrivaled Yang Sword to unleash its true power.
But it now seemed.
There must be two versions of the City-Overturning Love.
One version was the true heritage of Martial Saint Guan Yu, consisting of sword techniques, a true City-Overturning Love!
The other was a weakened version, sword techniques meant for two people!
Clearly, Guan Yu had inherited ’Guan Yu’s’ legacy!

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 634: Jue Xin
paragraphs: Sounds quite convoluted.
But indeed, the "City-Overturning Love" of this world is the sword technique passed down by Martial Saint Guan Yu.
As for who passed down this weakened version.
Ding Ling is not sure.
Guan Yu continued narrating.
After receiving this ’unknowable’ and ’extremely enigmatic’ consciousness infusion.
His power increased dramatically!
In the realm of sword techniques, it seemed like ’pulling up seedlings to help them grow,’ yet also like a natural progression, reaching an incredible level!
His strength achieved a leap in growth!
Upon hearing this.
Not only were Jue Xin and Little Zhao terribly envious, even Ding Ling was somewhat moved by Guan Yu’s extraordinary fortune!
But it’s because Guan Yu is truly Guan Yu!
It makes sense that he would receive the favor of this Martial Saint inheritance.
Just as the story reached this point.
Wuming arrived.
First, he looked at Ding Ling with astonishment, then his gaze froze on Guan Yu, with a startled expression, he said with some uncertainty:
"Is this... Martial Saint Guan Yu?!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded.
Wuming was at a loss.
But thinking of the Celestial Ladder and Ascenders mentioned by the alien, he felt relieved. Despite this, facing the real Guan Yu, Wuming couldn’t help but take a couple more glances.
This is a living Martial Saint!
This world is not lacking in Guan Gong Temples! Wuming had also worshiped the Martial Saint. Seeing the real one now, how could he not be moved and look away?
"Continue."
Ding Ling signaled Guan Yu to keep talking.
Guan Yu glanced at Wuming with some discomfort, as if Wuming had seen a ghost. Fortunately, he had experienced many such scenes before, and he quickly recovered.
He cleared his throat and continued.
After receiving the inheritance, Guan Yu stayed in the Bright Moon Ancient Tomb for a few days to consolidate and comprehend the inheritance he received.
Until he could proficiently wield the ’City-Overturning Love’.
He then prepared to leave the ancient tomb to find Zhang Fei and Liu Bei, to see if these two brothers had ascended to this world.
Unexpectedly.
He happened to encounter Jue Xin and others leading thousands of Ghost Fork to assassinate the experts of Unrivaled City.

At that time, Zhang Wuji was also in Unrivaled City to deliver a letter, and seeing Zhang Wuji being besieged, Guan Yu, who had some connection with Zhang Wuji in the Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber World, decisively intervened to save him.
Although they ultimately defeated Jue Xin and his group together.
But Guan Yu thus incurred a significant enmity with them because he was too ruthless in killing.
So, after Guan Yu left Unrivaled City.
Jue Xin and his group resorted to various assassinations, stabbings, and poisonings against Guan Yu in secret.
Guan Yu was feeling quite overwhelmed.

If it weren’t for his significant increase in strength and his sword technique reaching an unprecedented frightening level, he definitely wouldn’t have been able to withstand Jue Xin’s ’tricks’ and ’conspiracies’.
By the time he reached this place.
Once again, Guan Yu unintentionally fell victim to a strange poison from Jue Xin, and, reaching his limit, Guan Yu unleashed the grand move of ’City-Overturning Love’!
With one swing of the sword!
Sword light erupted!
Illuminating hundreds of miles!
Wherever it passed, everything was crushed and destroyed!
After one move, all the Ghost Fork blocking the front were completely wiped out, killing no less than a thousand enemies, and more than a dozen large trees were shattered.
The ground was split open with a deep chasm.
After this move.
Guan Yu felt completely drained, but to deter the enemies from other directions, he had to forcibly maintain composure, standing upright with his sword.
Until Ding Ling’s arrival...
"... The situation roughly went like this."
"Mm."
Ding Ling nodded, stepped forward to examine Guan Yu, and said:
’The strange poison you suffered is not a major issue. Rest assured.’
Guan Yu let out a sigh of relief, saying:

"I only feel dizzy and like I’m on the brink of death, but since the Prince says so, there must be a way to save me. I’ve been saved twice by the Prince, and in the future, as long as it doesn’t violate principles, I, Guan, will spare no effort whenever the Prince needs assistance."
Jue Xin tried to kill him, saved once;
This time poisoned, will be saved again.
Guan Yu calculated very clearly.
And the reason he chose to rely closely on Ding Ling is that he realized that looking for his eldest brother alone is like finding a needle in a haystack, time-consuming and laborious.
Previously, he came to the Imperial City to see if the Emperor was competent enough to help find his eldest brother and third brother.
And why didn’t he associate with Unrivaled City?
Because he looked down on Duann Lang and others.
Coming to the Imperial City, he was thinking of cooperating with the Emperor.
But after seeing Ding Ling, he immediately overturned his previous thoughts and chose to join Ding Ling’s force.
In the Great Wei Kingdom, he is a general, and can be considered under Ding Ling’s command.
Now to join Ding Ling’s command again.
This is quite a normal thing.
"Mm."
Ding Ling nodded and looked at Jue Xin, saying:
"Don’t you know that Unrivaled City also belongs to me?"
"Your expression suggests you know, and yet you dared to challenge, who gave your Godless Palace the confidence?"
Ding Ling slightly activated the Supreme Sword Dao of ’Heartless Dao,’ a mighty sword intent transformed into a cold-hearted killing intent directly targeting Jue Xin’s Sea of Consciousness!
The Supreme Sword Dao of Heartless Dao turned out to be a ’Spiritual Killing Secret Technique’.
Similar to Emperor Shitian’s Godslaying Tribulation.
Godslaying Tribulation is ’an icy face entering the Sea of Consciousness’.
While Heartless Dao has sword intent transforming into killing intent directly piercing into a person’s spirit sea.
Godslaying Tribulation can precisely find a person’s Sea of Consciousness and destroy it;
Heartless Dao might not precisely locate, but can envelop a person’s shell with killing intent, thereby directly entering their spirit sea.
One is targeted attack;
One is extensive area attack.
Both have their merits.
But without exception, they can be called ’Divine Skills’ in the Martial Hero Plane!
Because martial artists generally lack secret skills to protect the Sea of Consciousness; facing this move, it’s like an unarmored child facing a sharp sword, they can only kneel!
This is why Wuming is invincible wherever he goes.
Fighting above one’s level.
This move can be described as a ’winning magical treasure’!

Even Shattering Level experts cannot withstand Ding Ling’s move, let alone Jue Xin, although he seems to have gained considerable fortune, advancing to the Innate Realm, but facing Ding Ling, it’s like a locust facing a boundless ocean, in just an instant, Jue Xin felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave, his whole body couldn’t help but tremble violently.
Never before had he so tangibly felt the fear of Death God’s presence:
"I, I don’t know, I’m just following orders."
"Following whose orders?"
"My father, Jue Wushen."
"Reveal your Martial Arts Heart Method."
Jue Xin came to his senses, unwilling to speak, Ding Ling used the Life and Death Talisman to torture him a few times, and he couldn’t endure, obediently speaking out.
He initially disclosed only the ordinary First-class Skill and Grandmaster Level Skill he cultivated.
Intimidated by Ding Ling, he also revealed the method of ’Indestructible Golden Body’.
As to how he acquired the Indestructible Golden Body?

sentences.text: Sounds quite convoluted.
But indeed, the "City-Overturning Love" of this world is the sword technique passed down by Martial Saint Guan Yu.
As for who passed down this weakened version.
Ding Ling is not sure.
Guan Yu continued narrating.
After receiving this ’unknowable’ and ’extremely enigmatic’ consciousness infusion.
His power increased dramatically!
In the realm of sword techniques, it seemed like ’pulling up seedlings to help them grow,’ yet also like a natural progression, reaching an incredible level!
His strength achieved a leap in growth!
Upon hearing this.
Not only were Jue Xin and Little Zhao terribly envious, even Ding Ling was somewhat moved by Guan Yu’s extraordinary fortune!
But it’s because Guan Yu is truly Guan Yu!
It makes sense that he would receive the favor of this Martial Saint inheritance.
Just as the story reached this point.
Wuming arrived.
First, he looked at Ding Ling with astonishment, then his gaze froze on Guan Yu, with a startled expression, he said with some uncertainty:
"Is this...
Martial Saint Guan Yu?!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded.
Wuming was at a loss.
But thinking of the Celestial Ladder and Ascenders mentioned by the alien, he felt relieved.
Despite this, facing the real Guan Yu, Wuming couldn’t help but take a couple more glances.
This is a living Martial Saint!
This world is not lacking in Guan Gong Temples!
Wuming had also worshiped the Martial Saint.
Seeing the real one now, how could he not be moved and look away?
"Continue."
Ding Ling signaled Guan Yu to keep talking.
Guan Yu glanced at Wuming with some discomfort, as if Wuming had seen a ghost.
Fortunately, he had experienced many such scenes before, and he quickly recovered.
He cleared his throat and continued.
After receiving the inheritance, Guan Yu stayed in the Bright Moon Ancient Tomb for a few days to consolidate and comprehend the inheritance he received.
Until he could proficiently wield the ’City-Overturning Love’.
He then prepared to leave the ancient tomb to find Zhang Fei and Liu Bei, to see if these two brothers had ascended to this world.
Unexpectedly.
He happened to encounter Jue Xin and others leading thousands of Ghost Fork to assassinate the experts of Unrivaled City.

At that time, Zhang Wuji was also in Unrivaled City to deliver a letter, and seeing Zhang Wuji being besieged, Guan Yu, who had some connection with Zhang Wuji in the Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber World, decisively intervened to save him.
Although they ultimately defeated Jue Xin and his group together.
But Guan Yu thus incurred a significant enmity with them because he was too ruthless in killing.
So, after Guan Yu left Unrivaled City.
Jue Xin and his group resorted to various assassinations, stabbings, and poisonings against Guan Yu in secret.
Guan Yu was feeling quite overwhelmed.

If it weren’t for his significant increase in strength and his sword technique reaching an unprecedented frightening level, he definitely wouldn’t have been able to withstand Jue Xin’s ’tricks’ and ’conspiracies’.
By the time he reached this place.
Once again, Guan Yu unintentionally fell victim to a strange poison from Jue Xin, and, reaching his limit, Guan Yu unleashed the grand move of ’City-Overturning Love’!
With one swing of the sword!
Sword light erupted!
Illuminating hundreds of miles!
Wherever it passed, everything was crushed and destroyed!
After one move, all the Ghost Fork blocking the front were completely wiped out, killing no less than a thousand enemies, and more than a dozen large trees were shattered.
The ground was split open with a deep chasm.
After this move.
Guan Yu felt completely drained, but to deter the enemies from other directions, he had to forcibly maintain composure, standing upright with his sword.
Until Ding Ling’s arrival...
The situation roughly went like this."
"Mm."
Ding Ling nodded, stepped forward to examine Guan Yu, and said:
’The strange poison you suffered is not a major issue.
Rest assured.’
Guan Yu let out a sigh of relief, saying:
"I only feel dizzy and like I’m on the brink of death, but since the Prince says so, there must be a way to save me.
I’ve been saved twice by the Prince, and in the future, as long as it doesn’t violate principles, I, Guan, will spare no effort whenever the Prince needs assistance."
Jue Xin tried to kill him, saved once;
This time poisoned, will be saved again.
Guan Yu calculated very clearly.
And the reason he chose to rely closely on Ding Ling is that he realized that looking for his eldest brother alone is like finding a needle in a haystack, time-consuming and laborious.
Previously, he came to the Imperial City to see if the Emperor was competent enough to help find his eldest brother and third brother.
And why didn’t he associate with Unrivaled City?
Because he looked down on Duann Lang and others.
Coming to the Imperial City, he was thinking of cooperating with the Emperor.
But after seeing Ding Ling, he immediately overturned his previous thoughts and chose to join Ding Ling’s force.
In the Great Wei Kingdom, he is a general, and can be considered under Ding Ling’s command.
Now to join Ding Ling’s command again.
This is quite a normal thing.
"Mm."
Ding Ling nodded and looked at Jue Xin, saying:
"Don’t you know that Unrivaled City also belongs to me?"
"Your expression suggests you know, and yet you dared to challenge, who gave your Godless Palace the confidence?"
Ding Ling slightly activated the Supreme Sword Dao of ’Heartless Dao,’ a mighty sword intent transformed into a cold-hearted killing intent directly targeting Jue Xin’s Sea of Consciousness!
The Supreme Sword Dao of Heartless Dao turned out to be a ’Spiritual Killing Secret Technique’.
Similar to Emperor Shitian’s Godslaying Tribulation.
Godslaying Tribulation is ’an icy face entering the Sea of Consciousness’.
While Heartless Dao has sword intent transforming into killing intent directly piercing into a person’s spirit sea.
Godslaying Tribulation can precisely find a person’s Sea of Consciousness and destroy it;
Heartless Dao might not precisely locate, but can envelop a person’s shell with killing intent, thereby directly entering their spirit sea.
One is targeted attack;
One is extensive area attack.
Both have their merits.
But without exception, they can be called ’Divine Skills’ in the Martial Hero Plane!
Because martial artists generally lack secret skills to protect the Sea of Consciousness; facing this move, it’s like an unarmored child facing a sharp sword, they can only kneel!
This is why Wuming is invincible wherever he goes.
Fighting above one’s level.
This move can be described as a ’winning magical treasure’!

Even Shattering Level experts cannot withstand Ding Ling’s move, let alone Jue Xin, although he seems to have gained considerable fortune, advancing to the Innate Realm, but facing Ding Ling, it’s like a locust facing a boundless ocean, in just an instant, Jue Xin felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave, his whole body couldn’t help but tremble violently.
Never before had he so tangibly felt the fear of Death God’s presence:
"I, I don’t know, I’m just following orders."
"Following whose orders?"
"My father, Jue Wushen."
"Reveal your Martial Arts Heart Method."
Jue Xin came to his senses, unwilling to speak, Ding Ling used the Life and Death Talisman to torture him a few times, and he couldn’t endure, obediently speaking out.
He initially disclosed only the ordinary First-class Skill and Grandmaster Level Skill he cultivated.
Intimidated by Ding Ling, he also revealed the method of ’Indestructible Golden Body’.
As to how he acquired the Indestructible Golden Body?

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 635: Indestructible Golden Body
paragraphs: Ding Ling didn’t ask.
What he wanted was the Martial Arts Heart Method; he wasn’t interested in this kind of thing.
But he could guess that Jue Xin must have used some underhanded tricks to obtain the Indestructible Golden Body.
This guy is as cunning as those Old Poison Masters!
Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was at full level, so he knew that Jue Xin appeared honest, extremely fearful, and cooperative.
Actually, he had no idea how many times Jue Xin wanted to kill him.
He didn’t expose Jue Xin, just listened to the Heart Technique of the Indestructible Golden Body.
He recalled slightly.
In an instant.
[Indestructible Golden Body Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.3]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is also a defensive technique that can be cultivated to Grandmaster level.
The defense is extremely strong.
Once at full level.
With a thought.
A Protective Gang Qi Shield can be formed, invulnerable, extremely impressive.
And since Ding Ling had already reached full level, this Indestructible Golden Body almost had no flaws.
While Jue Wushen had a flaw under his armpit, it showed that he certainly hadn’t cultivated this technique to true Great Perfection!

After Ding Ling emptied out all of Jue Xin’s martial arts and brought them to full level, Jue Xin was shocked, horrified, and dazed as Ding Ling grabbed him into the air and executed the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Hoo hoo!
Rolling True Qi entered his body.
With the operation of Profound Skill and Breathing Technique, it was thoroughly refined in just a moment.
[Inner Power Value +15]
A first-class expert among the Ghost Forks could only provide Ding Ling with 2 inner power value points.
Jue Xin was an Innate expert.
His power compared to the first-class expert was seven to eight times stronger.

But because the Cultivation Technique he practiced was far inferior to the Black Tortoise True Skill, coupled with Ding Ling’s True Water Level advancing to the Shattered Realm, evolving and elevating to a higher level.
Thus, although Jue Xin’s inner strength was rolling and extremely outstanding, it was a bit weak in providing aid to Ding Ling.
The meat of a mosquito’s leg is still meat.
Ding Ling did not disdain it.
After draining Jue Xin dry, ignoring his begging, he casually slapped him, bang!
Heart-Pushing Palm!
With one palm, Jue Xin’s heart was destroyed!
His life ceased, falling dead to the ground, dying with his eyes still open.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidation of Jue Xin.]
[Note: Only upon dying was he truly intimidated by you, and genuinely remorseful!]
Indeed.
Before his death, Jue Xin seemed very afraid of him, but only during periods like the Sword Intent Shield was he truly afraid, while other times he seemed to be pretending.

For such people, how could Ding Ling possibly keep them? He wouldn’t dare to use them, just like Chengkun; Ding Ling could never keep him around for employment, too insidious, impossible to guard against.
Although Ding Ling wasn’t afraid, if his friends and family suffered an ambush, wouldn’t it be a disaster?
"I’m planning to visit Unrivaled City, and then go to the Sword Sect and Celestial Sect."
Ding Ling looked at Wuming and Guan Yu:
"What about you?"
Guan Yu said solemnly:
"Since I’ve decided to follow the Prince wherever he goes, I will follow."
Wuming was silent for a while, then said:
"I haven’t been to the Sword Sect in a long time. Are you going for the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root Secret Manual?"
"That’s right."

Ding Ling’s Geomancy Skill, Mechanical Skill, and Array Dao were all full level, so in his opinion, no matter how well the Sword Sect hid the Secret Manual, it must be hidden using an array formation, utilizing Mechanical Skill, etc.
And he had mastered all of these.

Though he understood better the Initial Tier and Middle Tier Array Dao, he had learned quite a bit about High Tier; therefore, he thought breaking the place where the Sword Sect hid the manual shouldn’t be difficult.
"But I only have half of the key."
Wuming hesitated:
"The other half is with my brother Pojun, but we’ve become enemies; it’s hard to make him give up the other half of the key."
"No worries. Having half might be enough."
Ding Ling explained casually.
Wuming admired the Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root Sword Technique manual, feeling passionate and decided to follow him to the Sword Sect.
As for Ghost Tiger, Phoenix, and Dragon King, who had just arrived, Wuming ordered them to guard the Imperial City with God of Capture.
The three servants agreed.
But upon seeing Guan Yu, they couldn’t help but be shocked!
Especially seeing Guan Yu, the living Martial Saint, being respectful to Ding Ling, they were dumbfounded, their jaws almost dropped to the ground.
Wuming likewise was extremely moved and watched closely.
A Martial Saint, yet he held Ding Ling, this young man, in such high regard and respect!
This Ding Ling is indeed extraordinary! Absolutely amazing!
On the way, Ding Ling relieved Guan Yu’s poison.
He had a friendly relationship with Zhang Wuji, learned Lightweight Skill from Zhang Wuji, and now his Lightweight Skill cultivation was quite splendid.
Especially after ’this world’s Martial Saint’ instilled a Consciousness Body into him.
His Sword Dao had reached a mysterious, extremely high realm.
In this state of realm enhancement, his speed was no less than Wuming.
Ding Ling secretly marveled at it.
This Consciousness Body infusion is comparable to a Xuanhuan world!
Thinking of the intense battles in the later stage of the Fengyun series.
Ding Ling was enlightened.
This Fengyun may seem like a High Martial World.
But later on, it really became like a Xuanhuan or Fantasy world.
And it’s not surprising at all.
This Fengyun world surely integrated the comic version world!
Thus explaining the astonishing scene Lü Bu witnessed!
The ’Martial Saint legacy’ Guan Yu received!
For the City-Overturning Love technique, Ding Ling’s understanding mostly came from comics, novels, etc.
Legend has it that once City-Overturning Love was unleashed, it could instantly create a black hole; its authenticity was unknown.
Yet judging from Guan Yu’s Sword Technique, his mastery of City-Overturning Love evidently reached an outrageously high realm.
He did not create a black hole and get himself sucked in.

In the Fengyun novel, it is introduced: towards the end of the Unrivaled City war, a fake Dugu Yifang took civilians and Nie Feng hostage, forcing ’Hua Meng’ to deliver the secret of City-Overturning Love. Hua Meng was the TV character equivalent of Mingyue.
To protect Nie Feng and the people, Hua Meng forcibly executed City-Overturning Love, obliterating seven thousand troops and tearing the sky, creating a void black hole that sucked Hua Meng in!
Of course.
This is the novel version.
Whereas in this world, there’s no Hua Meng, only Mingyue.
But since the legacy of the City-Overturning Love Sword Technique appeared, this Fengyun world naturally correlates with the novel.
It just proves.
His previous guesses were correct. This world assimilates elements of TV, novels, comics, movies. It’s a fusion version world.
"It’s a pity Sword Technique doesn’t have a Mantra Technique; otherwise, I could instantly reach full level."
Ding Ling was slightly regretful.
Yet he didn’t think too much.
There are many secret techniques in this world; although City-Overturning Love is extremely formidable, there are many other formidable Martial Arts Skills.
Twenty-Third Sword isn’t necessarily weaker than City-Overturning Love.
Moreover, City-Overturning Love is clearly an explosive Sword Technique.
After one slash, Guan Yu became worn out.
It can be used for enemy duels, but if attacked from all directions, this move might be beaten.
Previously, the Sword Technique could only target one direction, while Guan Yu neglected the enemies from other directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 636: Yitian Dragon Slayer: Zhang Wuji
paragraphs: Once Ding Ling arrived at Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, and others immediately came to greet and pay their respects.
Chengkun was nowhere to be seen among the crowd.
Asked around to find out.
During the previous chaotic battle, Japan deployed an extremely strong assassin who killed Chengkun in one strike!
Chengkun could be said to have died with regrets!
Enduring until now, he still ended up dying!
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised and asked:
"Where is that assassin?"
"Ran away."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling looked at Guan Yu.
Guan Yu immediately said:
"That assassin seems to be not in league with Jue Xin, yet also appears to be. I suspect the two have a cooperative relationship."
Ding Ling nodded, didn’t ask further, and instead inquired Duann Lang about the recent developments of Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang’s spirit lifted, and he began to speak enthusiastically.
It turns out that ever since Unrivaled City and the World Association jointly declared to honor Ding Ling as master, the nearby forces have been flocking to align with Unrivaled City.
Many Ascenders have also chosen to settle in Unrivaled City, study martial arts, and discuss doctrines.
Among them are Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min, Xie Xun, and others.
After Duann Lang’s introduction.
Ding Ling then saw Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min, and Xie Xun among the crowd.
Xie Xun indeed was a towering, magnificent man with a head full of blond hair, fierce and wild, though he was blind, it could not conceal his overwhelming ferocity and wildness;
Zhang Wuji was a tall and valiant man with a seemingly honest demeanor;
Whereas Zhao Min, dressed in men’s attire, still could not hide her outstanding beauty.

She greeted Ding Ling with a charming smile, as her beautiful eyes glanced, showcasing an unparalleled charm, and her male attire only added a touch of heroic air, making her stand shoulder to shoulder with Diao Chan.
Ding Ling glanced, slightly puzzled, momentarily thinking he saw Diao Chan.
But soon, he regained his clarity, gave Zhao Min a smile, and continued to walk forward.
"Hero Ding, wait."
Zhao Min called out.
"What is it?"
Ding Ling slightly turned his head to look at Zhao Min, raised his eyebrows, and said:
"Anything you need?"
"My husband and I wish to follow you. On behalf of my husband, I ask. When will Hero Ding unify Jiuzhou?"
"Soon."
"Once Jiuzhou is unified, my husband, my father-in-law, and I wish to closely follow Hero Ding, not knowing if Hero Ding would agree?"
Zhao Min spoke earnestly:

"We Ascended to this realm with the intention, aside from killing Chengkun, of finding a method for immortality. Now, having thought it over, it seems only by following Hero Ding that we have some hope of immortality. Therefore, my family is willing to genuinely serve Hero Ding, as honest ministers! We listen to Hero Ding’s arrangements for everything.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling looked Zhao Min deeply in the eyes, turned around, and walked away:
"At that time, there will be imperial exams. You can come to participate, pass them and we will talk further."
"Yes, Hero Ding."
Zhao Min shouted towards Ding Ling’s departing figure:
"Hero Ding, I believe my husband and I can surely stand by your side to follow you!"
Ding Ling did not respond.
Zhao Min pouted a little indignantly.
Zhang Wuji stepped forward to comfort her.
Xie Xun said apologetically:
"If it weren’t for my insistence to come to the Upper Realm to kill Chengkun, you might now be pair-binding joyfully in the Lower Realm. I’m the one who dragged you into this."
"Godfather."
Zhang Wuji earnestly said:
"Family does not speak separately. Your affair is my affair. How could I not care for you! Fortunately, Chengkun is finally dead, and you can lay down the hatred in your heart."
Zhang Wuji face blurred:
"This world is vast, familiar yet so strange, we can never return."
He looked at Zhao Min:
"Minmin, it’s me who burdened you."
"We are one as a couple, how could you say it’s a burden?"
Zhao Min took Zhang Wuji’s hand, publicly leaned her head on Zhang Wuji’s shoulder, with a sweet smile:
"Moreover, we’re not doing this just for a mere few decades; we’re aiming for hundreds, thousands of years together!"
Zhao Min and Zhang Wuji are already husband and wife.
As can be seen, in the chaotic interference by players, the story from the Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber World brought these two together by fate.
Although Ding Ling felt somewhat surprised, he did not delve deep into it.
Even he did not possess immortality, what was Zhao Min thinking by wanting immortality?!
Because of that.
He did not cater to Zhao Min.
More Ascenders kept emerging.
The local native talents were not lacking either, except for those particularly exceptional who earned his recognition, Ding Ling would not gather them around him as confidants.
That Zhao Min dared to speak so obviously among everyone showed her confidence in herself. Why was she so confident?
Ding Ling did not explore deeply either.
He had important matters to attend to.
Spent only half a day in Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang then delivered dozens to hundreds of buckets of Great Medicine he had specially collected.
Most of these Great Medicines were two to three hundred years old.
Totaled around eighteen hundred plants.
Ding Ling consumed 100 plants.
The deficiency sensation of his previously enhanced strength instantly vanished, not to mention.
[Defense +1.5]
Defense was improved once more.
[Defense: 120]
Previously, defense had grown somewhat, and this time, consuming medicine caused further growth.
Ding Ling’s Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill finally achieved Great Perfection.
The two Divine Forms completely refined to substantial status!
Attributes in all three aspects reached the limit required by Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
Thus, the Divine Forms were perfected; the scales on the Dragon Form glittered, akin to real dragon scales;
Thunder Elephant’s hide shone brightly, appearing real!
With defense reaching the threshold, these two Divine Forms transformed and sublimated once again!
Capable of easily extending beyond the body ten-odd feet, transforming into a Divine Dragon, a Thunder Elephant guarding Ding Ling.
Boom!

With Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill reaching Great Perfection, the two Divine Forms detached automatically, dragon roar, elephant trumpeting, Divine Dragon spiraling ten feet high in the sky, Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, roaring upward, akin to a real dragon descending!
Thunder Elephant lifted Ding Ling’s body.
Its size was like a small mountain.
Ding Ling stood on its back, appearing slender but towering like a deity!
Even the mighty Thunder Elephant was subjected under Ding Ling’s foot, what kind of Divine Being was that?
Thunder rolling!
Electric light surrounded Thunder Elephant, making a glowing radiance emerge around Ding Ling, emphasizing Ding Ling like a living deity or buddha, deterring direct sight.
"So strong!"
Shangguan Jinhong vibrated:
"What kind of martial arts is this?!"
He had an extremely strong premonition.
He possibly couldn’t even beat Ding Ling’s two ’mounts’!
"What’s that?!"
Further away, Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji, and others saw the Divine Dragon above the City Lord’s Mansion in Unrivaled City, and witnessed the scene of lightning storming the sky, shocked:
"Dragon?! Is that a Divine Dragon?"
"And that enormous elephant, what species is that? Hero Ding standing on the elephant, with the Divine Dragon guarding, is this a living sacred being?!"
Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min were dumbfounded!
In the Lower Realm, they all believed the Divine Dragon to be fictional.

sentences.text: Once Ding Ling arrived at Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, and others immediately came to greet and pay their respects.
Chengkun was nowhere to be seen among the crowd.
Asked around to find out.
During the previous chaotic battle, Japan deployed an extremely strong assassin who killed Chengkun in one strike!
Chengkun could be said to have died with regrets!
Enduring until now, he still ended up dying!
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised and asked:
"Where is that assassin?"
"Ran away."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling looked at Guan Yu.
Guan Yu immediately said:
"That assassin seems to be not in league with Jue Xin, yet also appears to be.
I suspect the two have a cooperative relationship."
Ding Ling nodded, didn’t ask further, and instead inquired Duann Lang about the recent developments of Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang’s spirit lifted, and he began to speak enthusiastically.
It turns out that ever since Unrivaled City and the World Association jointly declared to honor Ding Ling as master, the nearby forces have been flocking to align with Unrivaled City.
Many Ascenders have also chosen to settle in Unrivaled City, study martial arts, and discuss doctrines.
Among them are Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min, Xie Xun, and others.
After Duann Lang’s introduction.
Ding Ling then saw Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min, and Xie Xun among the crowd.
Xie Xun indeed was a towering, magnificent man with a head full of blond hair, fierce and wild, though he was blind, it could not conceal his overwhelming ferocity and wildness;
Zhang Wuji was a tall and valiant man with a seemingly honest demeanor;
Whereas Zhao Min, dressed in men’s attire, still could not hide her outstanding beauty.

She greeted Ding Ling with a charming smile, as her beautiful eyes glanced, showcasing an unparalleled charm, and her male attire only added a touch of heroic air, making her stand shoulder to shoulder with Diao Chan.
Ding Ling glanced, slightly puzzled, momentarily thinking he saw Diao Chan.
But soon, he regained his clarity, gave Zhao Min a smile, and continued to walk forward.
"Hero Ding, wait."
Zhao Min called out.
"What is it?"
Ding Ling slightly turned his head to look at Zhao Min, raised his eyebrows, and said:
"Anything you need?"
"My husband and I wish to follow you.
On behalf of my husband, I ask.
When will Hero Ding unify Jiuzhou?"
"Soon."
"Once Jiuzhou is unified, my husband, my father-in-law, and I wish to closely follow Hero Ding, not knowing if Hero Ding would agree?"
Zhao Min spoke earnestly:
"We Ascended to this realm with the intention, aside from killing Chengkun, of finding a method for immortality.
Now, having thought it over, it seems only by following Hero Ding that we have some hope of immortality.
Therefore, my family is willing to genuinely serve Hero Ding, as honest ministers!
We listen to Hero Ding’s arrangements for everything.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling looked Zhao Min deeply in the eyes, turned around, and walked away:
"At that time, there will be imperial exams.
You can come to participate, pass them and we will talk further."
"Yes, Hero Ding."
Zhao Min shouted towards Ding Ling’s departing figure:
"Hero Ding, I believe my husband and I can surely stand by your side to follow you!"
Ding Ling did not respond.
Zhao Min pouted a little indignantly.
Zhang Wuji stepped forward to comfort her.
Xie Xun said apologetically:
"If it weren’t for my insistence to come to the Upper Realm to kill Chengkun, you might now be pair-binding joyfully in the Lower Realm.
I’m the one who dragged you into this."
"Godfather."
Zhang Wuji earnestly said:
"Family does not speak separately.
Your affair is my affair.
How could I not care for you!
Fortunately, Chengkun is finally dead, and you can lay down the hatred in your heart."
Zhang Wuji face blurred:
"This world is vast, familiar yet so strange, we can never return."
He looked at Zhao Min:
"Minmin, it’s me who burdened you."
"We are one as a couple, how could you say it’s a burden?"
Zhao Min took Zhang Wuji’s hand, publicly leaned her head on Zhang Wuji’s shoulder, with a sweet smile:
"Moreover, we’re not doing this just for a mere few decades; we’re aiming for hundreds, thousands of years together!"
Zhao Min and Zhang Wuji are already husband and wife.
As can be seen, in the chaotic interference by players, the story from the Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber World brought these two together by fate.
Although Ding Ling felt somewhat surprised, he did not delve deep into it.
Even he did not possess immortality, what was Zhao Min thinking by wanting immortality?!
Because of that.
He did not cater to Zhao Min.
More Ascenders kept emerging.
The local native talents were not lacking either, except for those particularly exceptional who earned his recognition, Ding Ling would not gather them around him as confidants.
That Zhao Min dared to speak so obviously among everyone showed her confidence in herself.
Why was she so confident?
Ding Ling did not explore deeply either.
He had important matters to attend to.
Spent only half a day in Unrivaled City.
Duann Lang then delivered dozens to hundreds of buckets of Great Medicine he had specially collected.
Most of these Great Medicines were two to three hundred years old.
Totaled around eighteen hundred plants.
Ding Ling consumed 100 plants.
The deficiency sensation of his previously enhanced strength instantly vanished, not to mention.
[Defense +1.5]
Defense was improved once more.
[Defense: 120]
Previously, defense had grown somewhat, and this time, consuming medicine caused further growth.
Ding Ling’s Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill finally achieved Great Perfection.
The two Divine Forms completely refined to substantial status!
Attributes in all three aspects reached the limit required by Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
Thus, the Divine Forms were perfected; the scales on the Dragon Form glittered, akin to real dragon scales;
Thunder Elephant’s hide shone brightly, appearing real!
With defense reaching the threshold, these two Divine Forms transformed and sublimated once again!
Capable of easily extending beyond the body ten-odd feet, transforming into a Divine Dragon, a Thunder Elephant guarding Ding Ling.
Boom!

With Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill reaching Great Perfection, the two Divine Forms detached automatically, dragon roar, elephant trumpeting, Divine Dragon spiraling ten feet high in the sky, Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, roaring upward, akin to a real dragon descending!
Thunder Elephant lifted Ding Ling’s body.
Its size was like a small mountain.
Ding Ling stood on its back, appearing slender but towering like a deity!
Even the mighty Thunder Elephant was subjected under Ding Ling’s foot, what kind of Divine Being was that?
Thunder rolling!
Electric light surrounded Thunder Elephant, making a glowing radiance emerge around Ding Ling, emphasizing Ding Ling like a living deity or buddha, deterring direct sight.
"So strong!"
Shangguan Jinhong vibrated:
"What kind of martial arts is this?!"
He had an extremely strong premonition.
He possibly couldn’t even beat Ding Ling’s two ’mounts’!
"What’s that?!"
Further away, Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji, and others saw the Divine Dragon above the City Lord’s Mansion in Unrivaled City, and witnessed the scene of lightning storming the sky, shocked:
"Dragon?!
Is that a Divine Dragon?"
"And that enormous elephant, what species is that?
Hero Ding standing on the elephant, with the Divine Dragon guarding, is this a living sacred being?!"
Zhang Wuji, Zhao Min were dumbfounded!
In the Lower Realm, they all believed the Divine Dragon to be fictional.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 637: War God Spirit Body
paragraphs: Even after arriving in this world, many aliens made firm promises, but without witnessing it firsthand, Zhang Wuji and Zhao Min remained skeptical.
Until now.
They saw the Divine Dragon and Thunder Elephant guarding Ding Ling.
Their hearts trembled, and they were completely convinced that there were indeed Divine Dragons, indeed myths and immortality in this world!
"Everything the aliens said is true. Brother Wuji, we have hope for immortality now!"
Zhao Min’s heart was blazing hot!
There were indeed many who thought like Zhao Min.
Duann Lang and others watched with shining eyes, both reverent and fearful, and were the first to bow down:
"Congratulations to the Venerable Lord on the great success of his Divine Skill!"

Ding Ling opened his eyes, whoosh! Two divine forms turned into streams of light and fled into his body. Ding Ling felt the power of the tenfold amplification of the divine forms was more enduring and concentrated.
If previously the divine forms could amplify a battle for a day, now it could last for three days!
It directly tripled!
This is the effect brought by transformation and sublimation!
Not only that.
The strength of the two divine forms also rose, each possessing the strength at a grandmaster level when manifested outside the body. A single divine form can contend with a grandmaster!
And in the future,
As Ding Ling’s strength continues to grow, as long as he receives enough ’divinity’ to nourish these two divine forms, allowing them to transform again.
They will certainly become stronger.
Of course.

Their most suitable role is still to amplify tenfold power, to fight outside the body, unless Ding Ling is severely injured, with no one to protect him, then he might do so. Otherwise, Ding Ling would never casually release the divine forms from his body.
After all, under a tenfold amplification, Ding Ling’s combat power is off the charts, much more formidable than two grandmaster-level divine forms as auxiliaries.
After indicating for Duann Lang and others to rise, Ding Ling continued consuming the Great Medicine.
With the Great Perfection of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
Ding Ling’s body refining has not stopped.
The War God Technique began to take effect, once again enhancing the physical attributes.
This Divine Skill had long been full level.
Now, it just needed to be filled with a large amount of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi.
The amount of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi required for the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill was massive.
Even the divinity was barely enough to create the agility of the divine forms after swallowing and digesting the entire divinity of a Fire Qilin.
Now this War God Technique, in terms of body refining, is in no way inferior to the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, even surpasses it in some aspects.
The required amount of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi is imaginable.
Ding Ling kept consuming the Great Medicine.
He consumed a hundred plants in one go.
[Strength +1]
[Constitution +1]
[Defense +1]
The Great Medicine was around two to three hundred years old, compared to the Blood Bodhi, the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi in this Great Medicine were quite ordinary.
Fortunately, the quantity was large.
And the War God Technique merely needed the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi from this Great Medicine.
According to the normal progress of ingesting Great Medicine, Ding Ling’s consumption of two to three hundred-year-old Great Medicine should have zero effect.
But because the War God Technique simply required the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi within, resistance lost its effect at this moment!
Ding Ling consumed the remaining 1600 plants of Great Medicine in one go.
[Strength +16]
[Constitution +16]
[Defense +16]
In one go, he leapt 16 points.
The change in Ding Ling’s aura was extremely noticeable.
An ’intention’ of the War God began to flicker, as if a War God would manifest at any moment!
This was also a divine form!
But different from Dragon Form and Elephant Form.
This was a spiritual body type of divine form, condensed into a ’War God’ using Ding Ling himself as the blueprint and template!
"To achieve the true Great Perfection of the War God Technique, besides having enough Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, a ’War God’ must be nurtured in the heart!"
Only with the ’War God Spirit Body’ accompanying can one achieve the immortality of the ’War God Spirit Body’ and thus remain unscathed!
Even if his head was chopped off!
As long as the War God Spirit Body is intact, the head can be reattached, returning to a perfect state.
"I see."
After consuming so much Great Medicine,
the progress of Ding Ling’s War God Technique soared!
Ding Ling became more and more profound in understanding of the War God Technique.
"It seems that the War God Spirit Body must successfully condense, then even if my head is severed, I won’t fear. Otherwise, I must protect my head well."
Within the head are the Consciousness Body, Sea of Consciousness, etc.
If the head is severed, the body and Consciousness Body lose connection, naturally making it hard to restore.
But once condensed into a ’War God Spirit Body’, it’s akin to having a second ’Consciousness Body’!
As long as one of the two Consciousness Bodies exists.
Ding Ling will remain undying!
This is the fundamental reason for the immortality of the War God Technique!
"War God Technique! Truly a divine technique born for war!"
"But the War God Spirit Body also requires a sufficient amount of divinity to condense!"
And this world’s divinity generally comes from the Four Great Divine Beasts.
Therefore, Ding Ling targeted the Divine Dragon.
As long as the dragon slaying is successful.
Absorb the Divine Dragon’s divinity into the War God Spirit Body!
Once Ding Ling condenses a second ’Consciousness Body’, then he will no longer fear beheading, etc.! His vitality and combat power will absolutely spike instantly!
Ding Ling was invigorated, thinking:
"First, defeat the Celestial Sect, acquire all of its resources to strengthen myself, then unify Jiuzhou, march towards the Divine Dragon, and finally attack Japan!
According to the comic records.
There are many hidden super experts on Japan.
To ensure nothing goes wrong,
killing the Divine Dragon and strengthening oneself is very necessary.
Thinking thus.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Root Bone 6, Wisdom 8.8, Strength 140.2, Agility 91.4, Constitution 139.9, Defense 137, Charm 13. True Power Value: 61 points]
Strength, Constitution, and Defense continuously breaking through limitations.
Ding Ling could clearly perceive his lifespan significantly extending!
Feeling it carefully.
His lifespan extended by another two hundred years.
Combined with earlier lifespan increases,
living over a thousand years is no problem at all.
"Over a thousand years."
Ding Ling was momentarily stunned.
Unknowingly, his lifespan has reached such a frightful state, even just enduring, he could outlast several generations of mortals!
But his goal is not only to achieve immortality himself but also to make Diao Chan and others immortal!
Thus,
he only had a brief moment of astonishment before he regained clarity.
Because he is not satisfied with this.
"Continue to acquire Great Medicine."
Ding Ling ordered Duann Lang:
"Additionally, work with the World Association to recruit talented individuals, both literary and military, and rapidly unify Jiuzhou."
"Yes, Venerable Lord."
Duann Lang respectfully complied.
Ding Ling had just consumed a vast amount of Great Medicine.
He consumed it like drinking water, finishing all 1800 plants of Great Medicine.
Duann Lang could only watch in secret amazement.
If given this much Great Medicine, he would definitely over-nourish and kill himself!
Not to mention himself.
He believed if given to the Martial Arts Myth Wuming, Wuming would also end up dying from consumption!
But Ding Ling consumed it, and kept growing stronger!
This is the gap!
"Guan Yu, coordinate well with Duann Lang."
Ding Ling glanced at Guan Yu.

Guan Yu had received the inheritance of City-Overturning Love, as long as he does not release the ultimate moves of City-Overturning Love, using some other big moves in normal times, his endurance is still adequate.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 638: Pojun
paragraphs: Add to that, Guan Yu with his southern and northern campaigns, he is a distinguished general. With his cooperation with Duann Lang, the footsteps towards unity should accelerate significantly.
"Yes, Prince!"
Ding Ling, accompanied by Little Zhao, headed towards the Sword Sect under the guidance of Wuming.
With the help of Duann Lang and others.
This made him feel a lot more relaxed.
Gathering 1800 Great Medicines on his own, who knows how long it would take.
But Duann Lang managed it in a short period.
It seems Duann Lang must have put in great effort, or perhaps offered many promises to gather so much Great Medicine in such a short time.
But to collect this much again?
Ding Ling estimated it would definitely be very difficult!
After all, gathering that much the first time, the nearby merchants, sects, families around Unrivaled City surely contributed a great deal.
Some sects might have even been completely emptied.
To ask them to produce more Great Medicines, it’s impossible to conjure them out of thin air.
Ding Ling wasn’t worried about this.
This time he’s heading to the Celestial Sect.
The books, Great Medicines stored in the Celestial Sect surely won’t be few.
Whoosh whoosh!
The three hurried along, at an extremely fast speed.
During the journey, Little Zhao recited everything she had learned and the Secret Manual she knew for Ding Ling.
Among them was the Qiankun Great Shift.
[Qiankun Great Shift Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.3]
This Technique has seven levels.
People with high perception need seven years to master the first level, and the second level doubles the time.
The creator only reached the sixth level.
The seventh level can be said to be derived from the creator’s imagination and striving for Transformation, consisting of nineteen phrases, seemingly plausible.
Yet Ding Ling achieved full level.
Because these nineteen phrases, though somewhat fantastical, conform to certain principles of mechanics and were taken by the library to extract the essence.
Allowing Ding Ling to instantly reach full level at the seventh level.
Learning the previous six levels enables potential, shifting Vigorous Qi, using force to counter force, converting Yin and Yang Qi, creating opponent’s flaws, copying opponent’s Martial Arts, etc.
And by mastering the seventh level.
It further enabled Ding Ling to elevate this Martial Arts to an unprecedented Supreme realm!

No matter what Martial Arts, as long as it’s within the Martial World, not surpassing Qiankun Great Shift in rank, and requires Vigorous Qi control, once he comprehends it, he will instantly know the secrets of its practice!
"Such a powerful Qiankun Great Shift!"
"It seems everyone has underestimated its power!"

This is also due to Ding Ling’s library being extremely unrivaled. As long as the Mantra is the original version, it can instantly reach full level. If others were to cultivate the seventh level, they’d likely face the consequence of going astray.
"Already mastered?!"
Little Zhao looked at Ding Ling in admiration, amazement, and adoration:
"Young Master, you’re truly amazing."
Wuming glanced aside, nodded and said:
"Ding Ling’s talent is indeed unparalleled. The Vigorous Qi from Qiankun Great Shift seems quite mysterious, as if it possesses the capability to penetrate through all Martial Arts mysteries."
"Indeed."
Ding Ling casually spoke two sentences about Qiankun Great Shift’s overview.

Wuming was moved, slightly sparred with Ding Ling. Without using Supreme Sword Dao, Ding Ling only used a fraction of his strength, merely leveraging Qiankun Great Shift, and managed to send Wuming flying.
Wuming marveled, spoke no more, but pointed ahead:
"The Sword Sect has arrived."
Located within a cave in the extremely cold mountains of the northeast.
Not far from the Celestial Sect.
Ding Ling had the Celestial Sect’s map, compared the distance when arriving at the Sword Sect, naturally he was clear about it.
He and Wuming entered the Sword Sect, discovering that its interior was indeed Frozen.
The previous Sect Leader Jian Hui was ruthless, not only freezing the visiting masters but also himself.
And from the shattered scene inside the Sword Sect.
It’s needless to say.
Someone must have been to the Sword Sect before Ding Ling and Wuming.
"The Sect Leader’s and others’ bodies are missing."
Wuming’s expression slightly changed.
"Few know about the Sword Sect’s ruins. It seems Pojun and others sold this secret place to someone else."
Wuming barely finished speaking.
Accompanied by a loud laugh, a person walked out from behind a massive ice pillar.

This person with straight stature, sword-shaped brows with star-like eyes, had three long floating whiskers beneath his chin, carrying a sword and a saber, exuding a distinguished yet wild aura. As he laughed heartily, the laughter caused the icy stalactites above the cave to tremble.
"Pojun!"
Wuming saw this person, his expression changed slightly.
"Indeed."
The newcomer disdainfully looked at Wuming, mockingly said:
"Wuming, you’re not bringing outsiders to this Sword Sect secret place, what right do you have to blame me!
"When did you come, where are the others?"
"It’s none of your business when I came."
Pojun glanced at Ding Ling and Little Zhao:

"A girl, a young man. Wuming you dare come to the Sword Sect secret place with these two wet-behind-the-ears kids, do you think with just you three, you can find Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root."
"Could it be that you’ve found it?"
Ding Ling interjected.
"Naturally."
Pojun took out the Secret Manual from his arms, and flaunted it towards Ding Ling, proudly said:
"Whatever I, Pojun, intend to do, I will succeed!"
His eyes passionately fixated on Wuming:
"I’ve already mastered a Divine Skill Great Technique. Wuming, today I’ll use you to test it out!"
As his words fell.
Without a second thought, he suddenly drew his saber, and fiercely slashed towards Ding Ling’s direction!
That slash, fast and urgent, once executed, the wind and clouds arose in the void, faintly a giant fierce wolf could be seen roaring towards the sun.
This is evidently ’Greed Wolf Devouring the Sun’!
Upon executing this move.
Even the sun could be devoured.

How could ordinary people withstand it, seeing Ding Ling about to be bitten to death by the greedy wolf, Pojun was smug, thinking Wuming oh Wuming, this time I’ve killed your man, watch where you go! This time you must fight me even if you don’t want to!
But in the next blink!
Whoosh whoosh!
A particular rotation of Vigorous Qi suddenly spun, the Sword Qi of ’Greed Wolf Devouring the Sun’ swiftly headed back towards Pojun at even greater speed.
Pojun was caught off guard, nearly got hit.
He was shocked:
"Shifted and countered?! What Technique could so easily deflect a killing move I’ve studied for years, Killing Wolf?!"
Ding Ling did not answer.
Merely disdainfully snorted.
With a thought!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Boom!
A mass of formidable Sword Intent suddenly erupted, heading towards Pojun with unstoppable force, within a breath’s time, the wild aura around Pojun suddenly vanished!
The whole person stood motionless on the spot.
Leaving only a pair of eyes filled with horror, as if narrating something extremely terrifying had just happened.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Deter Pojun.]

[Note: Pojun received help from a benefactor, mastered Supreme Great Technique. Unexpectedly, before he could activate and use the Supreme Technique, you annihilated him instantly! He died with regrets!]

sentences.text: Add to that, Guan Yu with his southern and northern campaigns, he is a distinguished general.
With his cooperation with Duann Lang, the footsteps towards unity should accelerate significantly.
"Yes, Prince!"
Ding Ling, accompanied by Little Zhao, headed towards the Sword Sect under the guidance of Wuming.
With the help of Duann Lang and others.
This made him feel a lot more relaxed.
Gathering 1800 Great Medicines on his own, who knows how long it would take.
But Duann Lang managed it in a short period.
It seems Duann Lang must have put in great effort, or perhaps offered many promises to gather so much Great Medicine in such a short time.
But to collect this much again?
Ding Ling estimated it would definitely be very difficult!
After all, gathering that much the first time, the nearby merchants, sects, families around Unrivaled City surely contributed a great deal.
Some sects might have even been completely emptied.
To ask them to produce more Great Medicines, it’s impossible to conjure them out of thin air.
Ding Ling wasn’t worried about this.
This time he’s heading to the Celestial Sect.
The books, Great Medicines stored in the Celestial Sect surely won’t be few.
Whoosh whoosh!
The three hurried along, at an extremely fast speed.
During the journey, Little Zhao recited everything she had learned and the Secret Manual she knew for Ding Ling.
Among them was the Qiankun Great Shift.
[Qiankun Great Shift Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.3]
This Technique has seven levels.
People with high perception need seven years to master the first level, and the second level doubles the time.
The creator only reached the sixth level.
The seventh level can be said to be derived from the creator’s imagination and striving for Transformation, consisting of nineteen phrases, seemingly plausible.
Yet Ding Ling achieved full level.
Because these nineteen phrases, though somewhat fantastical, conform to certain principles of mechanics and were taken by the library to extract the essence.
Allowing Ding Ling to instantly reach full level at the seventh level.
Learning the previous six levels enables potential, shifting Vigorous Qi, using force to counter force, converting Yin and Yang Qi, creating opponent’s flaws, copying opponent’s Martial Arts, etc.
And by mastering the seventh level.
It further enabled Ding Ling to elevate this Martial Arts to an unprecedented Supreme realm!

No matter what Martial Arts, as long as it’s within the Martial World, not surpassing Qiankun Great Shift in rank, and requires Vigorous Qi control, once he comprehends it, he will instantly know the secrets of its practice!
"Such a powerful Qiankun Great Shift!"
"It seems everyone has underestimated its power!"
This is also due to Ding Ling’s library being extremely unrivaled.
As long as the Mantra is the original version, it can instantly reach full level.
If others were to cultivate the seventh level, they’d likely face the consequence of going astray.
"Already mastered?!"
Little Zhao looked at Ding Ling in admiration, amazement, and adoration:
"Young Master, you’re truly amazing."
Wuming glanced aside, nodded and said:
"Ding Ling’s talent is indeed unparalleled.
The Vigorous Qi from Qiankun Great Shift seems quite mysterious, as if it possesses the capability to penetrate through all Martial Arts mysteries."
"Indeed."
Ding Ling casually spoke two sentences about Qiankun Great Shift’s overview.
Wuming was moved, slightly sparred with Ding Ling.
Without using Supreme Sword Dao, Ding Ling only used a fraction of his strength, merely leveraging Qiankun Great Shift, and managed to send Wuming flying.
Wuming marveled, spoke no more, but pointed ahead:
"The Sword Sect has arrived."
Located within a cave in the extremely cold mountains of the northeast.
Not far from the Celestial Sect.
Ding Ling had the Celestial Sect’s map, compared the distance when arriving at the Sword Sect, naturally he was clear about it.
He and Wuming entered the Sword Sect, discovering that its interior was indeed Frozen.
The previous Sect Leader Jian Hui was ruthless, not only freezing the visiting masters but also himself.
And from the shattered scene inside the Sword Sect.
It’s needless to say.
Someone must have been to the Sword Sect before Ding Ling and Wuming.
"The Sect Leader’s and others’ bodies are missing."
Wuming’s expression slightly changed.
"Few know about the Sword Sect’s ruins.
It seems Pojun and others sold this secret place to someone else."
Wuming barely finished speaking.
Accompanied by a loud laugh, a person walked out from behind a massive ice pillar.
This person with straight stature, sword-shaped brows with star-like eyes, had three long floating whiskers beneath his chin, carrying a sword and a saber, exuding a distinguished yet wild aura.
As he laughed heartily, the laughter caused the icy stalactites above the cave to tremble.
"Pojun!"
Wuming saw this person, his expression changed slightly.
"Indeed."
The newcomer disdainfully looked at Wuming, mockingly said:
"Wuming, you’re not bringing outsiders to this Sword Sect secret place, what right do you have to blame me!
"When did you come, where are the others?"
"It’s none of your business when I came."
Pojun glanced at Ding Ling and Little Zhao:
"A girl, a young man.
Wuming you dare come to the Sword Sect secret place with these two wet-behind-the-ears kids, do you think with just you three, you can find Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root."
"Could it be that you’ve found it?"
Ding Ling interjected.
"Naturally."
Pojun took out the Secret Manual from his arms, and flaunted it towards Ding Ling, proudly said:
"Whatever I, Pojun, intend to do, I will succeed!"
His eyes passionately fixated on Wuming:
"I’ve already mastered a Divine Skill Great Technique.
Wuming, today I’ll use you to test it out!"
As his words fell.
Without a second thought, he suddenly drew his saber, and fiercely slashed towards Ding Ling’s direction!
That slash, fast and urgent, once executed, the wind and clouds arose in the void, faintly a giant fierce wolf could be seen roaring towards the sun.
This is evidently ’Greed Wolf Devouring the Sun’!
Upon executing this move.
Even the sun could be devoured.
How could ordinary people withstand it, seeing Ding Ling about to be bitten to death by the greedy wolf, Pojun was smug, thinking Wuming oh Wuming, this time I’ve killed your man, watch where you go!
This time you must fight me even if you don’t want to!
But in the next blink!
Whoosh whoosh!
A particular rotation of Vigorous Qi suddenly spun, the Sword Qi of ’Greed Wolf Devouring the Sun’ swiftly headed back towards Pojun at even greater speed.
Pojun was caught off guard, nearly got hit.
He was shocked:
"Shifted and countered?!
What Technique could so easily deflect a killing move I’ve studied for years, Killing Wolf?!"
Ding Ling did not answer.
Merely disdainfully snorted.
With a thought!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Boom!
A mass of formidable Sword Intent suddenly erupted, heading towards Pojun with unstoppable force, within a breath’s time, the wild aura around Pojun suddenly vanished!
The whole person stood motionless on the spot.
Leaving only a pair of eyes filled with horror, as if narrating something extremely terrifying had just happened.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Deter Pojun.]
[Note: Pojun received help from a benefactor, mastered Supreme Great Technique.
Unexpectedly, before he could activate and use the Supreme Technique, you annihilated him instantly!
He died with regrets!]

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 639: Celestial Blade and Greed Wolf Sword
paragraphs: Did Pojun learn the Supreme Technique?
And also received assistance from a mystery benefactor?
Who is this benefactor?

Ding Ling was puzzled, but it did not affect his actions. He grabbed into the air, snatched the Secret Manual from Pojun’s hand, opened it, and to his astonishment, it turned out to be the "World-Ending Demon Body"!
"It’s not Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root!"
It seems Pojun was lying just now.
Ding Ling used Dragon Capturing Skill again to grab Pojun’s corpse over, then operated the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill, Transformation Skill, Storage Skill!
Whirl! Whirl!
Rolling True Qi surged into his body and was quickly refined.
[Inner Power Value +100]
Pojun’s skill tier unexpectedly reached high-tier Grandmaster!
He was not far from the Grandmaster Realm.
It appears he indeed acquired considerable serendipity and fortune recently!
Unfortunately, he actually wanted to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was decisive in his killing; if others didn’t provoke him, fine, but once provoked, he would rise like a thunderbolt, choosing to kill the opponent!
That’s why Pojun died so decisively!
Not to mention Pojun did not react.
Wuming also did not react.

Upon seeing Pojun dead, Wuming’s expression changed slightly, but he soon sighed and said no more. The matter of Pojun killing his wife, spread from the mouth of the alien, had become known throughout the world. How could Wuming not know?
Ding Ling instantly killed Pojun.
Wuming couldn’t save him. Thinking of the past, he naturally didn’t say much.
Pa! Ta!
Ding Ling tossed Pojun’s body to the side.
Compared to Jue Xin, the current Pojun was indeed much stronger!
Jue Xin, as an Innate Expert, only contributed a mere 15 points.

It can only be said that as Ding Ling broke into the Shattered Realm, the quality of True Qi brought the Shattering True Intent, with a very high level, so the inner strength of normal Innate Experts didn’t bring him much benefit.
Even such experts nearing Grandmaster only provided 100 points.
This is mainly because Pojun seemed to have practiced a Shattering Level technique, with much fewer impurities than other Grandmaster Level techniques; otherwise, there might not even be 100 points.
"The Shattering Level technique must be this World-Ending Demon Body."
Ding Ling opened the World-Ending Demon Body.
Rustle!
Reading as if flipping through a book, reading 10 lines at a glance, or a hundred.
Soon read it all.
[World-Ending Demon Body Internal Power Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[World-Ending Demon Body External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Defense +0.6]
[Physique +0.5]
This World-Ending Demon Body unexpectedly is a Supreme Technique of both inner and outer cultivation!
It’s at the Shattering Level!
Upon reaching full level.
Rolling Spiritual Mechanism Primordial Qi swarmed in, Ding Ling operated the Eternal Youth Technique, and soon, three threads of Longevity True Qi appeared in the Dantian.
Moreover, quickly condensed into a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value 62 points]
Slightly operating the technique of the World-Ending Demon Body.
The surface of Ding Ling’s body had an extremely special layer of Protective Gang Qi.
This Gang Qi continuously remodeled the skin and viscera, making Ding Ling’s entire body defense increasingly tough and strong.
This, surprisingly, is a technique that can make one’s body invulnerable to blades and spears, resistant to water and fire.
But Ding Ling’s body, after several reconstructions and exercises, was already invulnerable.
With the operation of Protective Gang Qi, even jumping into magma is fine.
This full-level World-Ending Demon Body.
Just made Ding Ling’s defense even stronger, adding another layer of Protective Gang Qi!

This now made Ding Ling anticipate even more what the martial arts secret manual forged from Indestructible Golden Body + World-Ending Demon Body + Vajra Indestructible Body Divine Skill + Nine Yang Divine Skill would ultimately evolve into.
"Wuming, take a look."
Ding Ling handed the Secret Manual of World-Ending Demon Body to Wuming.
Many people indeed knew this World-Ending Demon Body.
Ding Ling had no need to hide his skills.
After all, purely speaking, he and Wuming were still on the same side now.
Wuming finished reading, moved:
"This technique seems, when cultivated to Great Perfection, can increase lifespan by hundreds of years!"
"Precisely. If cultivated to its utmost, the true qi of the World-Ending Demon Body would be endlessly circulating within the body, living for a thousand or two thousand years becomes easy."
Ding Ling had seen it long ago.

This World-Ending Demon Body, he saw a Divine General perform, and the effects were exactly the same, only the World-Ending Demon Body doesn’t record the related ’skills’, just the pure Fundamental Technique.
Even so, the enhancement in lifespan, the consumption of true qi for healing injuries, detoxification, and other effects, this World-Ending Demon Body also possesses.
This is a remarkably outstanding Shattering Root Technique.
Anyone learning it could greatly increase potential, with a future full of possibilities!
"I seem to have heard people talk about this technique before."
After flipping through the Secret Manual of the World-Ending Demon Body, Wuming appeared somewhat dazed:
"It’s rumored to be a technique of immortality.
"How could it be true immortality?"
Ding Ling shook his head:
"At most, it lets you live longer. Of course, in the eyes of ordinary people, one or two thousand years is already indistinguishable from immortality."
Mortal lifespan lasts a few decades.
The longer ones a hundred years or so.
One or two thousand years, to many, indeed appears as an unattainable number!
"Even so, it is exceedingly remarkable."
Wuming returned the Secret Manual to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling then handed it to Little Zhao.
Little Zhao was taken aback by the surprise.
Ding Ling smiled, signaling her to accept it, hoping she could reach Great Success in the Divine Skill in the future.
Little Zhao, moved, swore internally to train diligently and cultivate this World-Ending Demon Body to Great Success!
Pa! Ta!
Pa! Ta!
Ding Ling again grabbed into the air, seizing Pojun’s two weapons.
The quality of the two weapons was extraordinary.

A peculiar ferocious aura emanated from them, seemingly capable of devouring people or even swallowing the heavens and the sun, just looking at them made one’s hairs stand on end, and holding them, the murderous aura was enough to make ordinary people shrink back in fear.
But how could Ding Ling, of such stature, possibly fear such mere murderous aura?
Just a slight cold snort.
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!

A sword of killing intent formed from an immense Supreme Sword Intent pierced the murderous aura of the two swords, in an instant, the murderous aura dissipated and contracted inside the sword body, trembling slightly, continuously ringing, but not daring to be reckless again.
Ding Ling held these two swords and said:
"The sword is a good sword, and the blade is also a good blade. It’s just too ferocious."

"Ordinary people cannot control them. Ding Ling, with your outstanding aptitude and immense power, your Supreme Sword Intent flows with your will, able to break any resistance, these two swords in your hands, no matter how fierce, will become lambs. You are the most suitable to use them."
Wuming said beside him.
Ding Ling was noncommittal, drew the sword, its wide blade gleaming with sharpness!
Clang!
The sword returned to its scabbard.
Ding Ling glanced at the blade, equally sharp to the extreme.
"These are the famous Greed Wolf Sword and Celestial Blade. Indeed worthy of being two of the Seven Weapons of Wind and Cloud."
These two swords, though not matching the Xuanyuan Sword or Snow-Drinking Saber,
But they were far superior to the Heaven-Swaying Sword.
Only slightly inferior to the Snow-Drinking Saber.

The sword and saber, fitting naturally with heaven and earth, were meticulously crafted, and the person who forged these Divine Weapons perhaps put them in the Celestial Wolf Valley to let them be immersed in the presence of wolves day and night, eventually even being able to turn the tide and control the wolf pack.
